description: v2 voice pass: Toa + Kaoru + narrator. ID3 + JSON for per-line regen.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Done complaining?
entries.game_text: Done complaining?

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Wrong door. Again.
entries.game_text: Wrong door. Again.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Still there? Knock if you want something.
entries.game_text: Still there? Knock if you want something.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Smarter the second time. Knock.
entries.game_text: Smarter the second time. Knock.

entries.text: [calm] [dismissive] Enter. You can knock when you want something. Try standing still next.
entries.game_text: Enter. You can knock when you want something. Try standing still next.

entries.text: [dismissive] [calm] Tedious. Correct, but tedious.
entries.game_text: Tedious. Correct, but tedious.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] At least your courtesy bow didn't wobble. Continue — briefly.
entries.game_text: At least your bow didn't wobble. Continue — briefly.

entries.text: [dismissive] [calm] Plain speech. You waste less of my evening than most.
entries.game_text: Plain speech. You waste less of my evening than most.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Names and purpose. Quickly.
entries.game_text: Names and purpose. Quickly.

entries.text: [dismissive] [calm] Humor in my office. Brave or stupid.
entries.game_text: Humor in my office. Brave or stupid.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] We'll discover which tonight.
entries.game_text: We'll discover which tonight.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Emerald Magistrate Kitsu Kaoru. You will use my title if you wish to leave with a seal.
entries.game_text: Emerald Magistrate Kitsu Kaoru. You will use my title if you wish to leave with a seal.

entries.text: [calm] [dismissive] State your business. Briefly.
entries.game_text: State your business. Briefly.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Crane hair, [short pause] Unicorn permit dates. Wrong clan for this desk — wrong week to fix it.
entries.game_text: Crane hair, Unicorn permit dates. Wrong clan for this desk — wrong week to fix it.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Posture on the cushion. We'll see if your feet match your courtesy bow.
entries.game_text: Posture on the cushion. We'll see if your feet match your bow.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Flexibility. [short pause] The roads teach what the Academy cannot. Sit, and show me the rest is more than posture.
entries.game_text: Flexibility. The roads teach what the Academy cannot. Sit, and show me the rest is more than posture.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Survivable. We'll test that claim before dawn.
entries.game_text: Survivable. We'll test that claim before dawn.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Interclan residence requires Emerald approval. You knew that.
entries.game_text: Interclan residence requires Emerald approval. You knew that.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] It does. Door.
entries.game_text: It does. Door.

entries.text: [deadpan] [calm] Better. Most Crane can't resist cataloging a room like a museum.
entries.game_text: Better. Most Crane can't resist cataloging a room like a museum.

entries.text: [dismissive] [calm] I said sit. Not catalog my trophies.
entries.game_text: I said sit. Not catalog my trophies.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Since you admire my shelves so freely, you may admire the seal from a distance. [short pause] If you ever earn it.
entries.game_text: Since you admire my shelves so freely, you may admire the seal from a distance. If you ever earn it.

entries.text: [dismissive] [calm] Cushion. Floor. You stand too much for someone begging favors.
entries.game_text: Cushion. Floor. You stand too much for someone begging favors.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] These dates.
entries.game_text: These dates.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] They are not. Your permit expired. Unicorn bureaucracy failed to mention it?
entries.game_text: They are not. Your permit expired. Unicorn bureaucracy failed to mention it?

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] How obedient. The Unicorn taught you to yield before the fight begins.
entries.game_text: How obedient. The Unicorn taught you to yield before the fight begins.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Unfortunately for your travel plans, I'm not finished with you.
entries.game_text: Unfortunately for your travel plans, I'm not finished with you.

entries.text: [calm] [warmly] Requirements. Finally, a useful word.
entries.game_text: Requirements. Finally, a useful word.

entries.text: [calm] [warmly] Most petitioners wail. You ask for terms. That almost earns respect.
entries.game_text: Most petitioners wail. You ask for terms. That almost earns respect.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Tragic. Continue.
entries.game_text: Tragic. Continue.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] A curry shop and borrowed bedding. Ryoko Owari's finest import.
entries.game_text: A curry shop and borrowed bedding. Ryoko Owari's finest import.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] We'll see what it's worth.
entries.game_text: We'll see what it's worth.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] No local patrons. No endorsements.
entries.game_text: No local patrons. No endorsements.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] High society.
entries.game_text: High society.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Proof requires more than appetite. Tut.
entries.game_text: Proof requires more than appetite. Tut.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Tomorrow is generous. Tut.
entries.game_text: Tomorrow is generous. Tut.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Tomorrow. Tut.
entries.game_text: Tomorrow. Tut.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] May have.
entries.game_text: May have.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Dance listed. Venue missing. Patron column blank. Even a junior clerk can read what that adds to.
entries.game_text: Dance listed. Venue missing. Patron column blank. Even a junior clerk can read what that adds to.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] You have curiosity. Not yet an audience.
entries.game_text: You have curiosity. Not yet an audience.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Stand.
entries.game_text: Stand.

entries.text: [deadpan] [calm] Proposed remedy?
entries.game_text: Proposed remedy?

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Impress me.
entries.game_text: Impress me.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Bold. We'll see if your art matches your contract law.
entries.game_text: Bold. We'll see if your art matches your contract law.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] I sign when I'm satisfied — not when you're tired. That is the only term.
entries.game_text: I sign when I'm satisfied — not when you're tired. That is the only term.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Acceptable. Begin.
entries.game_text: Acceptable. Begin.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] No preamble. Good.
entries.game_text: No preamble. Good.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Then you may walk back to your curry shop and explain an expired permit to the gate guards.
entries.game_text: Then you may walk back to your curry shop and explain an expired permit to the gate guards.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Justice is what I write on the page you didn't earn.
entries.game_text: Justice is what I write on the page you didn't earn.

entries.text: [dismissive] [calm] The gate closes at midnight. The canal district is that way.
entries.game_text: The gate closes at midnight. The canal district is that way.

entries.text: [deadpan] [chuckles] You won't. You'll knock again when hunger wins.
entries.game_text: You won't. You'll knock again when hunger wins.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] We'll see about never.
entries.game_text: We'll see about never.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Better. Keep going. I haven't touched the hanko yet.
entries.game_text: Better. Keep going. I haven't touched the hanko yet.

entries.text: [deadpan] [chuckles] Cheeky.
entries.game_text: Cheeky.

entries.text: [dismissive] [calm] Terms are for courts. This is my desk.
entries.game_text: Terms are for courts. This is my desk.

entries.text: [dismissive] [calm] Merit enough. Signature [short pause] ... pending.
entries.game_text: Merit enough. Signature... pending.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Continue.
entries.game_text: Continue.

entries.text: [calm] [warmly] A good performance.
entries.game_text: A good performance.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Better when you stop pretending the room is empty.
entries.game_text: Better when you stop pretending the room is empty.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] No? And yet you're still here.
entries.game_text: No? And yet you're still here.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Defiance suits you. Cheap seals don't.
entries.game_text: Defiance suits you. Cheap seals don't.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Better.
entries.game_text: Better.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Don't stop on my account.
entries.game_text: Don't stop on my account.

entries.text: [whispers] [short pause] Unless?
entries.game_text: Unless?

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Legally. You learn.
entries.game_text: Legally. You learn.

entries.text: [whispers] [calm] Unless you mean to finish what you started.
entries.game_text: Unless you mean to finish what you started.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] You'll be back. The permit still expires.
entries.game_text: You'll be back. The permit still expires.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] You negotiate with your mouth. Adequate.
entries.game_text: You negotiate with your mouth. Adequate.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Almost.
entries.game_text: Almost.

entries.text: [dismissive] [calm] Justice arrives when you stop treating my office like a stage you can exit on your terms.
entries.game_text: Justice arrives when you stop treating my office like a stage you can exit on your terms.

entries.text: [dismissive] [calm] More requires more. Leave before I charge you for the water you made me drink.
entries.game_text: More requires more. Leave before I charge you for the water you made me drink.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] I'll be here. Dates don't renew themselves.
entries.game_text: I'll be here. Dates don't renew themselves.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Then go. The city has other dancers and fewer scruples.
entries.game_text: Then go. The city has other dancers and fewer scruples.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] You'll knock again when the gate guards ask for paper you don't have.
entries.game_text: You'll knock again when the gate guards ask for paper you don't have.

entries.text: [whispers] [calm] You earned more than noise tonight.
entries.game_text: You earned more than noise tonight.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Patience.
entries.game_text: Patience.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] There. Signed.
entries.game_text: There. Signed.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Effective when I say. Return on the thirtieth. We'll discuss your residency then.
entries.game_text: Effective when I say. Return on the thirtieth. We'll discuss your residency then.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Bring yourself, on time. We will negotiate the rest across my desk.
entries.game_text: Bring yourself, on time. We will negotiate the rest across my desk.

entries.text: [whispers] [calm] Thirtieth. You'll knock on the right door [short pause] — I'll leave it unlatched.
entries.game_text: Thirtieth. You'll knock on the right door — I'll leave it unlatched.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Early is still obedience. Sit before you spill something on my docket.
entries.game_text: Early is still obedience. Sit before you spill something on my docket.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] We'll see if your appetite survives what I'm about to read you aloud.
entries.game_text: We'll see if your appetite survives what I'm about to read you aloud.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Bring that audience-of-one fervor to the docket. Cases bore me less when you perform.
entries.game_text: Bring that audience-of-one fervor to the docket. Cases bore me less when you perform.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You came back. I noted that.
entries.game_text: You came back. I noted that.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You still flinch when I reach for the cup. Don't, next time.
entries.game_text: You still flinch when I reach for the cup. Don't, next time.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You negotiated once. We'll see if you learned anything.
entries.game_text: You negotiated once. We'll see if you learned anything.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Ambitious. Now fetch the file.
entries.game_text: Ambitious. Now fetch the file.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You asked me for remedies once. Case One is your audition for belonging here.
entries.game_text: You asked me for remedies once. Case One is your audition for belonging here.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] No curry shop tonight. Just work.
entries.game_text: No curry shop tonight. Just work.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You danced like a maiden at a shrine. Try not to bow to the corpse.
entries.game_text: You danced like a maiden at a shrine. Try not to bow to the corpse.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] After. [short pause] And stop bowing at every clause. My neck aches just from watching you.
entries.game_text: After. And stop bowing at every clause. My neck aches just from watching you.

entries.text: [warmly] [matter-of-fact] Good. Plain speech spares us both another fan dance.
entries.game_text: Good. Plain speech spares us both another fan dance.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You may keep the guest room until the date takes effect. That was courtesy, not a loophole.
entries.game_text: You may keep the guest room until the date takes effect. That was courtesy, not a loophole.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Companion duties: attend the magistrate, carry messages, witness interviews, keep discretion, remain on the premises unless I release you. [short pause] The treasury pays for the art. Everything else it merely permits.
entries.game_text: Companion duties: attend the magistrate, carry messages, witness interviews, keep discretion, remain on the premises unless I release you. The treasury pays for the art. Everything else it merely permits.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You'll take meals in the inner hall. [short pause] You'll sleep in the chamber adjoining my office. You'll answer when I call, day or night.
entries.game_text: You'll take meals in the inner hall. You'll sleep in the chamber adjoining my office. You'll answer when I call, day or night.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] It sounds like law because it is. [short pause] Ryoko Owari doesn't grant interclan residence to dancers who vanish after sunset.
entries.game_text: It sounds like law because it is. Ryoko Owari doesn't grant interclan residence to dancers who vanish after sunset.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Three koku monthly, plus board. [short pause] Official gifts to support your expression. The treasury won't call you a kept performer so long as the ledger says patronage.
entries.game_text: Three koku monthly, plus board. Official gifts to support your expression. The treasury won't call you a kept performer so long as the ledger says patronage.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Then you understand the bargain. Sign it, or go back to Unicorn roads and expired paper.
entries.game_text: Then you understand the bargain. Sign it, or go back to Unicorn roads and expired paper.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You already proved you can close a proposition in this room. Don't pretend shock suits you.
entries.game_text: You already proved you can close a proposition in this room. Don't pretend shock suits you.

entries.text: [warmly] [matter-of-fact] Better. [short pause] You almost sound like you belong behind my desk, instead of on it.
entries.game_text: Better. You almost sound like you belong behind my desk, instead of on it.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Bold, for someone who still smells of my cedar shelves.
entries.game_text: Bold, for someone who still smells of my cedar shelves.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Academy letters wait on the outer desk. [short pause] You don't leave this compound without escort until Case One closes. Those are the terms.
entries.game_text: Academy letters wait on the outer desk. You don't leave this compound without escort until Case One closes. Those are the terms.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You'll work with what I give you. Now sign.
entries.game_text: You'll work with what I give you. Now sign.

entries.text: [warmly] [amused] Honest, at last. The treasury pays you regardless. Try not to grin at the clerk.
entries.game_text: Honest, at last. The treasury pays you regardless. Try not to grin at the clerk.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Effective on the thirtieth, as written. [short pause] Until then, you're mine to schedule, starting with Case One.
entries.game_text: Effective on the thirtieth, as written. Until then, you're mine to schedule, starting with Case One.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You'll fetch the docket from the inner archive. [short pause] Then you'll learn how this city buries its dead without funerals.
entries.game_text: You'll fetch the docket from the inner archive. Then you'll learn how this city buries its dead without funerals.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Thank me with a dry ledger, not with your mouth. Archive stairs. Now.
entries.game_text: Thank me with a dry ledger, not with your mouth. Archive stairs. Now.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Hold the lantern instead. You'll want both hands free on those steps.
entries.game_text: Hold the lantern instead. You'll want both hands free on those steps.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Leave the bells behind. This case is not a stage.
entries.game_text: Leave the bells behind. This case is not a stage.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Past the inner screen, down the left corridor. Don't rearrange my shelves.
entries.game_text: Past the inner screen, down the left corridor. Don't rearrange my shelves.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] I notice everything. Unpack after the docket, not before.
entries.game_text: I notice everything. Unpack after the docket, not before.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Left stair, behind the screen. [short pause] Archive dust on your hakama is acceptable. Just don't drop the ledger.
entries.game_text: Left stair, behind the screen. Archive dust on your hakama is acceptable. Just don't drop the ledger.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Refill it. [short pause] Then the archive. Then unpack. In that order, or I'll date your next permit forward again.
entries.game_text: Refill it. Then the archive. Then unpack. In that order, or I'll date your next permit forward again.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] When you come back, we open the file on the canal body. No audience. No bells. Only answers.
entries.game_text: When you come back, we open the file on the canal body. No audience. No bells. Only answers.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Bring rice crackers. I'll allow one indulgence before the city disappoints you.
entries.game_text: Bring rice crackers. I'll allow one indulgence before the city disappoints you.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Fetch the canal docket from the archive. We'll discuss residency once you've survived the season.
entries.game_text: Fetch the canal docket from the archive. We'll discuss residency once you've survived the season.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You took long enough. Set the docket on my desk and try not to breathe on the wax seals.
entries.game_text: You took long enough. Set the docket on my desk and try not to breathe on the wax seals.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Case One. [short pause] A body in the canal at first light. Noble quarter, where the water runs clean enough to mirror gold leaf.
entries.game_text: Case One. A body in the canal at first light. Noble quarter, where the water runs clean enough to mirror gold leaf.

entries.text: [coldly] [sternly] The watch writes drowning whenever the name line stays empty. [short pause] You'll learn which boxes they'll sign, and which they won't.
entries.game_text: The watch writes drowning whenever the name line stays empty. You'll learn which boxes they'll sign, and which they won't.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Night watch. [short pause] Fishermen who swore they saw nothing. And the Scorpion quarter upstream pretends the current runs backward.
entries.game_text: Night watch. Fishermen who swore they saw nothing. And the Scorpion quarter upstream pretends the current runs backward.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] The victim wears Miya colors under a borrowed haori. [short pause] Retainer's knot. Someone wanted him found. Someone else wanted him lost.
entries.game_text: The victim wears Miya colors under a borrowed haori. Retainer's knot. Someone wanted him found. Someone else wanted him lost.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Which is exactly why you sleep in the room beside my office. Discretion isn't decoration.
entries.game_text: Which is exactly why you sleep in the room beside my office. Discretion isn't decoration.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You'll collect at the waterline. First.
entries.game_text: You'll collect at the waterline. First.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Which is why you're not sleeping in my hall yet. [short pause] Prove you can witness a thing without selling it to the curry shops.
entries.game_text: Which is why you're not sleeping in my hall yet. Prove you can witness a thing without selling it to the curry shops.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] It counts toward the canal. It does not count toward trust.
entries.game_text: It counts toward the canal. It does not count toward trust.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Eat one now. You'll lose your appetite before we reach the water.
entries.game_text: Eat one now. You'll lose your appetite before we reach the water.

entries.text: [coldly] [sternly] Good. The watch wrote drowning and missed half of what you just said.
entries.game_text: Good. The watch wrote drowning and missed half of what you just said.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Poppy resin. Marriage contracts. Anyone in this city who sells silence by the barrel.
entries.game_text: Poppy resin. Marriage contracts. Anyone in this city who sells silence by the barrel.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You will not say any of that aloud at the canal. Watch faces instead.
entries.game_text: You will not say any of that aloud at the canal. Watch faces instead.

entries.text: [warmly] [matter-of-fact] Good. Notes I can file without crossing out half your adjectives.
entries.game_text: Good. Notes I can file without crossing out half your adjectives.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Try keeping that posture once the smell reaches you.
entries.game_text: Try keeping that posture once the smell reaches you.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] See that you do. Night calls won't wait for someone to light the lanterns.
entries.game_text: See that you do. Night calls won't wait for someone to light the lanterns.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Watch the eaves. Thieves in the noble quarter work for employers, not hunger.
entries.game_text: Watch the eaves. Thieves in the noble quarter work for employers, not hunger.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Wrong-colored water usually means a clerk poured something upstream. [short pause] Check the eaves before you blame charms.
entries.game_text: Wrong-colored water usually means a clerk poured something upstream. Check the eaves before you blame charms.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Kakita. Stand where I point you, and don't touch the water.
entries.game_text: Kakita. Stand where I point you, and don't touch the water.

entries.text: [coldly] [sternly] Identification first. Gossip a distant second. Mourning never.
entries.game_text: Identification first. Gossip a distant second. Mourning never.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Ask the river once you're qualified to. Until then, observe.
entries.game_text: Ask the river once you're qualified to. Until then, observe.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Which means he died somewhere else, then was dressed for display.
entries.game_text: Which means he died somewhere else, then was dressed for display.

entries.text: [coldly] [sternly] Because drowning keeps the taxes calm. You'll learn when to write only what the city can swallow.
entries.game_text: Because drowning keeps the taxes calm. You'll learn when to write only what the city can swallow.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] And when to make me swallow the harder truth instead. Not today.
entries.game_text: And when to make me swallow the harder truth instead. Not today.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Boring. Useful. The clerk can sign that without fainting.
entries.game_text: Boring. Useful. The clerk can sign that without fainting.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Don't touch it with bare hands.
entries.game_text: Don't touch it with bare hands.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Scorpion comb in Crane water. Bag it for custody. Don't compose metaphors over my desk.
entries.game_text: Scorpion comb in Crane water. Bag it for custody. Don't compose metaphors over my desk.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Borrowed haori, foreign comb. [short pause] Someone staged a message for Crane eyes. Put a name on that blank line.
entries.game_text: Borrowed haori, foreign comb. Someone staged a message for Crane eyes. Put a name on that blank line.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] The comb goes to the office. The name goes on the line. [short pause] You walk beside me, not a step ahead.
entries.game_text: The comb goes to the office. The name goes on the line. You walk beside me, not a step ahead.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Tomorrow we cross the Miya guest registry against Scorpion shipping rolls. [short pause] One of them flinches the moment Jiro's name is said aloud.
entries.game_text: Tomorrow we cross the Miya guest registry against Scorpion shipping rolls. One of them flinches the moment Jiro's name is said aloud.

entries.text: [warmly] [matter-of-fact] Eat. [short pause] Then copy the watch testimony twice: once for the Empire, once for what I actually believe happened.
entries.game_text: Eat. Then copy the watch testimony twice: once for the Empire, once for what I actually believe happened.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Eat, if you must. [short pause] Then copy the testimony twice. You read the water faster than my clerks did tonight. Do not let that go to your head before you have earned the rest of the season.
entries.game_text: Eat, if you must. Then copy the testimony twice. You read the water faster than my clerks did tonight. Do not let that go to your head before you have earned the rest of the season.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Summarize it. One sentence. If I say your words back to the Crane envoy, does he flinch or laugh?
entries.game_text: Summarize it. One sentence. If I say your words back to the Crane envoy, does he flinch or laugh?

entries.text: [warmly] [matter-of-fact] Good. [short pause] You sound like you belong in my hall, the moment you stop performing for corpses.
entries.game_text: Good. You sound like you belong in my hall, the moment you stop performing for corpses.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Bold. Don't mistake my attention for approval.
entries.game_text: Bold. Don't mistake my attention for approval.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Safe. The envoy won't laugh. He won't fear you either.
entries.game_text: Safe. The envoy won't laugh. He won't fear you either.

entries.text: [warmly] [amused] There she is. Keep that spine when the Miya registry clerks start smiling at you.
entries.game_text: There she is. Keep that spine when the Miya registry clerks start smiling at you.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] A witness without a seal is gossip. Learn faster.
entries.game_text: A witness without a seal is gossip. Learn faster.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Jiro handled Crane correspondence for the noble-quarter guest house. [short pause] Someone killed the clerk and still kept the appointment.
entries.game_text: Jiro handled Crane correspondence for the noble-quarter guest house. Someone killed the clerk and still kept the appointment.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You wanted a theory. Now you've got a face to hang it on. Don't gloat at the envoy.
entries.game_text: You wanted a theory. Now you've got a face to hang it on. Don't gloat at the envoy.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Still standing. Still useful. Copy the chit before the ink flakes.
entries.game_text: Still standing. Still useful. Copy the chit before the ink flakes.

entries.text: [coldly] [sternly] Write it clean. The watch will keep signing drowning until I stop letting them.
entries.game_text: Write it clean. The watch will keep signing drowning until I stop letting them.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] The signature was always going to bring you back. [short pause] I merely wrote out the appointment you'd earned.
entries.game_text: The signature was always going to bring you back. I merely wrote out the appointment you'd earned.

entries.text: [warmly] [amused] The clerk can run until dawn for all I care. [short pause] You, on the other hand, have an appointment that is not on any ledger.
entries.game_text: The clerk can run until dawn for all I care. You, on the other hand, have an appointment that is not on any ledger.

entries.text: [amused] [warmly] The watch files what I sign. [short pause] And tonight I am signing nothing except your attendance.
entries.game_text: The watch files what I sign. And tonight I am signing nothing except your attendance.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Meet me on Teardrop Island. [short pause] There is an inn on the north side, tucked between two geisha houses. Wear your best.
entries.game_text: Meet me on Teardrop Island. There is an inn on the north side, tucked between two geisha houses. Wear your best.

entries.text: [warmly] [teasing] Read the rest once you have remembered how to breathe.
entries.game_text: Read the rest once you have remembered how to breathe.

entries.text: [amused] [warmly] You will have your reason when you arrive, and arrive hungry. [short pause] Keep up, To-chan.
entries.game_text: You will have your reason when you arrive, and arrive hungry. Keep up, To-chan.

entries.text: [teasing] [amused] Good evening, Toa-san. The journey here was not too difficult, I hope?
entries.game_text: Good evening, Toa-san. The journey here was not too difficult, I hope?

entries.text: [firmly] [warmly] The menu has already been decided for you.
entries.game_text: The menu has already been decided for you.

entries.text: [gently] [warmly] I wanted to show you some appreciation. [short pause] For all the work you have done for me.
entries.game_text: I wanted to show you some appreciation. For all the work you have done for me.

entries.text: [warmly] [calm] I have arranged for more music, and dancers, [short pause] should that suit your desires.
entries.game_text: I have arranged for more music, and dancers, should that suit your desires.

entries.text: [calm] Finally. A witness note I can eat without crossing out your adjectives.
entries.game_text: Finally. A witness note I can eat without crossing out your adjectives.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] I call it payment for bolt-room competence. [short pause] Do not let the quarter file poetry about us before the dessert is even cleared.
entries.game_text: I call it payment for bolt-room competence. Do not let the quarter file poetry about us before the dessert is even cleared.

entries.text: [deadpan] [chuckles] If I ever find any dance crimes I know who I need to bring with me.
entries.game_text: If I ever find any dance crimes I know who I need to bring with me.

entries.text: [warmly] [gently] Relax. Enjoy the dance. [short pause] Unless the watching is the fun of it. What could they be doing better?
entries.game_text: Relax. Enjoy the dance. Unless the watching is the fun of it. What could they be doing better?

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [calm] Much as a magistrate reads deceit.
entries.game_text: Much as a magistrate reads deceit.

entries.text: [amused] [warmly] Well, then. [short pause] It seems I have learned something new tonight.
entries.game_text: Well, then. It seems I have learned something new tonight.

entries.text: [teasing] [calm] And you do realize these observations of yours are not limited to dance?
entries.game_text: And you do realize these observations of yours are not limited to dance?

entries.text: [calm] I know. I file what your body says louder than your mouth.
entries.game_text: I know. I file what your body says louder than your mouth.

entries.text: [calm] Now tell me who has been saying these things. I insist. Gossip is inventory I did not authorize.
entries.game_text: Now tell me who has been saying these things. I insist. Gossip is inventory I did not authorize.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Doji Sango-san? Have the two of us even spoken?
entries.game_text: Doji Sango-san? Have the two of us even spoken?

entries.text: [amused] [teasing] If it is only two names, then I clearly need to work on my image.
entries.game_text: If it is only two names, then I clearly need to work on my image.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] And what else has this Doji Sango-san been saying?
entries.game_text: And what else has this Doji Sango-san been saying?

entries.text: [amused] [teasing] Oh. [short pause] Now I am very interested.
entries.game_text: Oh. Now I am very interested.

entries.text: [mockingly] [amused] I would never do such a thing. [short pause] That would be admitting defeat.
entries.game_text: I would never do such a thing. That would be admitting defeat.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] No. Do not change a thing. If servants carry it, [short pause] she might as well have watchers.
entries.game_text: No. Do not change a thing. If servants carry it, she might as well have watchers.

entries.text: [coldly] [matter-of-fact] I said the city speaks well of my witness. [short pause] Do not go inflating the file.
entries.game_text: I said the city speaks well of my witness. Do not go inflating the file.

entries.text: [amused] [deadpan] A date is a line in a permit book.
entries.game_text: A date is a line in a permit book.

entries.text: [coldly] [matter-of-fact] This is appreciation. For witness competence. [short pause] And food, so you do not faint on my desk tomorrow.
entries.game_text: This is appreciation. For witness competence. And food, so you do not faint on my desk tomorrow.

entries.text: [calm] It is the answer the quarter deserves. You are patronage on paper, the woman who trusted me in the bolt room. Do not borrow festival vocabulary because the sake was expensive and your obi is too honest.
entries.game_text: It is the answer the quarter deserves. You are patronage on paper, the woman who trusted me in the bolt room. Do not borrow festival vocabulary because the sake was expensive and your obi is too honest.

entries.text: [coldly] [firmly] Feel whatever you like in private. [short pause] In public, you are mine to position.
entries.game_text: Feel whatever you like in private. In public, you are mine to position.

entries.text: [pause] [exhales] ...No.
[calm] It is the closest I come to calling this courtship, before I learn better.
entries.game_text: It is the closest I come to calling this courtship, before I learn better.

entries.text: [calm] Forget the second sentence. The first one stands. Feel the rest in private.
entries.game_text: Forget the second sentence. The first one stands. Feel the rest in private.

entries.text: [softly] [gently] ...It is the closest I come, before I learn better.
entries.game_text: ...It is the closest I come, before I learn better.

entries.text: [coldly] [firmly] Forget I said the second sentence. [short pause] The first one stands.
entries.game_text: Forget I said the second sentence. The first one stands.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [calm] Tea. Then bed. [short pause] The dock tomorrow will not smell of lanterns.
entries.game_text: Tea. Then bed. The dock tomorrow will not smell of lanterns.

entries.text: [calm] And, To-chan. Do not sulk in the witness log. Sulk in private where I can inventory it. I permit you that much.
entries.game_text: And, To-chan. Do not sulk in the witness log. Sulk in private where I can inventory it. I permit you that much.

entries.text: [amused] [teasing] Good. Wear a cloak. Leave the ledger. [short pause] If the watch asks, you are inventory I chose not to file yet.
entries.game_text: Good. Wear a cloak. Leave the ledger. If the watch asks, you are inventory I chose not to file yet.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Permits are just paper. Boats are honest. With me, To-chan.
entries.game_text: Permits are just paper. Boats are honest. With me, To-chan.

entries.text: [angry] [dramatic] Can just ONE thing go right tonight?!
entries.game_text: Can just ONE thing go right tonight?!

entries.text: [deadpan] [resigned] Bad day for you too, then?
entries.game_text: Bad day for you too, then?

entries.text: [gently] [softly] I'm fine, To-chan. [short pause] Just cold.
entries.game_text: I'm fine, To-chan. Just cold.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] There's no other way to reach Teardrop Island. [short pause] Obviously.
entries.game_text: There's no other way to reach Teardrop Island. Obviously.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Stand there gawking or come warm me. [short pause] It has been a bad day, To-chan, and you are the only fire on this pier.
entries.game_text: Stand there gawking or come warm me. It has been a bad day, To-chan, and you are the only fire on this pier.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Crane spine, even on a frozen pier. Brave. Foolish. Mine either way.
entries.game_text: Crane spine, even on a frozen pier. Brave. Foolish. Mine either way.

entries.text: [seductive] [warmly] I asked with the boat and the bay. [short pause] And you are still here, aren't you.
entries.game_text: I asked with the boat and the bay. And you are still here, aren't you.

entries.text: [teasing] [seductive] Almost enough. [short pause] But not quite.
entries.game_text: Almost enough. But not quite.

entries.text: [calm] You are on top today. I am too cold to manage you, and you have feelings to work through besides. Get to it. File them on my hull.
entries.game_text: You are on top today. I am too cold to manage you, and you have feelings to work through besides. Get to it. File them on my hull.

entries.text: [amused] [warmly] Hm? Oh. I suppose that is true. [short pause] Were you really looking for someone like me, though?
entries.game_text: Hm? Oh. I suppose that is true. Were you really looking for someone like me, though?

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] I keep wondering what I did to deserve the one witness who lets a man like me bully her toward the warm side of the boat.
entries.game_text: I keep wondering what I did to deserve the one witness who lets a man like me bully her toward the warm side of the boat.

entries.text: [teasing] [amused] Toa-san? Next time I will have you again behind my screen, in a proper bath, where the bay cannot watch. [short pause] The marina was never the place for it.
entries.game_text: Toa-san? Next time I will have you again behind my screen, in a proper bath, where the bay cannot watch. The marina was never the place for it.

entries.text: [teasing] [amused] Case Five will not wait just because you bruised your knees on my kobune.
entries.game_text: Case Five will not wait just because you bruised your knees on my kobune.

entries.text: [teasing] [warmly] And To-chan, do your sulking in private if you must. [short pause] The marina saw quite enough of us tonight.
entries.game_text: And To-chan, do your sulking in private if you must. The marina saw quite enough of us tonight.

entries.text: [coldly] [cruelly] You will knock on my screen again, the night your hunger finally outvotes your pride. [short pause] Tonight, though, I collect what you owed me back at the canal.
entries.game_text: You will knock on my screen again, the night your hunger finally outvotes your pride. Tonight, though, I collect what you owed me back at the canal.

entries.text: [dismissive] [calm] There. Now you're low enough to hear terms.
entries.game_text: There. Now you're low enough to hear terms.

entries.text: [cruelly] [mockingly] A witness without obedience is just gossip in a clean kosode. [short pause] Learn the difference faster.
entries.game_text: A witness without obedience is just gossip in a clean kosode. Learn the difference faster.

entries.text: [coldly] [cruelly] You carried my seal's work into Scorpion water and walked back through that gate proud of it. [short pause] Pride does not survive this room. It bends.
entries.game_text: You carried my seal's work into Scorpion water and walked back through that gate proud of it. Pride does not survive this room. It bends.

entries.text: [coldly] [menacingly] You pushed me twice at the waterline and once inside my own hall. [short pause] I gave you the warnings. I do not give them a fourth time.
entries.game_text: You pushed me twice at the waterline and once inside my own hall. I gave you the warnings. I do not give them a fourth time.

entries.text: [warmly] [matter-of-fact] You are one line on my evening's ledger until I say otherwise. Desk. Now.
entries.game_text: You are one line on my evening's ledger until I say otherwise. Desk. Now.

entries.text: [coldly] [cruelly] You wanted theater out on the canal. This office is not a stage, To-chan. [short pause] It is a desk, a seal, and the consequences of everything you said in front of witnesses.
entries.game_text: You wanted theater out on the canal. This office is not a stage, To-chan. It is a desk, a seal, and the consequences of everything you said in front of witnesses.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] You'll knock again when hunger wins. Tonight I collect what you owed at the chair.
entries.game_text: You'll knock again when hunger wins. Tonight I collect what you owed at the chair.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You bow when the floor meets your knees — bend at the waist, courtesy bow. Less talk.
entries.game_text: You bow when the floor meets your knees. Less talk.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Companion escort, temporary. I know what I'm paying for tonight.
entries.game_text: Companion escort, temporary. I know what I'm paying for tonight.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Watch me stamp something that isn't your renewal.
entries.game_text: Watch me stamp something that isn't your renewal.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Permit book without ink is just paper. You are still line item on my evening.
entries.game_text: Permit book without ink is just paper. You are still line item on my evening.

entries.text: [dismissive] [calm] The watch files what I sign. You ran from my desk with wet ink on your sleeve.
entries.game_text: The watch files what I sign. You ran from my desk with wet ink on your sleeve.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Wrong door was amusing once. I'm not amused anymore.
entries.game_text: Wrong door was amusing once. I'm not amused anymore.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] You carried my permit book out. That makes you my errand until I cancel it.
entries.game_text: You carried my permit book out. That makes you my errand until I cancel it.

entries.text: [dismissive] [calm] Desk. Now. The latch stays down until I say otherwise.
entries.game_text: Desk. Now. The latch stays down until I say otherwise.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] My escort list ends at my threshold. You're still on the docket.
entries.game_text: My escort list ends at my threshold. You're still on the docket.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] I said the city has other dancers. I did not release you from my hall.
entries.game_text: I said the city has other dancers. I did not release you from my hall.

entries.text: [dismissive] [calm] To-chan. My corridor. My hanko. You have neither.
entries.game_text: To-chan. My corridor. My hanko. You have neither.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [deadpan] Case Two. The Academy was expecting a credential packet for one Kakita Toa. Charter renewal, examination waiver, [short pause] all the paperwork you people dress up as mercy.
entries.game_text: Case Two. The Academy was expecting a credential packet for one Kakita Toa. Charter renewal, examination waiver, all the paperwork you people dress up as mercy.

entries.text: [coldly] [matter-of-fact] They found the courier in a warehouse alley. Throat opened, satchel burned to nothing. [short pause] The watch is calling it robbery. The ash is telling me it was a message.
entries.game_text: They found the courier in a warehouse alley. Throat opened, satchel burned to nothing. The watch is calling it robbery. The ash is telling me it was a message.

entries.text: [firmly] [teasing] You're not running off to beg Crane clerks by letter. You'll find what burned, [short pause] or you'll pack for that road I warned you about.
entries.game_text: You're not running off to beg Crane clerks by letter. You'll find what burned, or you'll pack for that road I warned you about.

entries.text: [dismissive] [amused] Your permit survived Case One. Case Two decides whether the Academy ever bothers to say your name again.
entries.game_text: Your permit survived Case One. Case Two decides whether the Academy ever bothers to say your name again.

entries.text: [warmly] [calm] Methodical. So the Academy taught you something useful after all.
entries.game_text: Methodical. So the Academy taught you something useful after all.

entries.text: [calm] [matter-of-fact] Make a list. The jealous, the indebted, the Scorpion leftovers. [short pause] Case One left us enemies with ash still on their cuffs.
entries.game_text: Make a list. The jealous, the indebted, the Scorpion leftovers. Case One left us enemies with ash still on their cuffs.

entries.text: [sternly] [firmly] Discipline. Rare in you. [short pause] Fetch the outer-desk file and meet me at the kiln.
entries.game_text: Discipline. Rare in you. Fetch the outer-desk file and meet me at the kiln.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Or walked off paid. Charms don't come cheap this far from a shrine.
entries.game_text: Or walked off paid. Charms don't come cheap this far from a shrine.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Grey to bury the clan colors, again. It seems Case One's little flower isn't finished with us yet.
entries.game_text: Grey to bury the clan colors, again. It seems Case One's little flower isn't finished with us yet.

entries.text: [sternly] [firmly] Toa. Wait...
entries.game_text: Toa. Wait...

entries.text: [coldly] [matter-of-fact] That margin's a clerk's hand. Office ink, not warehouse soot. [short pause] Someone inside my own compound touched the routing before Tsubaki ever set out.
entries.game_text: That margin's a clerk's hand. Office ink, not warehouse soot. Someone inside my own compound touched the routing before Tsubaki ever set out.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Factor. Scorpion. Ash. Fill the gaps between those three, or the kiln does the talking for you.
entries.game_text: Factor. Scorpion. Ash. Fill the gaps between those three, or the kiln does the talking for you.

entries.text: [amused] [calm] Patient. Vicious, in the right direction. [short pause] I'll watch the desk myself tonight.
entries.game_text: Patient. Vicious, in the right direction. I'll watch the desk myself tonight.

entries.text: [warmly] [amused] You're learning. The clerk's sweating precisely because you didn't shout. [short pause] Quiet frightens him more.
entries.game_text: You're learning. The clerk's sweating precisely because you didn't shout. Quiet frightens him more.

entries.text: [sternly] [coldly] Wise. The clerk talks to me alone. [short pause] You'll stand there and learn exactly what betrayal in an office sounds like.
entries.game_text: Wise. The clerk talks to me alone. You'll stand there and learn exactly what betrayal in an office sounds like.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] The Academy gets proof you're still alive, still employed, and still a nuisance. [short pause] That buys you the season.
entries.game_text: The Academy gets proof you're still alive, still employed, and still a nuisance. That buys you the season.

entries.text: [coldly] [dismissive] You burned a clerk's cover in the open. Effective. [short pause] Expensive, too. The office will chew on it for weeks.
entries.game_text: You burned a clerk's cover in the open. Effective. Expensive, too. The office will chew on it for weeks.

entries.text: [amused] [teasing] Your decoy snared a rat. And the rat leads us straight back to the Chrysanthemum's ledger. [short pause] Case One's flower isn't done blooming.
entries.game_text: Your decoy snared a rat. And the rat leads us straight back to the Chrysanthemum's ledger. Case One's flower isn't done blooming.

entries.text: [warmly] [calm] Tonight, you sleep. [short pause] Tomorrow Case Three arrives whether we invite it or not.
entries.game_text: Tonight, you sleep. Tomorrow Case Three arrives whether we invite it or not.

entries.text: [teasing] [warmly] The outer clerk can guard ash until dawn. [short pause] You're coming to the hill festival with me. Call it a field inspection of morale.
entries.game_text: The outer clerk can guard ash until dawn. You're coming to the hill festival with me. Call it a field inspection of morale.

entries.text: [amused] [matter-of-fact] The watch files whatever I sign. Tonight I'm signing nothing but your attendance. [short pause] Bring an appetite. The curry stall by the lower bridge owes me a debt.
entries.game_text: The watch files whatever I sign. Tonight I'm signing nothing but your attendance. Bring an appetite. The curry stall by the lower bridge owes me a debt.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Correct. Now walk with me, To-chan. The lanterns will not wait.
entries.game_text: Correct. Now walk with me, To-chan. The lanterns will not wait.

entries.text: [calm] [warmly] Sit. The hill is mine, by tax map and by habit both. [short pause] No clerk will come petitioning you up here.
entries.game_text: Sit. The hill is mine, by tax map and by habit both. No clerk will come petitioning you up here.

entries.text: [calm] [bitterly] Kind is what merchants sell when the ledger stays honest for a single night. [short pause] Enjoy the lie. It's cheaper than virtue.
entries.game_text: Kind is what merchants sell when the ledger stays honest for a single night. Enjoy the lie. It's cheaper than virtue.

entries.text: [warmly] [amused] One night. I know how carefully you count.
entries.game_text: One night. I know how carefully you count.

entries.text: [seductive] [softly] Let them have the sky. [short pause] I'm watching you remember you're still alive after all that ash.
entries.game_text: Let them have the sky. I'm watching you remember you're still alive after all that ash.

entries.text: [dismissive] [deadpan] Enough. Don't go filing that under promises.
entries.game_text: Enough. Don't go filing that under promises.

entries.text: [coldly] [bitterly] A festival kiss is paper confetti. Pretty, public, worthless by the morning docket. [short pause] Don't read my mouth like it's a charter.
entries.game_text: A festival kiss is paper confetti. Pretty, public, worthless by the morning docket. Don't read my mouth like it's a charter.

entries.text: [sternly] [firmly] Good. Then we go down before the watch invents a rumor worth selling.
entries.game_text: Good. Then we go down before the watch invents a rumor worth selling.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Walk. Curry before curfew. [short pause] Case Three won't wait just because you blushed on a bench.
entries.game_text: Walk. Curry before curfew. Case Three won't wait just because you blushed on a bench.

entries.text: [seductive] [firmly] Then choose a door I already hold. [short pause] Guest room on the way down. One screen, one lock, my corridor.
entries.game_text: Then choose a door I already hold. Guest room on the way down. One screen, one lock, my corridor.

entries.text: [flirtatious] [amused] A dangerous request, from my companion. [short pause] I'll allow it until the wax cools.
entries.game_text: A dangerous request, from my companion. I'll allow it until the wax cools.

entries.text: [warmly] [matter-of-fact] Don't thank me with poetry. [short pause] Feed yourself before Case Three drags you back to witness notes.
entries.game_text: Don't thank me with poetry. Feed yourself before Case Three drags you back to witness notes.

entries.text: [calm] [dismissive] The city pretends every single night. [short pause] I remember what I pay for.
entries.game_text: The city pretends every single night. I remember what I pay for.

entries.text: [calm] [firmly] Sleep while you can. The next file won't smell of fireworks.
entries.game_text: Sleep while you can. The next file won't smell of fireworks.

entries.text: [firmly] [coldly] It won't wait. Neither will I. [short pause] When it knocks, you answer it beside me.
entries.game_text: It won't wait. Neither will I. When it knocks, you answer it beside me.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Case Three. That Chrysanthemum factor from Case One did not drown with his barge after all. [short pause] His cousin sells kimono behind a borrowed Crane name, and the bolt counts never quite agree with the tax lines.
entries.game_text: Case Three. That Chrysanthemum factor from Case One did not drown with his barge after all. His cousin sells kimono behind a borrowed Crane name, and the bolt counts never quite agree with the tax lines.

entries.text: [coldly] [sternly] Civilized is how this city hides its knives. You wanted a witness note that outlives the clerks who file it. [short pause] Earn it in the bolt room, or lose it on my desk.
entries.game_text: Civilized is how this city hides its knives. You wanted a witness note that outlives the clerks who file it. Earn it in the bolt room, or lose it on my desk.

entries.text: [warmly] [firmly] You sleep on the other side of my office wall now. So today you walk the shop at my side. [short pause] Not ahead of me, not alone.
entries.game_text: You sleep on the other side of my office wall now. So today you walk the shop at my side. Not ahead of me, not alone.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] The tea cooled yesterday. The file did not.
entries.game_text: The tea cooled yesterday. The file did not.

entries.text: [coldly] [sarcastic] Your permit survived Case Two. Case Three decides whether a single soul in the Academy still believes your name means anything.
entries.game_text: Your permit survived Case Two. Case Three decides whether a single soul in the Academy still believes your name means anything.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Numbers before names. [short pause] The Academy did teach you something after all. Bring me a line I can paste straight into the file without crossing out half your adjectives.
entries.game_text: Numbers before names. The Academy did teach you something after all. Bring me a line I can paste straight into the file without crossing out half your adjectives.

entries.text: [sternly] [matter-of-fact] Discipline. Good. [short pause] Ask him who profits when a bolt room happens to collapse on a Crane witness.
entries.game_text: Discipline. Good. Ask him who profits when a bolt room happens to collapse on a Crane witness.

entries.text: [coldly] [dismissive] Then do not braid poetry on my desk to match. [short pause] Tag it, bag it, witness it.
entries.game_text: Then do not braid poetry on my desk to match. Tag it, bag it, witness it.

entries.text: [sternly] [firmly] Magistrate's custody. Open the bolt room. [short pause] No one lays a finger on the top shelf until my witness has signed the count.
entries.game_text: Magistrate's custody. Open the bolt room. No one lays a finger on the top shelf until my witness has signed the count.

entries.text: [coldly] [matter-of-fact] Because someone wanted the inventory to come down the moment the right person stood beneath it. Ask your questions. [short pause] I will be at the street door. Close enough to hear you scream, far enough that the clerks still think you are alone.
entries.game_text: Because someone wanted the inventory to come down the moment the right person stood beneath it. Ask your questions. I will be at the street door. Close enough to hear you scream, far enough that the clerks still think you are alone.

entries.text: [warmly] [matter-of-fact] I am handing you a clerk who will talk to a dancer and lie to a magistrate. [short pause] Use that.
entries.game_text: I am handing you a clerk who will talk to a dancer and lie to a magistrate. Use that.

entries.text: [sternly] [firmly] Up. Now. [short pause] Before that clerk invents a story where you died clumsy.
entries.game_text: Up. Now. Before that clerk invents a story where you died clumsy.

entries.text: [coldly] [dismissive] A draft, from the alley. Nerves. Stand.
entries.game_text: A draft, from the alley. Nerves. Stand.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] If that shelf had taken you, there would be no bolt room left. [short pause] No quarter. Nothing but the canal and my apology to it.
entries.game_text: If that shelf had taken you, there would be no bolt room left. No quarter. Nothing but the canal and my apology to it.

entries.text: [coldly] [dismissive] Forget I said that. Witness note: shelf sabotage, clerk detained. [short pause] You are breathing. That is the only romance this file requires.
entries.game_text: Forget I said that. Witness note: shelf sabotage, clerk detained. You are breathing. That is the only romance this file requires.

entries.text: [amused] [coldly] Good. Devotion stays on paper until I say otherwise.
entries.game_text: Good. Devotion stays on paper until I say otherwise.

entries.text: [coldly] [matter-of-fact] Case Three is not closed. It is pinned. [short pause] Like the bolt that almost killed my witness.
entries.game_text: Case Three is not closed. It is pinned. Like the bolt that almost killed my witness.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [firmly] The mistagged lot ties straight back to Case One's flower. Good. [short pause] Paste that line into the file before some Scorpion lawyer buys the clerk's silence.
entries.game_text: The mistagged lot ties straight back to Case One's flower. Good. Paste that line into the file before some Scorpion lawyer buys the clerk's silence.

entries.text: [coldly] [dismissive] I was at the mat, not the door. Do not make poetry of it. [short pause] Case Four will knock soon enough, the moment the rain comes back.
entries.game_text: I was at the mat, not the door. Do not make poetry of it. Case Four will knock soon enough, the moment the rain comes back.

entries.text: [coldly] [firmly] Case Four is where the paper trail runs out and the steel begins. We raid the lower dock tonight. [short pause] Bring me Kurogane, or bring me his blood.
entries.game_text: Case Four is where the paper trail runs out and the steel begins. We raid the lower dock tonight. Bring me Kurogane, or bring me his blood.

entries.text: [deadpan] [sternly] Tonight you are both. Stay in my line, [short pause] or the file learns that you didn't.
entries.game_text: Tonight you are both. Stay in my line, or the file learns that you didn't.

entries.text: [calm] [matter-of-fact] Case Four. Kurogane runs the split crates our clerk ran toward. He learned his trade under a Scorpion quartermaster, [short pause] so he will not surrender to a brush and ink.
entries.game_text: Case Four. Kurogane runs the split crates our clerk ran toward. He learned his trade under a Scorpion quartermaster, so he will not surrender to a brush and ink.

entries.text: [firmly] [coldly] Steel. You dance with a blade when I tell you to dance. [short pause] You do not duel a foreman on your own.
entries.game_text: Steel. You dance with a blade when I tell you to dance. You do not duel a foreman on your own.

entries.text: [warmly] [teasing] You learned how to breathe in my bolt room. [short pause] Tonight you breathe in my line, or the ledger learns that you couldn't.
entries.game_text: You learned how to breathe in my bolt room. Tonight you breathe in my line, or the ledger learns that you couldn't.

entries.text: [amused] [matter-of-fact] Correct. You are a witness with a wakizashi. [short pause] Walk like you know the difference.
entries.game_text: Correct. You are a witness with a wakizashi. Walk like you know the difference.

entries.text: [coldly] [firmly] Note that down before the steel starts talking.
entries.game_text: Note that down before the steel starts talking.

entries.text: [calm] [coldly] Good. Say his name again when his blade clears the sheath.
entries.game_text: Good. Say his name again when his blade clears the sheath.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Discipline, with the steel this close. I will take it.
entries.game_text: Discipline, with the steel this close. I will take it.

entries.text: [sternly] [coldly] Kurogane! Emerald custody. [short pause] Lower your blade, or lower your head.
entries.game_text: Kurogane! Emerald custody. Lower your blade, or lower your head.

entries.text: [sternly] [coldly] [case4_suspect_name]! Emerald custody. [short pause] Lower your blade, or lower your head.
entries.game_text: [case4_suspect_name]! Emerald custody. Lower your blade, or lower your head.

entries.text: [sternly] [firmly] Toa! Hold the line!
entries.game_text: Toa! Hold the line!

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Breathe. [short pause] Count to three. That deflection was clean. The Academy would not believe me if I filed it honestly.
entries.game_text: Breathe. Count to three. That deflection was clean. The Academy would not believe me if I filed it honestly.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] If you had died on my dock, I would have burned this whole pier down to the canal. [short pause] I am not going to pretend I did not say it this time.
entries.game_text: If you had died on my dock, I would have burned this whole pier down to the canal. I am not going to pretend I did not say it this time.

entries.text: [coldly] [dismissive] Forget I said it. Witness note: foreman detained, ledger seized. [short pause] You are still breathing, and that is the only romance the file requires tonight.
entries.game_text: Forget I said it. Witness note: foreman detained, ledger seized. You are still breathing, and that is the only romance the file requires tonight.

entries.text: [deadpan] [calm] Case Four is pinned, not closed. [short pause] The flower still has its roots.
entries.game_text: Case Four is pinned, not closed. The flower still has its roots.

entries.text: [warmly] [amused] You stayed in my line when the steel wanted you alone. [short pause] Do not expect applause. Expect a pleasure-quarter seal stolen by morning.
entries.game_text: You stayed in my line when the steel wanted you alone. Do not expect applause. Expect a pleasure-quarter seal stolen by morning.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] I find you less tiresome than the rest of my docket. [short pause] Enough that I have decided to keep you within reach. Do not make me phrase it more plainly than that.
entries.game_text: I find you less tiresome than the rest of my docket. Enough that I have decided to keep you within reach. Do not make me phrase it more plainly than that.

entries.text: [dismissive] [calm] You ask for my desk in front of a drowning clerk and a Miya witness. Stupid, To-chan. Mine.
entries.game_text: You ask for my desk in front of a drowning clerk and a Miya witness. Stupid, To-chan. Mine.

entries.text: [dismissive] [calm] Office. My corridor. We're not finished when you decide we're finished.
entries.game_text: Office. My corridor. We're not finished when you decide we're finished.

entries.text: [whispers] [calm] You asked for closed screens twice in one night. You will have them.
entries.game_text: You asked for closed screens twice in one night. You will have them.

entries.text: [dismissive] [calm] Desk. Now. Before you mistake appetite for permission again.
entries.game_text: Desk. Now. Before you mistake appetite for permission again.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Empty witness note. Blank collar line. You do not get another hour.
entries.game_text: Empty witness note. Blank collar line. You do not get another hour.

entries.text: [dismissive] [calm] Desk. You will learn what my hall costs when you arrive with nothing to sign.
entries.game_text: Desk. You will learn what my hall costs when you arrive with nothing to sign.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Five matters on my slate this season. [short pause] Companion ink puts you on my witness docket for all of it, Case One through Five. Survive all five, or the quarter eats your stipend.
entries.game_text: Five matters on my slate this season. Companion ink puts you on my witness docket for all of it, Case One through Five. Survive all five, or the quarter eats your stipend.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Dance bought you the corridor. [short pause] Cases buy your keep. Show me competence I can reach for. Archive stairs, the Case One ledger, before the watch blanks that name line.
entries.game_text: Dance bought you the corridor. Cases buy your keep. Show me competence I can reach for. Archive stairs, the Case One ledger, before the watch blanks that name line.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Patronage keeps you in my corridor. [short pause] Case One opens on my desk, first of five you'll witness before the season turns.
entries.game_text: Patronage keeps you in my corridor. Case One opens on my desk, first of five you'll witness before the season turns.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Correction: five matters on my slate this season. [short pause] Witness attachment only. Case One through Five. No companion seal on this timeline.
entries.game_text: Correction: five matters on my slate this season. Witness attachment only. Case One through Five. No companion seal on this timeline.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Seasons are what I assign. [short pause] Fetch Case One from the archive. Survive the season, and then we'll discuss whether you sleep in my hall.
entries.game_text: Seasons are what I assign. Fetch Case One from the archive. Survive the season, and then we'll discuss whether you sleep in my hall.

entries.text: [dismissive] [calm] Still insolent. Desk. Case One first — the other four will find you if you don't flee to curry shops.
entries.game_text: Still insolent. Desk. Case One first — the other four will find you if you don't flee to curry shops.

entries.text: [amused] [dismissive] You wanted the hall. Case One opens first — four more if you don't bore me or flee to curry shops.
entries.game_text: You wanted the hall. Case One opens first — four more if you don't bore me or flee to curry shops.

entries.text: Witness is a word for paper that has not earned ink yet. Case Five opens at the hour of the serpent. Dress for court, not for my corridor.
entries.game_text: Witness is a word for paper that has not earned ink yet. Case Five opens at the hour of the serpent. Dress for court, not for my corridor.

entries.text: We are talking about them. In a room that can hear you.
entries.game_text: We are talking about them. In a room that can hear you.

entries.text: Leave the adjoining chamber key at the gate. Today you are witness. The hall does not care what you called last night.
entries.game_text: Leave the adjoining chamber key at the gate. Today you are witness. The hall does not care what you called last night.

entries.text: Good. That pleasure-quarter seal on the summons is bait for clerks who think Case Five is only Chrysanthemum politics. It is not. Stay in my line.
entries.game_text: Good. That pleasure-quarter seal on the summons is bait for clerks who think Case Five is only Chrysanthemum politics. It is not. Stay in my line.

entries.text: Case One, you read a lie under pressure at the Lacquered Plum and you did not run when the comb turned out to be Scorpion.
entries.game_text: Case One, you read a lie under pressure at the Lacquered Plum and you did not run when the comb turned out to be Scorpion.

entries.text: Case Two, you stood on the hill where the city could see you beside my file, and you did not hide behind Crane honor when kiln ash choked the alley.
entries.game_text: Case Two, you stood on the hill where the city could see you beside my file, and you did not hide behind Crane honor when kiln ash choked the alley.

entries.text: Case Three, you trusted the bolt room when the room tried to kill you. You let me pull you out instead of proving the Academy right on splinters.
entries.game_text: Case Three, you trusted the bolt room when the room tried to kill you. You let me pull you out instead of proving the Academy right on splinters.

entries.text: Case Four, you stayed behind my shoulder when steel wanted you alone. You did not compose poetry on my dock.
entries.game_text: Case Four, you stayed behind my shoulder when steel wanted you alone. You did not compose poetry on my dock.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] I said provisional attachment until the files close. [short pause] They were real cases, and they did not close themselves, To-chan. I was not testing you. Each one added a link to the witness chain the hall will swear to today.
entries.game_text: I said provisional attachment until the files close. They were real cases, and they did not close themselves, To-chan. I was not testing you. Each one added a link to the witness chain the hall will swear to today.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] I meant a left hand. [short pause] The city needs a name on it. I could not offer it behind my screen, or the quarter would call it a kept woman's wages. You had to be seen choosing the desk over the road. Forgive the cold morning. I chose your name before you knew what the job was called.
entries.game_text: I meant a left hand. The city needs a name on it. I could not offer it behind my screen, or the quarter would call it a kept woman's wages. You had to be seen choosing the desk over the road. Forgive the cold morning. I chose your name before you knew what the job was called.

entries.text: Kitsu Kaoru, Emerald Magistrate. Case Five: witness chains for the Chrysanthemum root, and appointment of sworn yoriki for the ongoing docket.
entries.game_text: Kitsu Kaoru, Emerald Magistrate. Case Five: witness chains for the Chrysanthemum root, and appointment of sworn yoriki for the ongoing docket.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Witness is not enough in this city. [short pause] You signed my corridor, my cushion, my release. Let the quarter whisper kept woman. The file will say office.
entries.game_text: Witness is not enough in this city. You signed my corridor, my cushion, my release. Let the quarter whisper kept woman. The file will say office.

entries.text: Kakita Toa. Appointment as yoriki to the Emerald office of Ryoko Owari. Witness chains, quarter escort, left-hand signature on my docket.
entries.game_text: Kakita Toa. Appointment as yoriki to the Emerald office of Ryoko Owari. Witness chains, quarter escort, left-hand signature on my docket.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You have already served this desk. [short pause] You slept behind my screen. You argued well every time I needed a sharp mind within reach.
entries.game_text: You have already served this desk. You slept behind my screen. You argued well every time I needed a sharp mind within reach.

entries.text: This is office. I am not asking for poetry. I need a name the city can cite when the seal walks.
entries.game_text: This is office. I am not asking for poetry. I need a name the city can cite when the seal walks.

entries.text: You passed every case I put in front of you. Do not make me say it twice in front of clerks who sell courage by the cup.
entries.game_text: You passed every case I put in front of you. Do not make me say it twice in front of clerks who sell courage by the cup.

entries.text: [calm] Speak without the docket listening. One sentence you never filed, and one debt you still owe my desk.
entries.game_text: Speak without the docket listening. One sentence you never filed, and one debt you still owe my desk.

entries.text: I know.
entries.game_text: I know.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Most people try to rename me. [short pause] You let me keep you, and still walked back to my corridor on your own feet.
entries.game_text: Most people try to rename me. You let me keep you, and still walked back to my corridor on your own feet.

entries.text: [calm] Then stand. The oath is public. The rest is mine to file when you stop stammering like a petitioner.
entries.game_text: Then stand. The oath is public. The rest is mine to file when you stop stammering like a petitioner.

entries.text: [calm] Still mine. That is the only title that matters behind my screen tonight.
entries.game_text: Still mine. That is the only title that matters behind my screen tonight.

entries.text: File the witness chain before noon. The Chrysanthemum root still has tendrils in the pleasure quarter.
entries.game_text: File the witness chain before noon. The Chrysanthemum root still has tendrils in the pleasure quarter.

entries.text: Good. Case Five is pinned, not closed. The city still lies.
entries.game_text: Good. Case Five is pinned, not closed. The city still lies.

entries.text: You served the docket. The city has your testimony. Do not expect my corridor to keep a room warm on gratitude alone.
entries.game_text: You served the docket. The city has your testimony. Do not expect my corridor to keep a room warm on gratitude alone.

entries.text: [warmly] [matter-of-fact] Good. [short pause] Case Five sleeps on my desk until someone earns the left hand. The Chrysanthemum root keeps its tendrils in the quarter, the way the big files always do.
entries.game_text: Good. Case Five sleeps on my desk until someone earns the left hand. The Chrysanthemum root keeps its tendrils in the quarter, the way the big files always do.

entries.text: You refused the name. The city will still want one on my left hand. It will not be yours.
entries.game_text: You refused the name. The city will still want one on my left hand. It will not be yours.

entries.text: Clerks sell courage by the cup. You sell me indignation by the segment.
entries.game_text: Clerks sell courage by the cup. You sell me indignation by the segment.

entries.text: Almost is the only concession this office allows before sunset.
entries.game_text: Almost is the only concession this office allows before sunset.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Eat your mikan. [short pause] Drip on the yoriki sash and I will make you copy the stain into the record twice. I still take what I am owed.
entries.game_text: Eat your mikan. Drip on the yoriki sash and I will make you copy the stain into the record twice. I still take what I am owed.

entries.text: [calm] Just this room is still mine to share when the city is not listening. Do not make me say it twice.
entries.game_text: Just this room is still mine to share when the city is not listening. Do not make me say it twice.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Then I will not forge your hand onto a docket you refuse to stand on. [short pause] An oath taken under pressure is just another counterfeit seal, and I have hanged men for those.
entries.game_text: Then I will not forge your hand onto a docket you refuse to stand on. An oath taken under pressure is just another counterfeit seal, and I have hanged men for those.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Your permit stands, dated and honest. [short pause] The stipend closes with the case. The adjoining chamber empties tonight. Dance in any quarter that will have you, and none of them will owe me a thing.
entries.game_text: Your permit stands, dated and honest. The stipend closes with the case. The adjoining chamber empties tonight. Dance in any quarter that will have you, and none of them will owe me a thing.

entries.text: [cold] [deadpan] Scroll ink dries at the dais. You are not at the dais anymore.
entries.game_text: Scroll ink dries at the dais. You are not at the dais anymore.

entries.text: [cold] [proprietary] Temporary escort. Left hand filled. Her name stays off my appointment scroll.
entries.game_text: Temporary escort. Left hand filled. Her name stays off my appointment scroll.

entries.text: [cold] [deadpan] Fine. The hall keeps what the scroll would have claimed. Holding cell. Ink. Witnesses who learn not to hear.
entries.game_text: Fine. The hall keeps what the scroll would have claimed. Holding cell. Ink. Witnesses who learn not to hear.

entries.text: [cold] [bureaucratic] You are a Crane dancer who embarrassed my docket in open court. The file will say corrective custody.
entries.game_text: You are a Crane dancer who embarrassed my docket in open court. The file will say corrective custody.

entries.text: [cold] [commanding] Thumb here. Or I file you as flight risk and let the runners collect.
entries.game_text: Thumb here. Or I file you as flight risk and let the runners collect.

entries.text: [cold] [proprietary] The quarter keeps what I sell. You keep what you refused to price.
entries.game_text: The quarter keeps what I sell. You keep what you refused to price.

entries.text: [cold] [bureaucratic] Corrective custody closes at dawn. What happens before dawn is hall business.
entries.game_text: Corrective custody closes at dawn. What happens before dawn is hall business.

entries.text: [calm] Counting is witness work. Stop filing ceiling beams and sleep.
entries.game_text: Counting is witness work. Stop filing ceiling beams and sleep.

entries.text: [calm] I did not ask for a chambermate either, and yet here you are. Drink before it goes cold. I am not thanking you for tea I did not request.
entries.game_text: I did not ask for a chambermate either, and yet here you are. Drink before it goes cold. I am not thanking you for tea I did not request.

entries.text: [calm] Thank you would admit I wanted the company. I wanted a body in my corridor who could read a ledger without fainting. Different line item.
entries.game_text: Thank you would admit I wanted the company. I wanted a body in my corridor who could read a ledger without fainting. Different line item.

entries.text: [calm] The corridor is still mine. The blanket is only a loan against your noise. Snore, and I reassign you to the archive.
