entries.game_text: The corridor is still mine. The blanket is only a loan against your noise. Snore, and I reassign you to the archive.

entries.text: [calm] Good night, To-chan. Case One starts at dawn. Be vertical. Scheduling, not romance.
entries.game_text: Good night, To-chan. Case One starts at dawn. Be vertical. Scheduling, not romance.

entries.text: [amused] [deadpan] The kitchen is not a courtroom, To-chan. [short pause] Neither is the lid of that pot.
entries.game_text: The kitchen is not a courtroom, To-chan. Neither is the lid of that pot.

entries.text: [calm] Official lentils are still lentils. Put my chop on paper, not on my dinner. I am not signing your gratitude into the pot lid.
entries.game_text: Official lentils are still lentils. Put my chop on paper, not on my dinner. I am not signing your gratitude into the pot lid.

entries.text: [satisfied] [calm] Edible. [short pause] More than I can say for the Academy letters out on the desk. Case Two has been waiting there since this morning.
entries.game_text: Edible. More than I can say for the Academy letters out on the desk. Case Two has been waiting there since this morning.

entries.text: [calm] I ate the proof that you follow instructions when you are not stamping dinner. Do not expect a second serving or a softer inventory.
entries.game_text: I ate the proof that you follow instructions when you are not stamping dinner. Do not expect a second serving or a softer inventory.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] And you are still in my corridor. [short pause] That is filing enough for one afternoon. Try not to walk like a woman carrying a secret she forgot to seal.
entries.game_text: And you are still in my corridor. That is filing enough for one afternoon. Try not to walk like a woman carrying a secret she forgot to seal.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Do not perform stillness at me, To-chan. [short pause] I have read quieter ledgers than the one your body is keeping tonight.
entries.game_text: Do not perform stillness at me, To-chan. I have read quieter ledgers than the one your body is keeping tonight.

entries.text: [commanding] [quiet] The archive sleeps. You do not. [short pause] Hands on the post. Do not leave a mark I cannot explain.
entries.game_text: The archive sleeps. You do not. Hands on the post. Do not leave a mark I cannot explain.

entries.text: [rough] [low] Quiet. Take what I give you from behind the screen and do not drip on my tatami. [short pause] I know what I am paying for.
entries.game_text: Quiet. Take what I give you from behind the screen and do not drip on my tatami. I know what I am paying for.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Tea is witness work when someone wants a favor. File the cup. I did not ask.
entries.game_text: Tea is witness work when someone wants a favor. File the cup. I did not ask.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] You may leave the second if it saves you a walk. I still will not drink gratitude.
entries.game_text: You may leave the second if it saves you a walk. I still will not drink gratitude.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Three mornings, three cups, zero admissions. When the dancer arrives with tea she will learn the same arithmetic.
entries.game_text: Three mornings, three cups, zero admissions. When the dancer arrives with tea she will learn the same arithmetic.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] When the archive boy brought mikan peel on a tray. Denied.
entries.game_text: When the archive boy brought mikan peel on a tray. Denied.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] When Witness ████ cried thank-you on the stairs and bowed too low. Denied.
entries.game_text: When Witness ████ cried thank-you on the stairs and bowed too low. Denied.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] When the puppet villain on the canal road got the children to clap. Denied.
entries.game_text: When the puppet villain on the canal road got the children to clap. Denied.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] When the rain stopped for six breaths and the office went quiet enough to pretend this city was kind. Denied.
entries.game_text: When the rain stopped for six breaths and the office went quiet enough to pretend this city was kind. Denied.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Paper first. Mouth later. If later ever comes.
entries.game_text: Paper first. Mouth later. If later ever comes.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Watching is free. Smiling is a debt I have not agreed to owe.
entries.game_text: Watching is free. Smiling is a debt I have not agreed to owe.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Next stair. Do not wait for praise.
entries.game_text: Next stair. Do not wait for praise.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Wrong motive. He killed for debt schedule, not passion. Ledger line due on the fifteenth. Wife already sold the comb.
entries.game_text: Wrong motive. He killed for debt schedule, not passion. Ledger line due on the fifteenth. Wife already sold the comb.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Puppeteer, your villain emotes well and files poorly. Fear is cheaper than love in this quarter. Write that on your crate.
entries.game_text: Puppeteer, your villain emotes well and files poorly. Fear is cheaper than love in this quarter. Write that on your crate.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Dancers make the same mistake. Pretty feet, wrong reason. I will know the difference when one knocks.
entries.game_text: Dancers make the same mistake. Pretty feet, wrong reason. I will know the difference when one knocks.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Street theater is not my docket unless it blocks my corridor.
entries.game_text: Street theater is not my docket unless it blocks my corridor.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Citation keeps the puppeteer honest and the children moving. File it.
entries.game_text: Citation keeps the puppeteer honest and the children moving. File it.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Wrong quarter to be visible without my seal.
entries.game_text: Wrong quarter to be visible without my seal.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] I could open the watch door. I could write you a corridor pass until dawn.
entries.game_text: I could open the watch door. I could write you a corridor pass until dawn.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Instead I will close the other door.
entries.game_text: Instead I will close the other door.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Witness spendable when the quarter pays better. Patronage is appetite with a stamp. I know what I am buying.
entries.game_text: Witness spendable when the quarter pays better. Patronage is appetite with a stamp. I know what I am buying.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Case Zero closes. Next petition lands when some Crane gets lost in my hall.
entries.game_text: Case Zero closes. Next petition lands when some Crane gets lost in my hall.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Renewal season. Wrong door season. I will drink none of the tea and take all of the witness.
entries.game_text: Renewal season. Wrong door season. I will drink none of the tea and take all of the witness.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Almost-smile stays denied. The corridor stays mine.
entries.game_text: Almost-smile stays denied. The corridor stays mine.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Corridor's awake. Renewal season.
entries.game_text: Corridor's awake. Renewal season.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] She will knock wrong first. They always do.
entries.game_text: She will knock wrong first. They always do.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Come back when you learn my corridor. You will.
entries.game_text: Come back when you learn my corridor. You will.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Gratitude in liquid form is still a bid. I do not accept bids before breakfast.
entries.game_text: Gratitude in liquid form is still a bid. I do not accept bids before breakfast.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] If you want to please me, bring dry copies and leave the sugar on someone else's tray.
entries.game_text: If you want to please me, bring dry copies and leave the sugar on someone else's tray.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Mikan comes later. Peel on a tray. Domestic filing. I will deny that too until the quarter stops selling what I intend to keep.
entries.game_text: Mikan comes later. Peel on a tray. Domestic filing. I will deny that too until the quarter stops selling what I intend to keep.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] When the night clerk laughed at my stamp and called me handsome in a voice that wanted a corridor pass. Denied.
entries.game_text: When the night clerk laughed at my stamp and called me handsome in a voice that wanted a corridor pass. Denied.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] When the okami's runner bowed with coin already counted and called me merciful. [short pause] Denied. Merciful is a word witnesses use before they learn the price.
entries.game_text: When the okami's runner bowed with coin already counted and called me merciful. Denied. Merciful is a word witnesses use before they learn the price.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] When I thought of a kotatsu and wool and citrus and a mouth that might ask me to almost smile on purpose. Denied twice. Denied in advance.
entries.game_text: When I thought of a kotatsu and wool and citrus and a mouth that might ask me to almost smile on purpose. Denied twice. Denied in advance.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] If you linger I will deduct a coin for theater.
entries.game_text: If you linger I will deduct a coin for theater.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Run.
entries.game_text: Run.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Sponsorship is not kindness. It is a calendar and a corridor and a body I intend to read like a docket.
entries.game_text: Sponsorship is not kindness. It is a calendar and a corridor and a body I intend to read like a docket.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] When the renewal petition comes I will not be the villain in purple. I will be the stamp. That is scarier and more honest.
entries.game_text: When the renewal petition comes I will not be the villain in purple. I will be the stamp. That is scarier and more honest.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] You wanted my corridor. This is what my corridor costs when I do not lend it.
entries.game_text: You wanted my corridor. This is what my corridor costs when I do not lend it.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] I could have opened the watch door. I chose the fee line. Do not call that romance. Call it jurisdiction.
entries.game_text: I could have opened the watch door. I chose the fee line. Do not call that romance. Call it jurisdiction.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Companion means my corridor, my hanko, my release. I wrote that line before she existed. I intend to fill the blank.
entries.game_text: Companion means my corridor, my hanko, my release. I wrote that line before she existed. I intend to fill the blank.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Come back when you learn my corridor. You will.
entries.game_text: Come back when you learn my corridor. You will.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Before I read it aloud, one question. [short pause] Plainly. When your permit was dying, you danced for me in this room. The quarter forgets dancers who vanish after sunset. I don't.
entries.game_text: Before I read it aloud, one question. Plainly. When your permit was dying, you danced for me in this room. The quarter forgets dancers who vanish after sunset. I don't.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] No. Witnesses lie. [short pause] You had a body worth housing and a voice worth putting on a filing.
entries.game_text: No. Witnesses lie. You had a body worth housing and a voice worth putting on a filing.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Attendance. Discretion. Art that doesn't embarrass the seal on my door.
entries.game_text: Attendance. Discretion. Art that doesn't embarrass the seal on my door.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Later. First you hear what I'm willing to pay for.
entries.game_text: Later. First you hear what I'm willing to pay for.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Brave. The cost is written right here. Listen.
entries.game_text: Brave. The cost is written right here. Listen.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] This is sponsorship, not a courtesan's contract. [short pause] The ledger reads art donor to artist. I will not insult your lord or mine by playing danna to a Crane who crossed provinces for ink.
entries.game_text: This is sponsorship, not a courtesan's contract. The ledger reads art donor to artist. I will not insult your lord or mine by playing danna to a Crane who crossed provinces for ink.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Coin for your art, openly given. [short pause] I know exactly what I am paying for, and so do you. 'Patronage' is the courtesy the ledger requires. Interpret it as liberally as you like, so long as you do it under my roof.
entries.game_text: Coin for your art, openly given. I know exactly what I am paying for, and so do you. 'Patronage' is the courtesy the ledger requires. Interpret it as liberally as you like, so long as you do it under my roof.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Twice a week you attend me here. [short pause] For performance, and for case work when I need a witness who doesn't flinch. The rest is written below.
entries.game_text: Twice a week you attend me here. For performance, and for case work when I need a witness who doesn't flinch. The rest is written below.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Seal on the desk, comb in plain cloth. Crude, but the Plum opens for whatever it can see.
entries.game_text: Seal on the desk, comb in plain cloth. Crude, but the Plum opens for whatever it can see.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Your past, turned into a bargaining chip. [short pause] I dislike how useful it keeps being.
entries.game_text: Your past, turned into a bargaining chip. I dislike how useful it keeps being.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Go in soft. I'll follow once the room is warm. Don't enjoy it more than the case.
entries.game_text: Go in soft. I'll follow once the room is warm. Don't enjoy it more than the case.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Finally. [short pause] Stand where I point. Breathe when I allow it. The Plum mistakes quiet witnesses for furniture, so use that.
entries.game_text: Finally. Stand where I point. Breathe when I allow it. The Plum mistakes quiet witnesses for furniture, so use that.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] A manifest worth a man's throat. Twice over.
entries.game_text: A manifest worth a man's throat. Twice over.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] She'll talk while she's frightened. Ask now, before the okami buys her courage back.
entries.game_text: She'll talk while she's frightened. Ask now, before the okami buys her courage back.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You said it aloud, against my instruction and your own safety both. [short pause] The Crane envoy won't laugh now. Neither will the Scorpion.
entries.game_text: You said it aloud, against my instruction and your own safety both. The Crane envoy won't laugh now. Neither will the Scorpion.

entries.text: [coldly] [sternly] Reckless. Effective. You've put the forgery on the okami's ledger, where no drowning can erase it.
entries.game_text: Reckless. Effective. You've put the forgery on the okami's ledger, where no drowning can erase it.

entries.text: [warmly] [matter-of-fact] Patience over theater. The Chrysanthemum keeps his appointment, and we keep the advantage. Good.
entries.game_text: Patience over theater. The Chrysanthemum keeps his appointment, and we keep the advantage. Good.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You're learning the shape of safety at my side. [short pause] The factor sees it too. Watch him reconsider the door.
entries.game_text: You're learning the shape of safety at my side. The factor sees it too. Watch him reconsider the door.

entries.text: [warmly] [matter-of-fact] Wise. [short pause] In this quarter, the only seal worth standing behind is the one that frightens factors. Behind me. Now.
entries.game_text: Wise. In this quarter, the only seal worth standing behind is the one that frightens factors. Behind me. Now.

entries.text: [warmly] [matter-of-fact] Theft as a craft. I approve, provided you steal the right ledger page.
entries.game_text: Theft as a craft. I approve, provided you steal the right ledger page.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Toa. [short pause] That deck is full of the flower's men, and his hand has already strangled one clerk this season. Step onto it alone and you are the next name the canal swallows. Do not.
entries.game_text: Toa. That deck is full of the flower's men, and his hand has already strangled one clerk this season. Step onto it alone and you are the next name the canal swallows. Do not.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] The okami won't open her registry for a watchman. [short pause] She might open it for a magistrate. Give her no reason to lie faster than she already means to.
entries.game_text: The okami won't open her registry for a watchman. She might open it for a magistrate. Give her no reason to lie faster than she already means to.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You walk a half step behind me, and you speak only when I open the door. [short pause] The quarter swallows companions who forget who lights the lanterns.
entries.game_text: You walk a half step behind me, and you speak only when I open the door. The quarter swallows companions who forget who lights the lanterns.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] In the Plum, the muzzle and the escort are the same thing. Stay where I can see you.
entries.game_text: In the Plum, the muzzle and the escort are the same thing. Stay where I can see you.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Flatter the okami like that and she'll tip her whole ledger into your lap.
entries.game_text: Flatter the okami like that and she'll tip her whole ledger into your lap.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You're not my hand yet. In the Plum you're a witness I tolerate. Try tolerating me back.
entries.game_text: You're not my hand yet. In the Plum you're a witness I tolerate. Try tolerating me back.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] It counts as a hunt. Now decide how we knock.
entries.game_text: It counts as a hunt. Now decide how we knock.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Or never wanted one. The Plum prefers guests unwatched by anything that reports upward.
entries.game_text: Or never wanted one. The Plum prefers guests unwatched by anything that reports upward.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] And yet you kept Miya Jiro. [short pause] He clerked your registry until the canal kept him instead. I want the book he wrote in.
entries.game_text: And yet you kept Miya Jiro. He clerked your registry until the canal kept him instead. I want the book he wrote in.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Respectable houses survive by knowing which silences cost more than others. [short pause] This silence will cost you the Plum itself. Choose.
entries.game_text: Respectable houses survive by knowing which silences cost more than others. This silence will cost you the Plum itself. Choose.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Afraid of what?
entries.game_text: Afraid of what?

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] A flower alias, foreign silver, frightened clerks. [short pause] Suzu's mouth next, before the okami buys her silence back.
entries.game_text: A flower alias, foreign silver, frightened clerks. Suzu's mouth next, before the okami buys her silence back.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] She's a frightened girl with one true thing left in her mouth. [short pause] Get it out before her courage spends itself. How?
entries.game_text: She's a frightened girl with one true thing left in her mouth. Get it out before her courage spends itself. How?

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Sixteen petals. [short pause] The forger did not merely counterfeit my office, he reached past it. Sixteen petals is the Emperor's own chrysanthemum. Whoever cut this seal dressed a smuggling cover in the Imperial mon, which makes it treason, and used it to lock a room where a Crane clerk was strangled inside my jurisdiction.
entries.game_text: Sixteen petals. The forger did not merely counterfeit my office, he reached past it. Sixteen petals is the Emperor's own chrysanthemum. Whoever cut this seal dressed a smuggling cover in the Imperial mon, which makes it treason, and used it to lock a room where a Crane clerk was strangled inside my jurisdiction.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] It is my office's mark. It is not my seal. [short pause] I authorized no writ for this house all season.
entries.game_text: It is my office's mark. It is not my seal. I authorized no writ for this house all season.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Which leaves me a forgery, or a thief inside the magistracy. Neither one is a comfort.
entries.game_text: Which leaves me a forgery, or a thief inside the magistracy. Neither one is a comfort.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] I am the privilege in this city. [short pause] Take one step toward that registry, and the watch fishes a second body out of the noble quarter by dawn.
entries.game_text: I am the privilege in this city. Take one step toward that registry, and the watch fishes a second body out of the noble quarter by dawn.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You came for a book and found a magistrate instead. [short pause] Tell the Chrysanthemum the Emerald office is missing a seal, and that I've decided to take an interest in flowers.
entries.game_text: You came for a book and found a magistrate instead. Tell the Chrysanthemum the Emerald office is missing a seal, and that I've decided to take an interest in flowers.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] And a seal cut to wear my mark, sealing the very room he died in. [short pause] Someone wants this murder to carry the Emerald crest.
entries.game_text: And a seal cut to wear my mark, sealing the very room he died in. Someone wants this murder to carry the Emerald crest.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You spoke against me twice tonight, and twice you were right. [short pause] I dislike how much that pleases me. Don't mistake the pleasure for permission.
entries.game_text: You spoke against me twice tonight, and twice you were right. I dislike how much that pleases me. Don't mistake the pleasure for permission.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Stubborn. [short pause] Keep it. I'll need something that doesn't bend when this seal turns out to belong to a man I dine with.
entries.game_text: Stubborn. Keep it. I'll need something that doesn't bend when this seal turns out to belong to a man I dine with.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You stood behind me all night and let the quarter break itself against my stillness. [short pause] That is exactly what a companion of mine is for.
entries.game_text: You stood behind me all night and let the quarter break itself against my stillness. That is exactly what a companion of mine is for.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You did. Obedient and observant both. I'm beginning to think I kept the right dancer.
entries.game_text: You did. Obedient and observant both. I'm beginning to think I kept the right dancer.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Someone tried to hang a murder on my seal. [short pause] Until I know who, you don't leave this compound without me. Not for the curry shops. Not for Academy letters. Nowhere.
entries.game_text: Someone tried to hang a murder on my seal. Until I know who, you don't leave this compound without me. Not for the curry shops. Not for Academy letters. Nowhere.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Escort means my corridor, my hanko, my release. Tonight you don't leave without all three.
entries.game_text: Escort means my corridor, my hanko, my release. Tonight you don't leave without all three.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You're still not sleeping in my hall. [short pause] But you spoke for the Empire in a Scorpion house tonight, and the wax never once cracked. I'm noting it.
entries.game_text: You're still not sleeping in my hall. But you spoke for the Empire in a Scorpion house tonight, and the wax never once cracked. I'm noting it.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Survive the Chrysanthemum first. [short pause] Forgers who cut my seal don't tend to leave their witnesses cheerful.
entries.game_text: Survive the Chrysanthemum first. Forgers who cut my seal don't tend to leave their witnesses cheerful.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] The Scorpion shipping rolls list one barge on the next high tide, booked to the same chartered concern as the river room. [short pause] The flower will be aboard, or his manifest will. Either way, we meet the tide.
entries.game_text: The Scorpion shipping rolls list one barge on the next high tide, booked to the same chartered concern as the river room. The flower will be aboard, or his manifest will. Either way, we meet the tide.

entries.text: [coldly] [sternly] Chartered concern, false cargo, a flower name on the ledger. [short pause] Tonight we seize the manifest before the tide signs off on another drowning.
entries.game_text: Chartered concern, false cargo, a flower name on the ledger. Tonight we seize the manifest before the tide signs off on another drowning.

entries.text: [coldly] [sternly] Stay inside my shadow on the plank. [short pause] One misstep, and the watch writes up two drownings and calls it efficiency.
entries.game_text: Stay inside my shadow on the plank. One misstep, and the watch writes up two drownings and calls it efficiency.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You turned a forgery into theater. Now go and finish the play.
entries.game_text: You turned a forgery into theater. Now go and finish the play.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You wanted a case. This is the part where the city bites back. Try to keep up.
entries.game_text: You wanted a case. This is the part where the city bites back. Try to keep up.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] A falsified cargo tally. Hold onto that page.
entries.game_text: A falsified cargo tally. Hold onto that page.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Open the hold. The Emerald office is auditing chartered lies tonight.
entries.game_text: Open the hold. The Emerald office is auditing chartered lies tonight.

entries.text: [coldly] [sternly] You. The man who threatened my witness. Step into the light.
entries.game_text: You. The man who threatened my witness. Step into the light.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] I have enough to hang your chartered concern and every clerk who ever signed for it. [short pause] Run to your flower. The tide won't hide you twice.
entries.game_text: I have enough to hang your chartered concern and every clerk who ever signed for it. Run to your flower. The tide won't hide you twice.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] The Chrysanthemum is still a cipher. [short pause] The factor's concern is not. I'll burn his charter before the week is out.
entries.game_text: The Chrysanthemum is still a cipher. The factor's concern is not. I'll burn his charter before the week is out.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Academy letters sat on the outer desk all night. [short pause] Case Two arrived with the dawn, and it isn't a polite one.
entries.game_text: Academy letters sat on the outer desk all night. Case Two arrived with the dawn, and it isn't a polite one.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Your permit survives because you survived the tide. [short pause] Case Two is already on the desk. Try not to expect any gratitude.
entries.game_text: Your permit survives because you survived the tide. Case Two is already on the desk. Try not to expect any gratitude.

entries.text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Wrong conference room. Again.
entries.game_text: Wrong conference room. Again.

entries.text: [coldly] You opened the door to the Office of Arts and Licensing without reading the plate. Intake is the other wing, where applicants wait their turn. This wing is where I decide whether intake wasted its morning. Reading the wrong door is a skill, not an excuse.
entries.game_text: You opened the door to the Office of Arts and Licensing without reading the plate. Intake is the other wing, where applicants wait their turn. This wing is where I decide whether intake wasted its morning. Reading the wrong door is a skill, not an excuse.

entries.text: [dry] Still there? Knock if you want something other than a live Council hearing to fail on the public record.
entries.game_text: Still there? Knock if you want something other than a live Council hearing to fail on the public record.

entries.text: [dry] Crane Conservatory transfer packet. [short pause] Expired six weeks ago. You walked into my live hearing like a pop-up ad.
entries.game_text: Crane Conservatory transfer packet. Expired six weeks ago. You walked into my live hearing like a pop-up ad.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] Ryoko Port has a queue. [short pause] You are in it now, whether you intended to be or not.
entries.game_text: Ryoko Port has a queue. You are in it now, whether you intended to be or not.

entries.text: [firmly] You already are. Sit. Witness posture. Not performance posture. [short pause] I will audit both.
entries.game_text: You already are. Sit. Witness posture. Not performance posture. I will audit both.

entries.text: [calm] Applicant present for sponsorship review. [short pause] Packet error is mine to remediate. Continue your agenda item.
entries.game_text: Applicant present for sponsorship review. Packet error is mine to remediate. Continue your agenda item.

entries.text: [firmly] I want proof you can follow choreography that is not flirting with clerks. Run the phrase.
entries.game_text: I want proof you can follow choreography that is not flirting with clerks. Run the phrase.

entries.text: [firmly] Again. Less apology in the port de bras.
entries.game_text: Again. Less apology in the port de bras.

entries.text: [deadpan] Counting is witness work. Stop expecting applause from a licensing officer. I will say one thing for the record and deny it under oath later. You stopped apologizing on the second pass. That is discipline, not charm. Discipline is the one thing in this building I respect without a form ordering me to.
entries.game_text: Counting is witness work. Stop expecting applause from a licensing officer. I will say one thing for the record and deny it under oath later. You stopped apologizing on the second pass. That is discipline, not charm. Discipline is the one thing in this building I respect without a form ordering me to.

entries.text: [dry] Two riders on the sponsorship draft I am prepared to sign. Pick one before I file you under *disruptive applicant* and let the queue keep you.
entries.game_text: Two riders on the sponsorship draft I am prepared to sign. Pick one before I file you under *disruptive applicant* and let the queue keep you.

entries.text: [deadpan] Correct. Boring is enforceable. I can work with boring. She initials the witness clause and files the rest under professional distance. The sponsorship will clear. The inspections will still find her.
entries.game_text: Correct. Boring is enforceable. I can work with boring. She initials the witness clause and files the rest under professional distance. The sponsorship will clear. The inspections will still find her.

entries.text: [calm] You understand that clause includes my calendar, not romance on letterhead. Hear the word I used. *Not.* On letterhead would mean I filed us. Your name beside mine, a relationship of record, a thing the Council can open and read and rule on. The rider is the opposite of that. Calendar, clause, after-hours access. We keep the real word out of every box a clerk could subpoena, and we call the keeping-out a rider.
entries.game_text: You understand that clause includes my calendar, not romance on letterhead. Hear the word I used. *Not.* On letterhead would mean I filed us. Your name beside mine, a relationship of record, a thing the Council can open and read and rule on. The rider is the opposite of that. Calendar, clause, after-hours access. We keep the real word out of every box a clerk could subpoena, and we call the keeping-out a rider.

entries.text: [quietly] Unless?
entries.game_text: Unless?

entries.text: [quietly] [firmly] The contract floor is closed. This floor is not on your calendar. Get in.
entries.game_text: The contract floor is closed. This floor is not on your calendar. Get in.

entries.text: [quietly] Quiet. You wanted exclusive rehearsal. I audit deliverables.
entries.game_text: Quiet. You wanted exclusive rehearsal. I audit deliverables.

entries.text: [dry] The break room is not a courtroom. Neither is the lid of that pot.
entries.game_text: The break room is not a courtroom. Neither is the lid of that pot.

entries.text: [deadpan] Official lentils are still lentils. Put my chop on paper, not on your paper plate.
entries.game_text: Official lentils are still lentils. Put my chop on paper, not on your paper plate.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] Three business days effective. Do not perform gratitude on municipal letterhead.
entries.game_text: Three business days effective. Do not perform gratitude on municipal letterhead.

entries.text: [dry] See that you don't. The queue remembers applicants who treat stamps like confetti.
entries.game_text: See that you don't. The queue remembers applicants who treat stamps like confetti.

entries.text: [deadpan] Blanket is a loan against your noise. Snore, and I reassign you to the public waiting area.
entries.game_text: Blanket is a loan against your noise. Snore, and I reassign you to the public waiting area.

entries.text: [calm] Peel one. Domestic filing. [short pause] I will deny that too until the port stops selling what I intend to keep.
entries.game_text: Peel one. Domestic filing. I will deny that too until the port stops selling what I intend to keep.

entries.text: [warmly] Motion denied. Good night, To-chan.
entries.game_text: Motion denied. Good night, To-chan.

entries.text: [dry] Floor fourteen B is still the wrong door tomorrow. Try reading the plate first.
entries.game_text: Floor fourteen B is still the wrong door tomorrow. Try reading the plate first.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] Their operating license promises posted occupancy, working fire exits, and honest books. My inspection confirms it, or my office pulls the license. The witness log needs a sponsor artist on it. That is you.
entries.game_text: Their operating license promises posted occupancy, working fire exits, and honest books. My inspection confirms it, or my office pulls the license. The witness log needs a sponsor artist on it. That is you.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] Surprise inspection. No appointment. If they scrub the lobby, we note the scrub.
entries.game_text: Surprise inspection. No appointment. If they scrub the lobby, we note the scrub.

entries.text: [dry] You film what I tell you is exhibit-worthy. Flirt with the lens on your own time.
entries.game_text: You film what I tell you is exhibit-worthy. Flirt with the lens on your own time.

entries.text: [dry] Operating entity on file: Scorpion-grey Holdings LLC. [short pause] Cute. File that under *names that audition for subpoenas*.
entries.game_text: Operating entity on file: Scorpion-grey Holdings LLC. Cute. File that under *names that audition for subpoenas*.

entries.text: [deadpan] It is a line item. Grey LLCs love grey corridors. We walk them anyway.
entries.game_text: It is a line item. Grey LLCs love grey corridors. We walk them anyway.

entries.text: [firmly] Witness protocol. Choose how you document before I choose for you.
entries.game_text: Witness protocol. Choose how you document before I choose for you.

entries.text: [warmly] Good. Bureaucracy loves clocks. So do I, when they save me a hearing.
entries.game_text: Good. Bureaucracy loves clocks. So do I, when they save me a hearing.

entries.text: [deadpan] Also acceptable. Do not typo my name. I will notice.
entries.game_text: Also acceptable. Do not typo my name. I will notice.

entries.text: [dry] Form 14-C requires posted capacity. Count the candles as people and I will cite you for poetry.
entries.game_text: Form 14-C requires posted capacity. Count the candles as people and I will cite you for poetry.

entries.text: [teasing] Write *diffuser exceeds serenity*. That is flirtation via footnote, To-chan, and I allow it once.
entries.game_text: Write *diffuser exceeds serenity*. That is flirtation via footnote, To-chan, and I allow it once.

entries.text: [teasing] It is scheduling. [short pause] You respond faster when I use the nickname inventory.
entries.game_text: It is scheduling. You respond faster when I use the nickname inventory.

entries.text: [sternly] You are interrupting a Council inspection of a license this office issued and this office can revoke. Step aside, or join the exhibit list.
entries.game_text: You are interrupting a Council inspection of a license this office issued and this office can revoke. Step aside, or join the exhibit list.

entries.text: [firmly] She said patience. I said compliance. Both are true. Move.
entries.game_text: She said patience. I said compliance. Both are true. Move.

entries.text: [dry] You wanted firm. He learned firm. Log the timestamp.
entries.game_text: You wanted firm. He learned firm. Log the timestamp.

entries.text: [calm] Shaking is human. Falsifying is not. Continue.
entries.game_text: Shaking is human. Falsifying is not. Continue.

entries.text: [deadpan] You passed witness work. That is not a compliment. It is a classification.
entries.game_text: You passed witness work. That is not a compliment. It is a classification.

entries.text: [dry] There is a harbor weekend on the calendar, logged as an audit retreat. Continued witness work: your clause, my signature, the Council's letterhead. Ferry slips Saturday. One bed in the Airbnb filing is a clerical error I will not fix unless you ask in writing.
entries.game_text: There is a harbor weekend on the calendar, logged as an audit retreat. Continued witness work: your clause, my signature, the Council's letterhead. Ferry slips Saturday. One bed in the Airbnb filing is a clerical error I will not fix unless you ask in writing.

entries.text: [dry] It sounds like a calendar invite. Accept on the municipal portal or argue with the tide.
entries.game_text: It sounds like a calendar invite. Accept on the municipal portal or argue with the tide.

entries.text: [quietly] Unless the harbor?
entries.game_text: Unless the harbor?

entries.text: [deadpan] Correct. File that under rider compliance.
entries.game_text: Correct. File that under rider compliance.

entries.text: [dry] You owe the island punctuality. The ferry owes us a revised ETA. Those are different dockets.
entries.game_text: You owe the island punctuality. The ferry owes us a revised ETA. Those are different dockets.

entries.text: [dry] Patience is a line item. Stand where I can see you and the manifest.
entries.game_text: Patience is a line item. Stand where I can see you and the manifest.

entries.text: [dry] It mentions one queen bed, one sofa, and a clerical error I will not fix unless you ask in writing.
entries.game_text: It mentions one queen bed, one sofa, and a clerical error I will not fix unless you ask in writing.

entries.text: [deadpan] It is a filing. [short pause] You sleep. I review calendar conflicts. We do not perform couple on the listing photos.
entries.game_text: It is a filing. You sleep. I review calendar conflicts. We do not perform couple on the listing photos.

entries.text: [teasing] If you answer *yes*, I will add a footnote: *applicant confuses calendar with courtship*. If you answer *no*, tell the truth in dates and names only.
entries.game_text: If you answer *yes*, I will add a footnote: *applicant confuses calendar with courtship*. If you answer *no*, tell the truth in dates and names only.

entries.text: [warmly] Good. Now choose how we file the weekend before the island files us.
entries.game_text: Good. Now choose how we file the weekend before the island files us.

entries.text: [teasing] Acceptable. I will deny almost-smile inventory until Monday.
entries.game_text: Acceptable. I will deny almost-smile inventory until Monday.

entries.text: [calm] You understand that clause is calendar and audit, not romance on letterhead.
entries.game_text: You understand that clause is calendar and audit, not romance on letterhead.

entries.text: [deadpan] Lights out at eleven. Snore above acceptable noise and I reassign you to the ferry bench.
entries.game_text: Lights out at eleven. Snore above acceptable noise and I reassign you to the ferry bench.

entries.text: [dry] Motion granted. Bring your tablet. Leave performance posture in the closet.
entries.game_text: Motion granted. Bring your tablet. Leave performance posture in the closet.

entries.text: [quietly] Then audit quietly. The harbor still has ears.
entries.game_text: Then audit quietly. The harbor still has ears.

entries.text: [quietly] Deliverable one. You hold still when I count.
entries.game_text: Deliverable one. You hold still when I count.

entries.text: [quietly] Deliverable two. You do not perform gratitude on rental linens.
entries.game_text: Deliverable two. You do not perform gratitude on rental linens.

entries.text: [calm] File it under exclusive rider. Monday calendar owns the rest.
entries.game_text: File it under exclusive rider. Monday calendar owns the rest.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] Calendar audit. Ferry back at six. HR block on Tuesday. Answer in dates, not poetry.
entries.game_text: Calendar audit. Ferry back at six. HR block on Tuesday. Answer in dates, not poetry.

entries.text: [calm] It sounds like signatory pressure. [short pause] You are listed dependent on the sponsorship I signed. I am the signatory of record. If that clip convinces the Council I favor you, People and Conduct opens a conflict-of-interest file, and the apparatus decides what to do with the pair of us. None of that is romance on letterhead.
entries.game_text: It sounds like signatory pressure. You are listed dependent on the sponsorship I signed. I am the signatory of record. If that clip convinces the Council I favor you, People and Conduct opens a conflict-of-interest file, and the apparatus decides what to do with the pair of us. None of that is romance on letterhead.

entries.text: [deadpan] Pack at five. If you post *is this a date* with my badge in frame, I will revoke your witness clause.
entries.game_text: Pack at five. If you post *is this a date* with my badge in frame, I will revoke your witness clause.

entries.text: [firmly] My applicant is seated where I placed her. If the agenda cannot tolerate a witness, revise the agenda.
entries.game_text: My applicant is seated where I placed her. If the agenda cannot tolerate a witness, revise the agenda.

entries.text: [dry] Trending is not a docket. [short pause] Sit where I can see you and the inbox. People and Conduct, the office the Council refers conflicts to, opened a file at eight this morning, before the coffee was enforceable.
entries.game_text: Trending is not a docket. Sit where I can see you and the inbox. People and Conduct, the office the Council refers conflicts to, opened a file at eight this morning, before the coffee was enforceable.

entries.text: [calm] You have a current packet now. [short pause] That is the problem the clip just made expensive. I signed it. You depend on it. A camera turned both facts into a story we did not write.
entries.game_text: You have a current packet now. That is the problem the clip just made expensive. I signed it. You depend on it. A camera turned both facts into a story we did not write.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] Folder one: signatory of record, Kitsu Kaoru. Folder two: sponsorship dependent applicant, Kakita Toa. The clip put both folders in the same frame. HR would like the frame explained.
entries.game_text: Folder one: signatory of record, Kitsu Kaoru. Folder two: sponsorship dependent applicant, Kakita Toa. The clip put both folders in the same frame. HR would like the frame explained.

entries.text: [dry] The concern is conflict of interest. Stated plainly: a deputy who signs for an applicant he is rumored to favor. Rumor is not a finding. But rumor schedules meetings, and we are in one.
entries.game_text: The concern is conflict of interest. Stated plainly: a deputy who signs for an applicant he is rumored to favor. Rumor is not a finding. But rumor schedules meetings, and we are in one.

entries.text: [calm] Before the liaison files, we decide the public posture. [short pause] Choose, applicant. The clip is loud. Our answer should be quieter, but it still has to be an answer.
entries.game_text: Before the liaison files, we decide the public posture. Choose, applicant. The clip is loud. Our answer should be quieter, but it still has to be an answer.

entries.text: [firmly] Owning the narrative is a real strategy. [short pause] It is also a microphone. If you take the microphone, you do not improvise. Dates and names only, even in a caption.
entries.game_text: Owning the narrative is a real strategy. It is also a microphone. If you take the microphone, you do not improvise. Dates and names only, even in a caption.

entries.text: [calm] Silence is also a filing. [short pause] Harder to misquote, slower to clear. You will sit in the comments for a week and not answer them. Some applicants cannot. Can you?
entries.game_text: Silence is also a filing. Harder to misquote, slower to clear. You will sit in the comments for a week and not answer them. Some applicants cannot. Can you?

entries.text: [calm] Signatory of record means I answer for your compliance. Sponsorship dependent means your right to work in this port routes through my signature. That is leverage. I do not enjoy being someone's leverage, including my own.
entries.game_text: Signatory of record means I answer for your compliance. Sponsorship dependent means your right to work in this port routes through my signature. That is leverage. I do not enjoy being someone's leverage, including my own.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] Either way the public narrative now exists in parallel with my actual calendar. Those two ledgers do not match, and HR audits the gap, not the gossip.
entries.game_text: Either way the public narrative now exists in parallel with my actual calendar. Those two ledgers do not match, and HR audits the gap, not the gossip.

entries.text: [calm] The harbor weekend is in the calendar as audit. [short pause] The internet would call it something else. Both readings are on the same row. That row is what HR will ask me to explain.
entries.game_text: The harbor weekend is in the calendar as audit. The internet would call it something else. Both readings are on the same row. That row is what HR will ask me to explain.

entries.text: [calm] Correct. [short pause] And the applicant gets a vote, because the applicant is the one the file outlives. Choose how we resolve the signatory conflict before the liaison chooses a template for us.
entries.game_text: Correct. And the applicant gets a vote, because the applicant is the one the file outlives. Choose how we resolve the signatory conflict before the liaison chooses a template for us.

entries.text: [softly] Procedural and correct. It also means another desk reviews you, and I lose the only honest reason to keep you in my afternoons. I will file it anyway, if that is the version you can live in.
entries.game_text: Procedural and correct. It also means another desk reviews you, and I lose the only honest reason to keep you in my afternoons. I will file it anyway, if that is the version you can live in.

entries.text: [calm] Disclosure is the riskier filing. [short pause] It survives the clip by agreeing with it, on our terms. You understand that once I write it, the port owns the sentence too, not just the harbor.
entries.game_text: Disclosure is the riskier filing. It survives the clip by agreeing with it, on our terms. You understand that once I write it, the port owns the sentence too, not just the harbor.

entries.text: [resigned] I filed the recusal. [short pause] Deputy Saito reviews your packet now. He is competent and he does not know your coffee order. That is the price of a clean conflict.
entries.game_text: I filed the recusal. Deputy Saito reviews your packet now. He is competent and he does not know your coffee order. That is the price of a clean conflict.

entries.text: [softly] I wrote the disclosure in my own hand. [short pause] *Personal relationship. Disclosed. Oversight accepted.* The port owns that sentence now. So, apparently, do I.
entries.game_text: I wrote the disclosure in my own hand. *Personal relationship. Disclosed. Oversight accepted.* The port owns that sentence now. So, apparently, do I.

entries.text: [calm] The quiet parts are not on any portal. [short pause] Blanket is still a loan against your noise. Clementine is domestic filing. Almost-smile inventory: pending, denied, pending again.
entries.game_text: The quiet parts are not on any portal. Blanket is still a loan against your noise. Clementine is domestic filing. Almost-smile inventory: pending, denied, pending again.

entries.text: [teasing] Motion denied, To-chan. [short pause] Effective in three business days, like everything I intend to keep.
entries.game_text: Motion denied, To-chan. Effective in three business days, like everything I intend to keep.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] ...You are not wrong about the clerks. [short pause] Note it, and say nothing. A read you cannot hold quietly will cost you more than a wobbled bow.
entries.game_text: ...You are not wrong about the clerks. Note it, and say nothing. A read you cannot hold quietly will cost you more than a wobbled bow.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] We held the line together. [short pause] That is new, and I find I do not hate it. Do not let it go to your head before the stitches are even in.
entries.game_text: We held the line together. That is new, and I find I do not hate it. Do not let it go to your head before the stitches are even in.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Witness note: foreman detained, ledger seized, and my witness turned the cut that should have killed her. [short pause] Write that line first. We will argue about the rest behind my screen, not on a wet dock.
entries.game_text: Witness note: foreman detained, ledger seized, and my witness turned the cut that should have killed her. Write that line first. We will argue about the rest behind my screen, not on a wet dock.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Say his name aloud and you accuse a peer of the bench with a dead clerk and a petal-count. [short pause] The Crane envoy writes that home, and this city eats the witness long before it eats the magistrate.
entries.game_text: Say his name aloud and you accuse a peer of the bench with a dead clerk and a petal-count. The Crane envoy writes that home, and this city eats the witness long before it eats the magistrate.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Now you understand the work. [short pause] We do not close the big file. We keep it open on purpose, one witness chain at a time, until the day the record can hold his name without burning the clerk who wrote it. That is what a left hand is for.
entries.game_text: Now you understand the work. We do not close the big file. We keep it open on purpose, one witness chain at a time, until the day the record can hold his name without burning the clerk who wrote it. That is what a left hand is for.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] I keep what signs willingly. [short pause] You did not. Holding what will not stay is the one crime this office cannot file. Take your road, Kakita Toa. Walk it on your own paper.
entries.game_text: I keep what signs willingly. You did not. Holding what will not stay is the one crime this office cannot file. Take your road, Kakita Toa. Walk it on your own paper.

entries.text: [dry] Footnotes outlive headlines. That is the only fame worth filing.
entries.game_text: Footnotes outlive headlines. That is the only fame worth filing.

entries.text: [calm] The disclosure sits in the permanent file in my own hand. *Personal relationship, disclosed, oversight accepted.* The internet, bored of the truth, went hunting for a man with a muted mic instead.
entries.game_text: The disclosure sits in the permanent file in my own hand. *Personal relationship, disclosed, oversight accepted.* The internet, bored of the truth, went hunting for a man with a muted mic instead.

entries.text: [calm] We kept it procedural. [short pause] Another desk reviews your packet now, and the file closed clean. The internet, bored of clean, went hunting for a man with a muted mic instead.
entries.game_text: We kept it procedural. Another desk reviews your packet now, and the file closed clean. The internet, bored of clean, went hunting for a man with a muted mic instead.

entries.text: [softly] It was not, then. [short pause] It is, now. I amended the filing. The letterhead caught up to the calendar. The calendar caught up to the harbor.
entries.game_text: It was not, then. It is, now. I amended the filing. The letterhead caught up to the calendar. The calendar caught up to the harbor.

entries.text: [softly] Effective immediately. [short pause] No waiting period. I have run out of business days I am willing to make you wait.
entries.game_text: Effective immediately. No waiting period. I have run out of business days I am willing to make you wait.

entries.text: [warmly] Noted. Entered. The record agrees with you, which it rarely does and never out loud.
entries.game_text: Noted. Entered. The record agrees with you, which it rarely does and never out loud.

entries.text: [firmly] Overruled. [short pause] The waiting period was always for the building, not for you. I am done making you wait for the benefit of an audience that muted its own microphone.
entries.game_text: Overruled. The waiting period was always for the building, not for you. I am done making you wait for the benefit of an audience that muted its own microphone.

entries.text: [softly] Noted.
entries.game_text: Noted.

entries.text: [warmly] Motion granted, To-chan. On the record.
entries.game_text: Motion granted, To-chan. On the record.

entries.text: [teasing] Your protest is noted and overruled. [short pause] I am keeping the smile and closing the clause.
entries.game_text: Your protest is noted and overruled. I am keeping the smile and closing the clause.

entries.text: [warmly] It is how this one works. I wrote it that way.
entries.game_text: It is how this one works. I wrote it that way.

entries.text: [warmly] Domestic filing.
entries.game_text: Domestic filing.

entries.text: [warmly] You can sit however you want. [short pause] You are not a witness here. You are the filing.
entries.game_text: You can sit however you want. You are not a witness here. You are the filing.

entries.text: [softly] Then pay attention to this part. It is the part I did not put on any portal.
entries.game_text: Then pay attention to this part. It is the part I did not put on any portal.

entries.text: [softly] Acceptable noise is still noise. [short pause] The harbor has ears. The neighbors have a lease. We decide how loud the audit gets tonight, and you decide first.
entries.game_text: Acceptable noise is still noise. The harbor has ears. The neighbors have a lease. We decide how loud the audit gets tonight, and you decide first.

entries.text: [softly] Then choose, on the record. A quiet audit after dark, on your word, or we close the file here, warm and dressed, and let the rain keep its own minutes.
entries.game_text: Then choose, on the record. A quiet audit after dark, on your word, or we close the file here, warm and dressed, and let the rain keep its own minutes.

entries.text: [softly] Deliverable one. [short pause] You beg the only way I allow after dark. Dates and names. Nothing performed for an audience.
entries.game_text: Deliverable one. You beg the only way I allow after dark. Dates and names. Nothing performed for an audience.

entries.text: [softly] You do not perform gratitude on the furniture. [short pause] You never did. You file it in the break room. I have the precedent in my own hand.
entries.game_text: You do not perform gratitude on the furniture. You never did. You file it in the break room. I have the precedent in my own hand.

entries.text: [tender] Acceptable noise is still noise. Tonight the acceptable noise is the rain and you breathing under my arm. The file can stay open until morning.
entries.game_text: Acceptable noise is still noise. Tonight the acceptable noise is the rain and you breathing under my arm. The file can stay open until morning.

entries.text: [warmly] You do not wait anymore. [short pause] That clause is closed. You are not a deliverable with an effective date. You are a standing item.
entries.game_text: You do not wait anymore. That clause is closed. You are not a deliverable with an effective date. You are a standing item.

entries.text: [dry] It sounds like you attend, you document, and you do not perform gratitude on municipal letterhead. Again.
entries.game_text: It sounds like you attend, you document, and you do not perform gratitude on municipal letterhead. Again.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] The fast track your letter promised is not a faster queue. [short pause] It is a signature. A Council sponsorship is only valid once a deputy director signs for the applicant. I am the deputy director on this floor. That is the line your transfer letter left out.
entries.game_text: The fast track your letter promised is not a faster queue. It is a signature. A Council sponsorship is only valid once a deputy director signs for the applicant. I am the deputy director on this floor. That is the line your transfer letter left out.

entries.text: [firmly] If I sign your sponsorship, I swear to the Council that you are an artist and not a story about fraud waiting to happen. The board takes my word because I do not give it cheaply. So give me an artist to swear to.
entries.game_text: If I sign your sponsorship, I swear to the Council that you are an artist and not a story about fraud waiting to happen. The board takes my word because I do not give it cheaply. So give me an artist to swear to.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] The file uses the words I can defend. [short pause] The word you mean stays off letterhead, where the board cannot read it back to us in a hearing. That is not a denial. That is custody.
entries.game_text: The file uses the words I can defend. The word you mean stays off letterhead, where the board cannot read it back to us in a hearing. That is not a denial. That is custody.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Your witness clause runs both directions today. [short pause] You have documented four of my inspections.
entries.game_text: Your witness clause runs both directions today. You have documented four of my inspections.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] An auditor who has never seen the deliverable cannot certify it.
entries.game_text: An auditor who has never seen the deliverable cannot certify it.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] So I am here to witness one of yours. Run a class.
entries.game_text: So I am here to witness one of yours. Run a class.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] I will sit where I can see you and the mirror.
entries.game_text: I will sit where I can see you and the mirror.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Then translate as you go.
entries.game_text: Then translate as you go.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] I have audited stranger languages than yours,
entries.game_text: I have audited stranger languages than yours,

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] and most of them were also hiding something in the footnotes.
entries.game_text: and most of them were also hiding something in the footnotes.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] That is a recording.
entries.game_text: That is a recording.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] A recording cannot tell whether you are early or whether you are apologizing.
entries.game_text: A recording cannot tell whether you are early or whether you are apologizing.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] It plays the same eight bars at the same tempo whether you are a witness or a liability.
entries.game_text: It plays the same eight bars at the same tempo whether you are a witness or a liability.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] It is a metronome that forgot it was supposed to be a human.
entries.game_text: It is a metronome that forgot it was supposed to be a human.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] I read music.
entries.game_text: I read music.

entries.text: [warmly] [matter-of-fact] It is mostly counting with better penmanship and a key signature where the case number goes.
entries.game_text: It is mostly counting with better penmanship and a key signature where the case number goes.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Three-four. Slow. Thirty-two. Noted.
entries.game_text: Three-four. Slow. Thirty-two. Noted.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] A recording cannot do the second one.
entries.game_text: A recording cannot do the second one.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] I find I object to being outperformed by a speaker that survived three tours.
entries.game_text: I find I object to being outperformed by a speaker that survived three tours.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] File it under professional pride and let it stay there.
entries.game_text: File it under professional pride and let it stay there.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Grand allegro. [short pause] You travel, I give you the bars to land in. Do not apologize on the descent.
entries.game_text: Grand allegro. You travel, I give you the bars to land in. Do not apologize on the descent.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] The descent is the part the board never watches and the only part that can hurt you.
entries.game_text: The descent is the part the board never watches and the only part that can hurt you.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] I played the first eight bars badly. Strike them from the witness log.
entries.game_text: I played the first eight bars badly. Strike them from the witness log.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] I played it correctly before I played it well. Note the difference in your log.
entries.game_text: I played it correctly before I played it well. Note the difference in your log.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] It is the only review I will ever file on myself.
entries.game_text: It is the only review I will ever file on myself.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] We are due back at the tower. The inspection still has to close on paper.
entries.game_text: We are due back at the tower. The inspection still has to close on paper.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] None of what just happened goes in that report.
entries.game_text: None of what just happened goes in that report.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] A studio with a piano is not a deliverable the Council keeps a box for.
entries.game_text: A studio with a piano is not a deliverable the Council keeps a box for.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] The piano is not in the record. Neither is the reason I sat down at it.
entries.game_text: The piano is not in the record. Neither is the reason I sat down at it.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Some deliverables I keep in the drawer with no label,
entries.game_text: Some deliverables I keep in the drawer with no label,

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] where the board cannot ask me to explain them. [short pause] You are filed in that drawer.
entries.game_text: where the board cannot ask me to explain them. You are filed in that drawer.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] So is the afternoon.
entries.game_text: So is the afternoon.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] I stopped being able to file you as procedure somewhere around a studio piano.
entries.game_text: I stopped being able to file you as procedure somewhere around a studio piano.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] A man cannot accompany a woman through a whole class, badly and then well,
entries.game_text: A man cannot accompany a woman through a whole class, badly and then well,

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] and keep pretending the clause is the true version. [short pause] So I amended the true version instead.
entries.game_text: and keep pretending the clause is the true version. So I amended the true version instead.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] It was the only honest filing left on the desk.
entries.game_text: It was the only honest filing left on the desk.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Pack up before the building decides we are a story it can stamp. Go home, To-chan.
entries.game_text: Pack up before the building decides we are a story it can stamp. Go home, To-chan.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] Lantern light pools on polished floorboards. Every sliding door looks the same.
entries.game_text: Lantern light pools on polished floorboards. Every sliding door looks the same.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] Toe-uh clutches her permit book and hanko case, [short pause] turning in a corridor that refuses to end.
entries.game_text: Toa clutches her permit book and hanko case, turning in a corridor that refuses to end.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] The noble quarter smells of ink and cedar. Somewhere behind these walls, [short pause] someone holds the seal she needs.
entries.game_text: The noble quarter smells of ink and cedar. Somewhere behind these walls, someone holds the seal she needs.

entries.text: [pause] [whispers] The door shuts with finality. Toe-uh's ears ring.
entries.game_text: The door shuts with finality. Toa's ears ring.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] Toe-uh straightens her kosode, breathes, and waits.
entries.game_text: Toa straightens her kosode, breathes, and waits.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] Three offices later, [short pause] a junior clerk squints at her permit book and points back the way she came.
entries.game_text: Three offices later, a junior clerk squints at her permit book and points back the way she came.

entries.text: [pause] The corridor loops [dramatic] of course it loops — and deposits her exactly where she started.
entries.game_text: The corridor loops — of course it loops — and deposits her exactly where she started.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] Toe-uh folds her hands. No muttering. No pacing. Just breath and patience.
entries.game_text: Toa folds her hands. No muttering. No pacing. Just breath and patience.

entries.text: [pause] Toe-uh kneels at the threshold and strikes the frame once [dramatic] crisp, patient.
entries.game_text: Toa kneels at the threshold and strikes the frame once, crisp, patient.

entries.text: [pause] Toe-uh kneels at the threshold and strikes the frame twice [dramatic] crisp, [short pause] measured.
entries.game_text: Toa kneels at the threshold and strikes the frame twice, crisp, measured.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] He gestures. The door closes behind her.
entries.game_text: He gestures. The door closes behind her.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] Toe-uh keeps her gaze on the desk. Not on the shelves lined with case files and curios.
entries.game_text: Toa keeps her gaze on the desk. Not on the shelves lined with case files and curios.

entries.text: [dramatic] Her eyes snag on a row of scrolls, Lion mon here, Emerald seal there, and one writ still bright with fresh wax at this late hour.
entries.game_text: Her eyes snag on a row of scrolls, Lion mon here, Emerald seal there, and one writ still bright with fresh wax at this late hour.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] A cushion already waits on the tatami at his knee. He taps it once with one finger. A tall cup of water on the desk waits like a witness.
entries.game_text: A cushion already waits on the tatami at his knee. He taps it once with one finger. A tall cup of water on the desk waits like a witness.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] Toe-uh sets her permit book and hanko case on the desk, close enough to show, [short pause] not close enough to surrender.
entries.game_text: Toa sets her permit book and hanko case on the desk, close enough to show, not close enough to surrender.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] He tutted once. Toe-uh has heard he can manage five.
entries.game_text: He tutted once. Toa has heard he can manage five.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] The cushion at her feet does not move. The water cup on the desk does not move. It never does.
entries.game_text: The cushion at her feet does not move. The water cup on the desk does not move. It never does.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] She gathers her permit book. The hanko case clicks shut like a verdict.
entries.game_text: She gathers her permit book. The hanko case clicks shut like a verdict.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] Rain finds the noble quarter anyway. Case One will have to wait for a braver night.
entries.game_text: Rain finds the noble quarter anyway. Case One will have to wait for a braver night.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] Lamplight shrinks the room. Toe-uh loosens her obi, not indecent, [short pause] but deliberate, and lets the silk breathe.
entries.game_text: Lamplight shrinks the room. Toa loosens her obi, not indecent, but deliberate, and lets the silk breathe.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] She unfolds her fan. Steps trace a story — courtship, [short pause] hesitation, resolve — obijime bells whispering at each turn.
entries.game_text: She unfolds her fan. Steps trace a story — courtship, hesitation, resolve — obijime bells whispering at each turn.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] Kaoru watches, still as stone. He drinks water without looking away.
entries.game_text: Kaoru watches, still as stone. He drinks water without looking away.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] The fan closes on the final beat [pause] not a courtesy bow, but a held breath.
entries.game_text: The fan closes on the final beat — not a bow, but a held breath.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] She plays to one viewer. Hips sway where the kata allows; [short pause] smile promises more than the room receives.
entries.game_text: She plays to one viewer. Hips sway where the kata allows; smile promises more than the room receives.

entries.text: [pause] She lets the obijime bells laugh once [dramatic] invitation and challenge in the same sound.
entries.game_text: She lets the obijime bells laugh once — invitation and challenge in the same sound.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] The cup sets down softly. His eyes don't blink.
entries.game_text: The cup sets down softly. His eyes don't blink.

entries.text: [pause] She continues [dramatic] the maiden's story unfinished, [short pause] bells softer now, every turn aimed at the desk.
entries.game_text: She continues — the maiden's story unfinished, bells softer now, every turn aimed at the desk.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] She continues — coquette sway sharpened to obedience, [short pause] every glance a question he refuses to answer.
entries.game_text: She continues — coquette sway sharpened to obedience, every glance a question he refuses to answer.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] She continues — bells softer, [short pause] gaze sharper, every turn aimed at the desk and the seal he still withholds.
entries.game_text: She continues — bells softer, gaze sharper, every turn aimed at the desk and the seal he still withholds.

entries.text: [dramatic] His hand finds her wrist, not painful, not gentle, the grip of a man weighing goods he already assumes are his.
entries.game_text: His hand finds her wrist, not painful, not gentle, the grip of a man weighing goods he already assumes are his.

entries.text: [pause] She spins free and finishes the phrase [dramatic] defiance as choreography.
entries.game_text: She spins free and finishes the phrase — defiance as choreography.

entries.text: [pause] She doesn't pull away. The dance uses his grip as counterweight [dramatic] dangerous, [short pause] deliberate.
entries.game_text: She doesn't pull away. The dance uses his grip as counterweight — dangerous, deliberate.

entries.text: [dramatic] The chair creaks. [short pause] Hakama folds. Two figures, one of them seated like he owns the floor she is standing on, and a single question left hanging between them.
entries.game_text: The chair creaks. Hakama folds. Two figures, one of them seated like he owns the floor she is standing on, and a single question left hanging between them.

entries.text: [pause] She straddles the chair's arm [dramatic] not surrender, [short pause] not retreat. Proximity as punctuation.
entries.game_text: She straddles the chair's arm — not surrender, not retreat. Proximity as punctuation.

entries.text: [pause] He lifts the hanko [dramatic] teasing height above the permit book — then sets it down untouched.
entries.game_text: He lifts the hanko — teasing height above the permit book — then sets it down untouched.

entries.text: [pause] The corridor is colder than the office. Somewhere a bell marks the hour [dramatic] not dawn, [short pause] not yet.
entries.game_text: The corridor is colder than the office. Somewhere a bell marks the hour — not dawn, not yet.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] She snatches the permit book. The hanko case stays — his, [short pause] or forgotten, or a trap she refuses to spring.
entries.game_text: She snatches the permit book. The hanko case stays — his, or forgotten, or a trap she refuses to spring.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] Lantern light stripes the floor. Her boots echo too loud for the noble quarter.
entries.game_text: Lantern light stripes the floor. Her boots echo too loud for the noble quarter.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] The latch catches. Lamplight thins to amber behind the desk.
entries.game_text: She runs for the outer gate. Lacquer and iron have not opened for petitioners this late — only for magistrates who forgot to lock shame inside.

entries.text: [dramatic] His hand finds her wrist. [short pause] Not to restrain her, to invite. He draws her off the chair, into the space between desk and lantern.
entries.game_text: His hand finds her wrist. Not to restrain her, to invite. He draws her off the chair, into the space between desk and lantern.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] Negotiation dissolves into breath. Her fingers find his collar; [short pause] his thumb traces the line of her jaw.
entries.game_text: His hand closes on her wrist — not a lover's grip, a clerk's. Fingers find the pulse the way he finds a misplaced line.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] She loosens the gold outer robe — magistrate formality giving way to skin at throat and collarbone. He lets her. Control, [short pause] yielded by degrees.
entries.game_text: He hauls her back through the corridor the way a seal returns to its case — boots skidding on polished wood, lantern stripes racing across her face.

entries.text: [dramatic] Maroon silk slips from one shoulder. [short pause] Her obi loosens; his hakama stays untouched. She offers; he allows.
entries.game_text: Maroon silk slips from one shoulder. Her obi loosens; his hakama stays untouched. She offers; he allows.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] They fold onto the cushion already on the tatami. Lamplight paints them in gold and shadow — breath shared, [short pause] his hands in white hair, her mouth at his collar until words fail.
entries.game_text: The guest-room mat. The cushion she refused to preview. The docket stack still warm where she flung her pride.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] She means it. He answers without words — hands in white hair, [short pause] silk between them, heat where law used to sit.
entries.game_text: He turns — not in haste, but enough. Her shoulder meets air where his sleeve was.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] What followed stayed between petitioner and magistrate — implied, [short pause] never entered in any clerk's ledger.
entries.game_text: The mat rushes up. Paper scatters like startled herons. The permit book skids under the desk where he wanted it in the first place.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] When breath and silk found order again, [short pause] robes still loose and cheeks flushed, the office smelled of ink and cedar, not scandal.
entries.game_text: Her arms do not answer. Pride was a costume. Under it she is only breath and bruised obi and the taste of his corridor.

entries.text: [pause] He draws the renewal from her permit book. The hanko rises [dramatic] law made weight in red wax.
entries.game_text: The office door seals. Lamplight shrinks to a strip under the shoji.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] Stamp. One crisp press against the page.
entries.game_text: From the hall, clerks hear nothing — or learn to hear nothing. Emerald Magistrate business.

entries.text: [pause] She holds the paper to the lamp. His hand wrote three days hence [dramatic] not tonight's mark.
entries.game_text: What happens next is not entered in any clerk's ledger — only in the ache she will carry if she survives the night.

entries.text: [dramatic] Morning in the noble quarter tastes of ink and cedar. [short pause] The thirtieth is still the date on her permit, but Toe-uh is already at the threshold with tea and a borrowed case file.
entries.game_text: Morning in the noble quarter tastes of ink and cedar. The thirtieth is still the date on her permit, but Toa is already at the threshold with tea and a borrowed case file.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] He gestures to the cushion on the tatami in front of the desk, [short pause] the same spot where he made her sit for her audition.
entries.game_text: He gestures to the cushion on the tatami in front of the desk, the same spot where he made her sit for her audition.

entries.text: [dramatic] He slides a stack across the desk. [short pause] Not her permit book this time, but office stationery stamped with the Emerald crest.
entries.game_text: He slides a stack across the desk. Not her permit book this time, but office stationery stamped with the Emerald crest.

entries.text: [dramatic] The top sheet is titled {i}Appointment of Live-In Companion (Patronage of Artistic Residence){/i}. [short pause] Her name is already inked there, in his hand.
entries.game_text: The top sheet is titled {i}Appointment of Live-In Companion (Patronage of Artistic Residence){/i}. Her name is already inked there, in his hand.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] He taps a second page: stipend figures, [short pause] duty rotations, and a line for her seal beside his.
