entries.game_text: He taps a second page: stipend figures, duty rotations, and a line for her seal beside his.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] She takes up the brush. Her seal meets his: waxless, [short pause] official, irrevocable until he says otherwise.
entries.game_text: She takes up the brush. Her seal meets his: waxless, official, irrevocable until he says otherwise.

entries.text: [dramatic] The inner screen slides open. [short pause] Beyond it, the stairs smell of old paper and river damp: the archive, where Case One waits.
entries.game_text: The inner screen slides open. Beyond it, the stairs smell of old paper and river damp: the archive, where Case One waits.

entries.text: [dramatic] A live-in companion appointment waits in draft on his desk: unsigned, unoffered on this timeline. [short pause] Case One opens without the patronage seal.
entries.game_text: A live-in companion appointment waits in draft on his desk: unsigned, unoffered on this timeline. Case One opens without the patronage seal.

entries.text: [dramatic] The stair behind the inner screen swallows every footfall. [short pause] Dust has crept into Toe-uh's hakama, and the ledger under her arm smells of river damp and ink old enough to flake.
entries.game_text: The stair behind the inner screen swallows every footfall. Dust has crept into Toa's hakama, and the ledger under her arm smells of river damp and ink old enough to flake.

entries.text: [dramatic] Lantern light finds her at the top step. [short pause] The noble quarter corridor seems to narrow the moment she sees a magistrate standing in it, already waiting.
entries.game_text: Lantern light finds her at the top step. The noble quarter corridor seems to narrow the moment she sees a magistrate standing in it, already waiting.

entries.text: [dramatic] [coldly] Kaoru breaks the outer seal. [short pause] Inside: watch reports, a charcoal sketch of the recovery site, and a name line left blank until someone puts a face to the dead.
entries.game_text: Kaoru breaks the outer seal. Inside: watch reports, a charcoal sketch of the recovery site, and a name line left blank until someone puts a face to the dead.

entries.text: [dramatic] [coldly] He taps the sketch: a narrow cut between warehouses, rope marks scored into the stone, no blood in the water worth mentioning.
entries.game_text: He taps the sketch: a narrow cut between warehouses, rope marks scored into the stone, no blood in the water worth mentioning.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] A bag of rice crackers sits on the desk corner. Her indulgence, [short pause] his allowance.
entries.game_text: A bag of rice crackers sits on the desk corner. Her indulgence, his allowance.

entries.text: [dramatic] In the margin, a clerk noted the fingernails: scrubbed clean the night before. [short pause] Labor without the honest dirt that should come with it.
entries.game_text: In the margin, a clerk noted the fingernails: scrubbed clean the night before. Labor without the honest dirt that should come with it.

entries.text: [dramatic] They leave through the inner hall, not the public corridor where Toe-uh once wandered lost. [short pause] Guards nod to Kaoru. They look straight through Toe-uh, like furniture that learned to walk.
entries.game_text: They leave through the inner hall, not the public corridor where Toa once wandered lost. Guards nod to Kaoru. They look straight through Toa, like furniture that learned to walk.

entries.text: [dramatic] Ryoko Owari wakes around them: cart wheels, a shamisen somewhere distant, sweet smoke from a vial house two alleys over. [short pause] The canal cut is still half a district off.
entries.game_text: Ryoko Owari wakes around them: cart wheels, a shamisen somewhere distant, sweet smoke from a vial house two alleys over. The canal cut is still half a district off.

entries.text: [dramatic] A crow watches from a warehouse sign, three painted eyes that aren't quite Imperial and aren't quite Scorpion. [short pause] It takes wing the instant Kaoru glances up.
entries.game_text: A crow watches from a warehouse sign, three painted eyes that aren't quite Imperial and aren't quite Scorpion. It takes wing the instant Kaoru glances up.

entries.text: [dramatic] The canal runs black-green under morning cloud, greener than honest water, as if someone dissolved a charm and tipped the dregs downstream. [short pause] Rope burns scar the stone where watchmen hauled the body up.
entries.game_text: The canal runs black-green under morning cloud, greener than honest water, as if someone dissolved a charm and tipped the dregs downstream. Rope burns scar the stone where watchmen hauled the body up.

entries.text: [dramatic] No crowd. [short pause] Only a clerk with a wax tablet, and a Miya envoy pretending to read the warehouse sign so he won't have to look at the pallet.
entries.game_text: No crowd. Only a clerk with a wax tablet, and a Miya envoy pretending to read the warehouse sign so he won't have to look at the pallet.

entries.text: [dramatic] The covered pallet lies at the canal's lip, cloth still damp. [short pause] When the clerk folds back the sheet, a young man's face shows, peaceful in entirely the wrong way, as if his sleep had been negotiated rather than earned.
entries.game_text: The covered pallet lies at the canal's lip, cloth still damp. When the clerk folds back the sheet, a young man's face shows, peaceful in entirely the wrong way, as if his sleep had been negotiated rather than earned.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] Near the rope post, [short pause] something lacquered catches lantern glare, wedged in the seam where oil and wrong-colored water meet.
entries.game_text: Near the rope post, something lacquered catches lantern glare, wedged in the seam where oil and wrong-colored water meet.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] He wraps it in wax cloth himself, [short pause] eyes never leaving the eaves, and hands it to Toe-uh only long enough for her seal on the chain-of-custody line.
entries.game_text: He wraps it in wax cloth himself, eyes never leaving the eaves, and hands it to Toa only long enough for her seal on the chain-of-custody line.

entries.text: [dramatic] The clerk lifts the separate haori from a dry crate. [short pause] Wax inside the lining has melted, but the inner fold still holds a courier's chit, half legible under river stain.
entries.game_text: The clerk lifts the separate haori from a dry crate. Wax inside the lining has melted, but the inner fold still holds a courier's chit, half legible under river stain.

entries.text: [dramatic] The Miya envoy finally looks up from the warehouse sign. [short pause] He sees the chit in Kaoru's hand and suddenly remembers urgent business elsewhere.
entries.game_text: The Miya envoy finally looks up from the warehouse sign. He sees the chit in Kaoru's hand and suddenly remembers urgent business elsewhere.

entries.text: [dramatic] Back among cedar and ink, the Scorpion comb sits in a lacquer tray like a poisonous jewel. [short pause] Beside it, Kaoru inks {i}Miya Jiro{/i} onto the line the watch left blank.
entries.game_text: Back among cedar and ink, the Scorpion comb sits in a lacquer tray like a poisonous jewel. Beside it, Kaoru inks {i}Miya Jiro{/i} onto the line the watch left blank.

entries.text: [dramatic] [coldly] Morning again, and the docket has grown teeth overnight. [short pause] Beside Jiro's name Kaoru pinned a second sheet: the Miya guest house, the Lacquered Plum, where a dead clerk once kept other men's appointments.
entries.game_text: Morning again, and the docket has grown teeth overnight. Beside Jiro's name Kaoru pinned a second sheet: the Miya guest house, the Lacquered Plum, where a dead clerk once kept other men's appointments.

entries.text: [dramatic] Rain reaches the licensed quarter first. [short pause] It beads on paper lanterns the color of old wine and runs the canal black between teahouses that sell forgetting by the hour.
entries.game_text: Rain reaches the licensed quarter first. It beads on paper lanterns the color of old wine and runs the canal black between teahouses that sell forgetting by the hour.

entries.text: [dramatic] The Lacquered Plum leans over the water on cedar stilts. [short pause] A three-eyed crow, the same painted sign or a cousin of it, watches from the gable. This time it does not fly.
entries.game_text: The Lacquered Plum leans over the water on cedar stilts. A three-eyed crow, the same painted sign or a cousin of it, watches from the gable. This time it does not fly.

entries.text: [dramatic] Inside: lamplight and face powder. [short pause] The okami kneels behind a low desk stacked with appointment books, smile fixed hard as lacquer, eyes already tallying the cost of a magistrate's boots on her tatami.
entries.game_text: Inside: lamplight and face powder. The okami kneels behind a low desk stacked with appointment books, smile fixed hard as lacquer, eyes already tallying the cost of a magistrate's boots on her tatami.

entries.text: [dramatic] Kaoru sets the wax-wrapped comb on the desk and folds the cloth back. [short pause] The okami's painted calm cracks, just a hairline.
entries.game_text: Kaoru sets the wax-wrapped comb on the desk and folds the cloth back. The okami's painted calm cracks, just a hairline.

entries.text: [dramatic] [coldly] But Toe-uh has already slipped past the desk the kitchen way: servant's bow, easy warmth of a woman who carried tea in worse rooms. [short pause] A young geisha looks up from folding a dead man's spare haori.
entries.game_text: But Toa has already slipped past the desk the kitchen way: servant's bow, easy warmth of a woman who carried tea in worse rooms. A young geisha looks up from folding a dead man's spare haori.

entries.text: [dramatic] The okami's smile finally fails. [short pause] In the corner a girl, a geisha, young, eyes red-rimmed, flinches under the weight of his voice.
entries.game_text: The okami's smile finally fails. In the corner a girl, a geisha, young, eyes red-rimmed, flinches under the weight of his voice.

entries.text: [dramatic] The geisha rises. [short pause] Perhaps nineteen, white makeup cried through at the edges. She bows too low, the way frightened people do once they've already decided to be brave.
entries.game_text: The geisha rises. Perhaps nineteen, white makeup cried through at the edges. She bows too low, the way frightened people do once they've already decided to be brave.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] Kaoru tilts the wrapped comb toward the lamp. Suzu goes the color of her own face powder.
entries.game_text: Kaoru tilts the wrapped comb toward the lamp. Suzu goes the color of her own face powder.

entries.text: [dramatic] She's already decided Toe-uh is safe. [short pause] The kitchen bow bought what no seal could. Her words come in a rush, like water finding the crack it wanted.
entries.game_text: She's already decided Toa is safe. The kitchen bow bought what no seal could. Her words come in a rush, like water finding the crack it wanted.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] She watches Toe-uh's hands, not her face. Slowly, fear loosens its knot.
entries.game_text: She watches Toa's hands, not her face. Slowly, fear loosens its knot.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] The girl's hand flies to her own throat. The gesture answers before her voice can.
entries.game_text: The girl's hand flies to her own throat. The gesture answers before her voice can.

entries.text: [dramatic] Kaoru says nothing. [short pause] He simply waits, and the room shrinks around his stillness until the okami's powder runs and Suzu's resolve breaks, all under a magistrate who hasn't yet bothered to threaten her.
entries.game_text: Kaoru says nothing. He simply waits, and the room shrinks around his stillness until the okami's powder runs and Suzu's resolve breaks, all under a magistrate who hasn't yet bothered to threaten her.

entries.text: [dramatic] The okami surrenders the high-tide registry the way a gambler gives up a marked card: slowly, watching the door the whole time. [short pause] Kaoru turns to the night Jiro died.
entries.game_text: The okami surrenders the high-tide registry the way a gambler gives up a marked card: slowly, watching the door the whole time. Kaoru turns to the night Jiro died.

entries.text: [dramatic] The booking is authorized in red: a private-room writ, the kind the licensed quarter demands of the magistracy to seal a room against the watch. [short pause] The wax bears the Emerald mon.
entries.game_text: The booking is authorized in red: a private-room writ, the kind the licensed quarter demands of the magistracy to seal a room against the watch. The wax bears the Emerald mon.

entries.text: [dramatic] The screen slides open without a knock. [short pause] A man in unmarked grey steps in from the rain, a trade factor by his ink-stained cuffs, Scorpion by the lacquer-scale clasp at his collar, with the easy menace of someone used to buying magistrates by the dozen.
entries.game_text: The screen slides open without a knock. A man in unmarked grey steps in from the rain, a trade factor by his ink-stained cuffs, Scorpion by the lacquer-scale clasp at his collar, with the easy menace of someone used to buying magistrates by the dozen.

entries.text: [dramatic] The factor's hand drifts toward his sleeve. [short pause] Kaoru doesn't move at all, and somehow that's worse than if he had.
entries.game_text: The factor's hand drifts toward his sleeve. Kaoru doesn't move at all, and somehow that's worse than if he had.

entries.text: [dramatic] The factor's composure thins. [short pause] A spoken record, in a house full of witnesses, is much harder to drown than a single clerk.
entries.game_text: The factor's composure thins. A spoken record, in a house full of witnesses, is much harder to drown than a single clerk.

entries.text: [dramatic] The factor weighs it all: the room, the spoken record, the unmoving magistrate. [short pause] Then he bows to the exact depth that insults without inviting a blade, and withdraws into the rain.
entries.game_text: The factor weighs it all: the room, the spoken record, the unmoving magistrate. Then he bows to the exact depth that insults without inviting a blade, and withdraws into the rain.

entries.text: [dramatic] The screen slides shut. [short pause] Suzu lets out a breath she's held since he entered. The okami has already started deciding which version of tonight she'll sell, and to whom.
entries.game_text: The screen slides shut. Suzu lets out a breath she's held since he entered. The okami has already started deciding which version of tonight she'll sell, and to whom.

entries.text: [dramatic] Back among cedar and ink, the case finally has a shape. [short pause] On the lacquer tray: the Scorpion comb, Suzu's name, and, depending on the night, a forged Emerald writ or its careful copy.
entries.game_text: Back among cedar and ink, the case finally has a shape. On the lacquer tray: the Scorpion comb, Suzu's name, and, depending on the night, a forged Emerald writ or its careful copy.

entries.text: [softly] [tender] He crosses the office and stops too close: practiced proximity of a man who has decided the distance between you is his to set.
entries.game_text: He crosses the office and stops too close: practiced proximity of a man who has decided the distance between you is his to set.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] She has already decided Toe-uh is safe. The kitchen bow bought what no seal could. Her words come in a rush, like water finding the crack it wanted.
entries.game_text: She has already decided Toa is safe. The kitchen bow bought what no seal could. Her words come in a rush, like water finding the crack it wanted.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] She watches Toe-uh's hands, not her face. Slowly the fear loosens its knot.
entries.game_text: She watches Toa's hands, not her face. Slowly the fear loosens its knot.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] Toe-uh is already below the awning, fingers on a waxed folio tied with Scorpion cord. The night smells of opium resin beneath honest rice sacks.
entries.game_text: Toa is already below the awning, fingers on a waxed folio tied with Scorpion cord. The night smells of opium resin beneath honest rice sacks.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] The factor from the Plum stumbles from the cabin, silver foreign coins spilling from his sleeve.
entries.game_text: The factor from the Plum stumbles from the cabin, silver foreign coins spilling from his sleeve.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] While Kaoru pins the factor with a smile like a drawn blade, Toe-uh lifts the manifest from the table behind him, rice on paper, resin in the hold.
entries.game_text: While Kaoru pins the factor with a smile like a drawn blade, Toa lifts the manifest from the table behind him, rice on paper, resin in the hold.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] Kneeling in soot, Toe-uh finds a corner of lacquered board the fire missed, the Academy's crane-in-flight mon, half melted but unmistakable.
entries.game_text: Kneeling in soot, Toa finds a corner of lacquered board the fire missed, the Academy's crane-in-flight mon, half melted but unmistakable.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] Fireworks climb over the canal, chrysanthemum bursts, then falling embers that die in the water wrong-green and beautiful. Toe-uh flinches at the first crack; Kaoru's hand finds her wrist, steady, proprietary.
entries.game_text: Fireworks climb over the canal, chrysanthemum bursts, then falling embers that die in the water wrong-green and beautiful. Toa flinches at the first crack; Kaoru's hand finds her wrist, steady, proprietary.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] The lamplight ends. What is left is rain on white hair and a bow that will not hold.
entries.game_text: The lamplight ends. What is left is rain on white hair and a bow that will not hold.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] Case Three's saw kerf still smells of cedar dust when Kaoru sets down his brush — not on a docket, [short pause] but on a folded sheet of rice paper sealed with wax that bears no office chop.
entries.game_text: Case Three's saw kerf still smells of cedar dust when Kaoru sets down his brush — not on a docket, but on a folded sheet of rice paper sealed with wax that bears no office chop.

entries.text: [pause] He slides the paper across the desk. The hand is his [dramatic] blunt vertical strokes, [short pause] no poetry.
entries.game_text: He slides the paper across the desk. The hand is his — blunt vertical strokes, no poetry.

entries.text: [softly] [gently] The second line is written smaller: [short pause] Performances available upon request from either neighboring house. Do not be late.
entries.game_text: The second line is written smaller: *Performances available upon request from either neighboring house. Do not be late.*

entries.text: [dramatic] She agonized over every last hairpin, dithered between obi brocades for hours, and finally flipped a coin just to settle on her shoes. [short pause] Autumn's turning let her play with patterns the peak seasons would never allow.
entries.game_text: She agonized over every last hairpin, dithered between obi brocades for hours, and finally flipped a coin just to settle on her shoes. Autumn's turning let her play with patterns the peak seasons would never allow.

entries.text: [dramatic] Black furisode, scattered with the turn of autumn: bush clover and chrysanthemum at the roots of a maple that climbs her sleeves, red leaves drifting all the way down her arms. [short pause] Rose-gold obi brocade tied in a musubi that trails past her hips. Zori instead of clunky geta, and kanzashi bells that sing whenever she moves.
entries.game_text: Black furisode, scattered with the turn of autumn: bush clover and chrysanthemum at the roots of a maple that climbs her sleeves, red leaves drifting all the way down her arms. Rose-gold obi brocade tied in a musubi that trails past her hips. Zori instead of clunky geta, and kanzashi bells that sing whenever she moves.

entries.text: [softly] [matter-of-fact] Rouge on her lips and at her eyes. Deliberate grace tonight, instead of her usual exuberant freedom. [short pause] At one-third of her normal stride, the walk to the ferry takes forever.
entries.game_text: Rouge on her lips and at her eyes. Deliberate grace tonight, instead of her usual exuberant freedom. At one-third of her normal stride, the walk to the ferry takes forever.

entries.text: [dramatic] Teardrop Island at night is all lantern-gold on dark water, licensed-quarter elegance without a trace of the magistrate hall's ink. [short pause] The geisha house eaves lean close over the canal like confidantes sharing a secret.
entries.game_text: Teardrop Island at night is all lantern-gold on dark water, licensed-quarter elegance without a trace of the magistrate hall's ink. The geisha house eaves lean close over the canal like confidantes sharing a secret.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] The inn sits exactly where he said: north side, [short pause] squeezed between two houses whose signboards promise music. No other guests on the walkway. No chatter behind the main screen.
entries.game_text: The inn sits exactly where he said: north side, squeezed between two houses whose signboards promise music. No other guests on the walkway. No chatter behind the main screen.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] A servant offers crisp hojicha — she will hunt that tea again for weeks. When she asks, [short pause] they bow in courtesy: yes, Magistrate Kitsu has taken the venue. Performances upon request from either neighbor.
entries.game_text: A servant offers crisp hojicha — she will hunt that tea again for weeks. When she asks, they bow: yes, Magistrate Kitsu has taken the venue. Performances upon request from either neighbor.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] Inside: tatami, [short pause] paper lanterns, a low table set for two. Biwa music threads from behind the wall — not performance yet, only atmosphere.
entries.game_text: Inside: tatami, paper lanterns, a low table set for two. Biwa music threads from behind the wall — not performance yet, only atmosphere.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] She tries to bow as she always does — a shallow courtesy bow at the waist. The stiff fukuro obi allows barely a hinge. She laughs inwardly and straightens, [short pause] catching his fragrance — the same note as the first wrong door.
entries.game_text: She tries to bow as she always does. The stiff fukuro obi allows barely a hinge. She laughs inwardly and straightens, catching his fragrance — the same note as the first wrong door.

entries.text: [softly] [calm] She tips her face upward, checking in with her own body.
entries.game_text: She tips her face upward, checking in with her own body.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] A servant departs without a ledger. Kaoru angles toward her — not full facing, [short pause] the way he sits when he wants truth without an audience.
entries.game_text: A servant departs without a ledger. Kaoru angles toward her — not full facing, the way he sits when he wants truth without an audience.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] Not *thank you*. He has said that word to her before, [short pause] in his own way. It does not bother her that he skips it tonight.
entries.game_text: Not *thank you*. He has said that word to her before, in his own way. It does not bother her that he skips it tonight.

entries.text: [dramatic] Kaiseki trays arrive, autumn's turning laid out on porcelain. [short pause] Matsutake with salted plum and preserved chrysanthemum. Skipjack with mustard greens, alliums, shiso flowers. White miso and chestnut.
entries.game_text: Kaiseki trays arrive, autumn's turning laid out on porcelain. Matsutake with salted plum and preserved chrysanthemum. Skipjack with mustard greens, alliums, shiso flowers. White miso and chestnut.

entries.text: [calm] [softly] The sake is poured, and he does not throw it back. [short pause] It is expensive enough to be savored.
entries.game_text: The sake is poured, and he does not throw it back. It is expensive enough to be savored.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] Warm courses follow: toro with uni rice porridge, [short pause] cabbage and bamboo with shrimp, mushroom shabushabu over a tealight, sesame noodles bright with watercress and radish.
entries.game_text: Warm courses follow: toro with uni rice porridge, cabbage and bamboo with shrimp, mushroom shabushabu over a tealight, sesame noodles bright with watercress and radish.

entries.text: [dramatic] She whispers *itadakimasu*. [short pause] Good food earns her silence, nothing but a soft hum the moment matsutake meets her tongue.
entries.game_text: She whispers *itadakimasu*. Good food earns her silence, nothing but a soft hum the moment matsutake meets her tongue.

entries.text: [calm] Between bites she watches him savor each flavor the way he savors a confession he has not filed yet, unhurried, proprietary, pleased without performing that pleasure for an audience.
entries.game_text: Between bites she watches him savor each flavor the way he savors a confession he has not filed yet, unhurried, proprietary, pleased without performing that pleasure for an audience.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] When they have polished two dishes each, [short pause] more instruments join the biwa — strings, flute, hand drum.
entries.game_text: When they have polished two dishes each, more instruments join the biwa — strings, flute, hand drum.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] At the first drumbeats she perks up, [short pause] slate eyes half-transfixed, half-evaluating — authority settling into her shoulders.
entries.game_text: At the first drumbeats she perks up, slate eyes half-transfixed, half-evaluating — authority settling into her shoulders.

entries.text: [softly] [tender] She catches herself right on the edge of a word she will not let herself name until Case Five.
entries.game_text: She catches herself right on the edge of a word she will not let herself name until Case Five.

entries.text: [softly] [nervously] She turns to her plate instead. [short pause] Then the sake. Then the air.
entries.game_text: She turns to her plate instead. Then the sake. Then the air.

entries.text: [amused] [warmly] He leans back, delighted, [short pause] treating the rumor as intelligence, not as shame.
entries.game_text: He leans back, delighted, treating the rumor as intelligence, not as shame.

entries.text: [calm] [softly] She eats the sesame seeds one by one, [short pause] then frowns as the question turns itself over.
entries.game_text: She eats the sesame seeds one by one, then frowns as the question turns itself over.

entries.text: [warmly] [softly] Bean paste with tea. [short pause] Sweet enough to let them pretend there is no dock steel waiting for them at dawn.
entries.game_text: Bean paste with tea. Sweet enough to let them pretend there is no dock steel waiting for them at dawn.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] They walk the lantern path toward the ferry — her zori careful on stone, [short pause] his pace slowed to match bells and obi.
entries.game_text: They walk the lantern path toward the ferry — her zori careful on stone, his pace slowed to match bells and obi.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] Crane training keeps her face pleasant. Inside, [short pause] something unnamed aches — not love by name, only the wish he would stop stepping back after every forward step.
entries.game_text: Crane training keeps her face pleasant. Inside, something unnamed aches — not love by name, only the wish he would stop stepping back after every forward step.

entries.text: [calm] His hand lifts. Not to take hers, but to straighten a lantern cord near her sleeve. His fingers pause a breath's width from her palm, close enough that she feels the heat he will not file. The almost-touch hurts worse than any no.
entries.game_text: His hand lifts. Not to take hers, but to straighten a lantern cord near her sleeve. His fingers pause a breath's width from her palm, close enough that she feels the heat he will not file. The almost-touch hurts worse than any no.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] The compound gate closes behind them. Cedar and ink replace hojicha and drum. She should sleep. Instead she listens to his footsteps fade toward the inner hall — still not a date by his ledger, [short pause] still not love by name, still hers in every file he refuses to romanticize.
entries.game_text: The compound gate closes behind them. Cedar and ink replace hojicha and drum. She should sleep. Instead she listens to his footsteps fade toward the inner hall — still not a date by his ledger, still not love by name, still hers in every file he refuses to romanticize.

entries.text: [dramatic] Case Four's ink is barely dry. [short pause] The first hard cold has come early off the bay, and with it the season's Scorpion raids have the harbor clerks lying about grain again, and Teardrop Island's marina still owes a witness line from the dock spill.
entries.game_text: Case Four's ink is barely dry. The first hard cold has come early off the bay, and with it the season's Scorpion raids have the harbor clerks lying about grain again, and Teardrop Island's marina still owes a witness line from the dock spill.

entries.text: [dramatic] Teardrop Island's marina is nothing like the licensed quarter's polished stone. [short pause] Just frost-bitten ribs and broken pilings. The first winter wind off the bay cuts straight through the rubble. A small kobune rocks at the tide line, its paint scarred from somebody else's war.
entries.game_text: Teardrop Island's marina is nothing like the licensed quarter's polished stone. Just frost-bitten ribs and broken pilings. The first winter wind off the bay cuts straight through the rubble. A small kobune rocks at the tide line, its paint scarred from somebody else's war.

entries.text: [softly] [calm] She peers out from behind a split mooring post, witness notes tucked into her sleeve. [short pause] Then a familiar voice cracks across the cold.
entries.game_text: She peers out from behind a split mooring post, witness notes tucked into her sleeve. Then a familiar voice cracks across the cold.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [amused] The Emerald Magistrate, soaked and furious, in a boat, [short pause] in this freezing cold?
entries.game_text: The Emerald Magistrate, soaked and furious, in a boat, in this freezing cold?

entries.text: [sad] [softly] A sniffle. [short pause] Then a whimper. Tears spill down her wind-reddened cheeks, concern he will not let her offer, [short pause] and she still does not know if he is whole.
entries.game_text: A sniffle. Then a whimper. Tears spill down her wind-reddened cheeks, concern he will not let her offer, and she still does not know if he is whole.

entries.text: [dramatic] [breathless] Knees, hips, shoulder, all wet wood. [short pause] Pain and surprise in a single breath. The roll of the boat underneath is wrong, [short pause] almost dizzying.
entries.game_text: Knees, hips, shoulder, all wet wood. Pain and surprise in a single breath. The roll of the boat underneath is wrong, almost dizzying.

entries.text: [dramatic] The hull rocks. [short pause] His palms brace the gunwales whenever the boat threatens to tip. Good girl, breathed against her hair, implied, never filed, a hunger the ledger has no column for.
entries.game_text: The hull rocks. His palms brace the gunwales whenever the boat threatens to tip. Good girl, breathed against her hair, implied, never filed, a hunger the ledger has no column for.

entries.text: [calm] When the rhythm finally ends, they are a single knot of warmth and borrowed robes. The bay cold waits just outside the strakes like a witness who was never summoned.
entries.game_text: When the rhythm finally ends, they are a single knot of warmth and borrowed robes. The bay cold waits just outside the strakes like a witness who was never summoned.

entries.text: [calm] [tender] They ferry back before the watch can invent a drowning. [short pause] Steam and citrus fill the magistrate wing, the bath, the kotatsu, mikan peeled in a silence that is almost domestic.
entries.game_text: They ferry back before the watch can invent a drowning. Steam and citrus fill the magistrate wing, the bath, the kotatsu, mikan peeled in a silence that is almost domestic.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] What happens next is not entered in any clerk's ledger — only in the ache she will carry if she survives the night.
entries.game_text: What happens next is not entered in any clerk's ledger — only in the ache she will carry if she survives the night.

entries.text: [pause] From the hall, [short pause] clerks hear nothing [dramatic] or learn to hear nothing. Emerald Magistrate business.
entries.game_text: From the hall, clerks hear nothing — or learn to hear nothing. Emerald Magistrate business.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] The office door seals. Lamplight shrinks to a strip under the shoji.
entries.game_text: The office door seals. Lamplight shrinks to a strip under the shoji.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] Her arms do not answer. Pride was a costume. Under it she is only breath and bruised obi and the taste of his corridor.
entries.game_text: Her arms do not answer. Pride was a costume. Under it she is only breath and bruised obi and the taste of his corridor.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] The mat rushes up. Paper scatters like startled herons. The permit book skids under the desk where he wanted it in the first place.
entries.game_text: The mat rushes up. Paper scatters like startled herons. The permit book skids under the desk where he wanted it in the first place.

entries.text: [softly] [calm] His hand closes around her wrist. Not a lover's hold, [short pause] a magistrate's. His fingers find the pulse there the way they find a misplaced line in a ledger, precise and without any warmth at all.
entries.game_text: His hand closes around her wrist. Not a lover's hold, a magistrate's. His fingers find the pulse there the way they find a misplaced line in a ledger, precise and without any warmth at all.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] Cedar and ink. The docket stack is still warm from Case One. [short pause] His hanko sits beside a narrow custody chit, companion escort, temporary, the kind of paper that buys silence from clerks who have already learned not to hear.
entries.game_text: Cedar and ink. The docket stack is still warm from Case One. His hanko sits beside a narrow custody chit, companion escort, temporary, the kind of paper that buys silence from clerks who have already learned not to hear.

entries.text: [softly] [dramatic] Then cold canal water, sweet with opium, closing over her head. [long pause] The last thing she sees is Scorpion grey paint blistering and bubbling under the rain.
entries.game_text: Then cold canal water, sweet with opium, closing over her head. The last thing she sees is Scorpion grey paint blistering and bubbling under the rain.

entries.text: [calm] [menacingly] The factor does not run. He only smiles and steps out from under the awning, [short pause] and somewhere behind her the deckhand's pole finds the small of her back.
entries.game_text: The factor does not run. He only smiles and steps out from under the awning, and somewhere behind her the deckhand's pole finds the small of her back.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] She boards alone, proud and quick, [short pause] certain the manifest is a prize waiting for her and not a hook waiting for a fish.
entries.game_text: She boards alone, proud and quick, certain the manifest is a prize waiting for her and not a hook waiting for a fish.

entries.text: [calm] [bitterly] He never does. The factor's runners are the ones who call out to her instead. [short pause] The companion file closes quietly, without her signature on the last line.
entries.game_text: He never does. The factor's runners are the ones who call out to her instead. The companion file closes quietly, without her signature on the last line.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] She walks out into the rain with her chin high, [short pause] certain the magistrate will call her name before she reaches the third bridge.
entries.game_text: She walks out into the rain with her chin high, certain the magistrate will call her name before she reaches the third bridge.

entries.text: [dramatic] Kurogane's cut is dock work, plain and final, not theater. [short pause] Rain swallows the pier. The magistrate's file closes without her breath.
entries.game_text: Kurogane's cut is dock work, plain and final, not theater. Rain swallows the pier. The magistrate's file closes without her breath.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] She lunges in alone, all pride and clean Crane footwork, [short pause] hungry to prove the Academy still owns her blade.
entries.game_text: She lunges in alone, all pride and clean Crane footwork, hungry to prove the Academy still owns her blade.

entries.text: [calm] [bitterly] The hospital cart creaks off toward the lower quarter. Ryoko Owari always keeps its boats. [short pause] It does not always trouble itself to keep its dancers.
entries.game_text: The hospital cart creaks off toward the lower quarter. Ryoko Owari always keeps its boats. It does not always trouble itself to keep its dancers.

entries.text: [softly] [sad] Bandages, later. Rain against the shoji. [short pause] A magistrate's shadow waits out at the marina pilings and never once crosses the gunwale, as though grief were something that might smudge a ledger.
entries.game_text: Bandages, later. Rain against the shoji. A magistrate's shadow waits out at the marina pilings and never once crosses the gunwale, as though grief were something that might smudge a ledger.

entries.text: [calm] [dramatic] She fights the throw, all that Crane pride pitched against a hull that was only ever built for fishermen. Her shoulder and ribs meet the thwart at the wrong angle. [short pause] The breath goes out of her. The kobune keeps rocking on the swell as if it had witnessed nothing at all.
entries.game_text: She fights the throw, all that Crane pride pitched against a hull that was only ever built for fishermen. Her shoulder and ribs meet the thwart at the wrong angle. The breath goes out of her. The kobune keeps rocking on the swell as if it had witnessed nothing at all.

entries.text: [calm] [bitterly] The hospital cart creaks off toward the canal quarter. Ryoko Owari always keeps its books in order. [short pause] It does not always trouble itself to keep its dancers.
entries.game_text: The hospital cart creaks off toward the canal quarter. Ryoko Owari always keeps its books in order. It does not always trouble itself to keep its dancers.

entries.text: [softly] [sad] Bandages, after. Rain against the shoji. [short pause] A magistrate's shadow stands in the doorway and never crosses the threshold, as though grief were something that might be catching on a ledger.
entries.game_text: Bandages, after. Rain against the shoji. A magistrate's shadow stands in the doorway and never crosses the threshold, as though grief were something that might be catching on a ledger.

entries.text: [calm] [dramatic] The bolt roll catches her shoulder first, then the mat comes up, [short pause] then the whole world tilts the wrong way. Crane footwork was never armor against a room built for the express purpose of killing witnesses.
entries.game_text: The bolt roll catches her shoulder first, then the mat comes up, then the whole world tilts the wrong way. Crane footwork was never armor against a room built for the express purpose of killing witnesses.

entries.text: [softly] [bitterly] Tsubaki's ghost gets company tonight. [short pause] Toe-uh's charter burns in the kiln with the rest of the evidence.
entries.game_text: Tsubaki's ghost gets company tonight. Toa's charter burns in the kiln with the rest of the evidence.

entries.text: [calm] [menacingly] The clerk's knife was never meant for Kaoru. [short pause] It was meant for the dancer who would not let the Academy packet stay buried.
entries.game_text: The clerk's knife was never meant for Kaoru. It was meant for the dancer who would not let the Academy packet stay buried.

entries.text: [calm] [deadpan] She walks into the kiln alley a step ahead of him, ash smeared in her palms, [short pause] the proof ready in her mouth, the pride still in every stride.
entries.game_text: She walks into the kiln alley a step ahead of him, ash smeared in her palms, the proof ready in her mouth, the pride still in every stride.

entries.text: [pause] He turns [dramatic] not in haste, [short pause] but enough. Her shoulder meets air where his sleeve was.
entries.game_text: He turns — not in haste, but enough. Her shoulder meets air where his sleeve was.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] The guest-room mat. The cushion she refused to preview. The docket stack still warm where she flung her pride.
entries.game_text: The guest-room mat. The cushion she refused to preview. The docket stack still warm where she flung her pride.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] Red wax blooms under his hanko — not on her permit, [short pause] but on a narrow custody chit he had waiting.
entries.game_text: Red wax blooms under his hanko — not on her permit, but on a narrow custody chit he had waiting.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] He hauls her back through the corridor the way a seal returns to its case — boots skidding on polished wood, [short pause] lantern stripes racing across her face.
entries.game_text: He hauls her back through the corridor the way a seal returns to its case — boots skidding on polished wood, lantern stripes racing across her face.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] His hand closes on her wrist — not a lover's grip, [short pause] a clerk's. Fingers find the pulse the way he finds a misplaced line.
entries.game_text: His hand closes on her wrist — not a lover's grip, a clerk's. Fingers find the pulse the way he finds a misplaced line.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] The gate bars are down. Night watchmen pretend not to hear. They know whose seal buys silence in this quarter.
entries.game_text: The gate bars are down. Night watchmen pretend not to hear. They know whose seal buys silence in this quarter.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] She runs for the outer gate. Lacquer and iron have not opened for petitioners this late — only for magistrates who forgot to lock shame inside.
entries.game_text: She runs for the outer gate. Lacquer and iron have not opened for petitioners this late — only for magistrates who forgot to lock shame inside.

entries.text: [pause] She turns the corner too fast. Behind her, [short pause] boots do not hurry [dramatic] they count.
entries.game_text: She turns the corner too fast. Behind her, boots do not hurry — they count.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] Kakita Toe-uh will not be asked to sign it.
entries.game_text: Kakita Toa will not be asked to sign it.

entries.text: [dramatic] She twists. [short pause] Crane training was for stages and polite duels, not alley brawls. They have the numbers. She has pride, and pride does not block three men.
entries.game_text: She twists. Crane training was for stages and polite duels, not alley brawls. They have the numbers. She has pride, and pride does not block three men.

entries.text: [dramatic] [sad] She twists, Crane footwork in a space built for counting merchants, not dancers. [short pause] Pride swears the roll will clear. Physics disagrees.
entries.game_text: She twists, Crane footwork in a space built for counting merchants, not dancers. Pride swears the roll will clear. Physics disagrees.

entries.text: [dramatic] [sad] She lunges. [short pause] Pride, Crane training, the need to prove the Academy still owns her footwork. But Kurogane's cut is not a performance. [short pause] It is a dockman's arithmetic.
entries.game_text: She lunges. Pride, Crane training, the need to prove the Academy still owns her footwork. But Kurogane's cut is not a performance. It is a dockman's arithmetic.

entries.text: [dramatic] Case One's tray hasn't even cooled before the outer bell rings again. [short pause] Not the watch. Not the Miya envoy. [pauses] A Crane runner this time, clutching an empty satchel and a story that won't add up no matter how you stack it.
entries.game_text: Case One's tray hasn't even cooled before the outer bell rings again. Not the watch. Not the Miya envoy. A Crane runner this time, clutching an empty satchel and a story that won't add up no matter how you stack it.

entries.text: [dramatic] The warehouse district trades honesty for inventory and never feels the loss. [short pause] Rain has rinsed the cobbles clean, but not the soot. A narrow alley behind a rice broker's kiln still reeks of burned linen and Crane wax.
entries.game_text: The warehouse district trades honesty for inventory and never feels the loss. Rain has rinsed the cobbles clean, but not the soot. A narrow alley behind a rice broker's kiln still reeks of burned linen and Crane wax.

entries.text: [dramatic] Kneeling in the soot, [short pause] Toe-uh turns up a corner of lacquered board the fire never reached. The Academy's crane-in-flight crest, half melted, still unmistakable.
entries.game_text: Kneeling in the soot, Toa turns up a corner of lacquered board the fire never reached. The Academy's crane-in-flight crest, half melted, still unmistakable.

entries.text: [dramatic] [coldly] Rope burns ring the wrists. A thin cut tucked under the jaw. [short pause] Not the showy strangling Jiro wore, but the same hand could have practiced on both.
entries.game_text: Rope burns ring the wrists. A thin cut tucked under the jaw. Not the showy strangling Jiro wore, but the same hand could have practiced on both.

entries.text: [dramatic] The outer desk keeps what the alley couldn't burn. [short pause] A duplicate routing slip, stamped but never filed, listing the courier's satchel and a second name scribbled in the margin.
entries.game_text: The outer desk keeps what the alley couldn't burn. A duplicate routing slip, stamped but never filed, listing the courier's satchel and a second name scribbled in the margin.

entries.text: [dramatic] By afternoon the clerk has given up a warehouse foreman, the foreman has given up the Chrysanthemum factor's cousin, and the cousin has slipped out with the tide. [short pause] Not before Kaoru inks a duplicate Crane charter on emergency authority, though.
entries.game_text: By afternoon the clerk has given up a warehouse foreman, the foreman has given up the Chrysanthemum factor's cousin, and the cousin has slipped out with the tide. Not before Kaoru inks a duplicate Crane charter on emergency authority, though.

entries.text: [dramatic] The duplicate charter is barely cool when Kaoru locks the inner screen and slides a festival sash across the desk toward her. [short pause] Not court dress. Not witness black. Borrowed color, just for the night.
entries.game_text: The duplicate charter is barely cool when Kaoru locks the inner screen and slides a festival sash across the desk toward her. Not court dress. Not witness black. Borrowed color, just for the night.

entries.text: [calm] [dramatic] They slip out by the service stair. No hanko, no escort line. [short pause] They climb the lantern road until the canal city spills out below them like a tray of scattered coins.
entries.game_text: They slip out by the service stair. No hanko, no escort line. They climb the lantern road until the canal city spills out below them like a tray of scattered coins.

entries.text: [calm] [gently] A wooden bench on the overlook faces the whole of Ryoko Owari: [short pause] paper rivers winding between warehouses, drumbeats thin as a pulse, smoke from the food stalls threading up through the eaves.
entries.game_text: A wooden bench on the overlook faces the whole of Ryoko Owari: paper rivers winding between warehouses, drumbeats thin as a pulse, smoke from the food stalls threading up through the eaves.

entries.text: [dramatic] Fireworks climb over the canal for the chrysanthemum festival. [short pause] Chrysanthemum bursts, then falling embers that drown in the water, wrong-green and lovely. The first real chill of autumn has come off the water tonight. Toe-uh flinches at the first crack. Kaoru's hand finds her wrist, steady, proprietary.
entries.game_text: Fireworks climb over the canal for the chrysanthemum festival. Chrysanthemum bursts, then falling embers that drown in the water, wrong-green and lovely. The first real chill of autumn has come off the water tonight. Toa flinches at the first crack. Kaoru's hand finds her wrist, steady, proprietary.

entries.text: [gently] [tender] The next volley paints her white lashes gold. He doesn't let go.
entries.game_text: The next volley paints her white lashes gold. He doesn't let go.

entries.text: [tender] [softly] He kisses her there on the bench. No performance, no ink, [short pause] just his mouth warm against hers while the fireworks stutter overhead and the city pretends it's innocent.
entries.game_text: He kisses her there on the bench. No performance, no ink, just his mouth warm against hers while the fireworks stutter overhead and the city pretends it's innocent.

entries.text: [sad] [softly] Her smile stays right where he can see it. [short pause] Underneath, something dull settles in. Not heartbreak, not yet anything with a name, just the ache of wanting his nod to mean more than patronage.
entries.game_text: Her smile stays right where he can see it. Underneath, something dull settles in. Not heartbreak, not yet anything with a name, just the ache of wanting his nod to mean more than patronage.

entries.text: [whispers] [seductive] The breath of the shoji, the grain of lantern light. [short pause] Clothed silhouettes first, then the whisper of fabric. Implied, never filed, satisfaction with no ledger line to its name.
entries.game_text: The breath of the shoji, the grain of lantern light. Clothed silhouettes first, then the whisper of fabric. Implied, never filed, satisfaction with no ledger line to its name.

entries.text: [softly] [tender] By the time they dress, the fireworks have thinned to ash on the water. [short pause] Her obi sits straight again. His cuff is still warm.
entries.game_text: By the time they dress, the fireworks have thinned to ash on the water. Her obi sits straight again. His cuff is still warm.

entries.text: [dramatic] Lanterns gutter along the descent. [short pause] Somewhere below, a clerk is already stacking the first paper of Case Three. A name, a seal, a lie dressed up as courtesy.
entries.game_text: Lanterns gutter along the descent. Somewhere below, a clerk is already stacking the first paper of Case Three. A name, a seal, a lie dressed up as courtesy.

entries.text: [calm] [matter-of-fact] Case Two's ash is barely a day cold, still clinging to the duplicate charter, when the outer bell rings again. [short pause] Cloth this time, not blood. A bolt merchant's runner, and the seal in his hand smells of Scorpion wax.
entries.game_text: Case Two's ash is barely a day cold, still clinging to the duplicate charter, when the outer bell rings again. Cloth this time, not blood. A bolt merchant's runner, and the seal in his hand smells of Scorpion wax.

entries.text: [calm] [matter-of-fact] The shop smells of camphor and indigo. Bolts lean against the walls like courtiers dozing through a dull recital, and the paper tags flutter every time the street door breathes. [short pause] A clerk in Crane colors bows a touch too low, smiles a touch too fast.
entries.game_text: The shop smells of camphor and indigo. Bolts lean against the walls like courtiers dozing through a dull recital, and the paper tags flutter every time the street door breathes. A clerk in Crane colors bows a touch too low, smiles a touch too fast.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dramatic] Crimson, tagged Crane on the outside. [short pause] But the inner thread carries the six-legged mark of a Scorpion factor's private vat. Someone switched the labels before the tax count ever happened.
entries.game_text: Crimson, tagged Crane on the outside. But the inner thread carries the six-legged mark of a Scorpion factor's private vat. Someone switched the labels before the tax count ever happened.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [nervously] His hands start shaking the moment she asks for the wax. [short pause] A thin book surfaces from somewhere, night counts that will never match the day book Kaoru is about to seize at the door.
entries.game_text: His hands start shaking the moment she asks for the wax. A thin book surfaces from somewhere, night counts that will never match the day book Kaoru is about to seize at the door.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dramatic] Beneath the old lacquer the brace shows a clean saw kerf. [short pause] Deliberate. Recent. And the top shelf already leans a finger's width out toward the aisle.
entries.game_text: Beneath the old lacquer the brace shows a clean saw kerf. Deliberate. Recent. And the top shelf already leans a finger's width out toward the aisle.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [dramatic] The clerk excuses himself to fetch 'fresh seals.' The street door latches behind him. [short pause] Somewhere overhead, rope begins to groan, too much weight resting on too fresh a cut.
entries.game_text: The clerk excuses himself to fetch 'fresh seals.' The street door latches behind him. Somewhere overhead, rope begins to groan, too much weight resting on too fresh a cut.

entries.text: [dramatic] [breathless] A lantern sways. The top bolt shifts, [short pause] pale silk spilling loose like a white serpent uncoiling, and the shelf timber starts to scream.
entries.game_text: A lantern sways. The top bolt shifts, pale silk spilling loose like a white serpent uncoiling, and the shelf timber starts to scream.

entries.text: [dramatic] [breathless] The shelf gives. Silk slams the air, dust turns to falling snow. [short pause] Toe-uh has exactly one breath and two bad choices: scream for the man at the door, or prove Crane training can still save her on its own.
entries.game_text: The shelf gives. Silk slams the air, dust turns to falling snow. Toa has exactly one breath and two bad choices: scream for the man at the door, or prove Crane training can still save her on its own.

entries.text: [dramatic] [breathless] He is already moving. Not at the street door at all, but inside the line of the fall, [short pause] magistrate's coat thrown back, one arm hooking hard under her obi.
entries.game_text: He is already moving. Not at the street door at all, but inside the line of the fall, magistrate's coat thrown back, one arm hooking hard under her obi.

entries.text: [breathless] [tender] They hit the mat together, sideways, silk dragging across her cheek, [short pause] his breath hot against her temple, his heartbeat suddenly louder than any of the clerk's lies.
entries.game_text: They hit the mat together, sideways, silk dragging across her cheek, his breath hot against her temple, his heartbeat suddenly louder than any of the clerk's lies.

entries.text: [softly] [tender] For one whole heartbeat his grip does not loosen. [short pause] Grey eyes locked on hers, too honest, every ounce of performance stripped away.
entries.game_text: For one whole heartbeat his grip does not loosen. Grey eyes locked on hers, too honest, every ounce of performance stripped away.

entries.text: [calm] [matter-of-fact] By afternoon the clerk has given up the Chrysanthemum cousin's runner, the runner has given up a payment for the shelf, [short pause] and Kaoru inks a custody chit thick enough to survive one jealous factor's lawyers.
entries.game_text: By afternoon the clerk has given up the Chrysanthemum cousin's runner, the runner has given up a payment for the shelf, and Kaoru inks a custody chit thick enough to survive one jealous factor's lawyers.

entries.text: [calm] [tender] Case Three's first line is written into the file. [short pause] The city still lies, but she is still breathing in Ryoko Owari.
entries.game_text: Case Three's first line is written into the file. The city still lies, but she is still breathing in Ryoko Owari.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] The fabric-shop clerk's runner never made it to the canal office. [short pause] A dock watchman swears the man bolted for the lower piers with Case Three's night ledger under his arm, the grey wax on its cord still wet.
entries.game_text: The fabric-shop clerk's runner never made it to the canal office. A dock watchman swears the man bolted for the lower piers with Case Three's night ledger under his arm, the grey wax on its cord still wet.

entries.text: [dramatic] Rain hammers the compound before dawn. [short pause] Case Three's custody chit is barely dry when Kaoru pins a dock watchman's note beside the bolt-room saw kerf. Lower pier. Warehouse three. A foreman who signs his name in unmarked grey, Scorpion-trained under the lacquer.
entries.game_text: Rain hammers the compound before dawn. Case Three's custody chit is barely dry when Kaoru pins a dock watchman's note beside the bolt-room saw kerf. Lower pier. Warehouse three. A foreman who signs his name in unmarked grey, Scorpion-trained under the lacquer.

entries.text: [dramatic] [softly] The lower piers. [short pause] Tar ropes, split crates, that wrong shade of green breathing off the canal. Lanterns gutter in the rain, [short pause] and the mouth of the warehouse swallows every sound.
entries.game_text: The lower piers. Tar ropes, split crates, that wrong shade of green breathing off the canal. Lanterns gutter in the rain, and the mouth of the warehouse swallows every sound.

entries.text: [dramatic] A foreman steps out of the crate shadow, katana already drawn, rain streaming off shoulders the Scorpion trained. [short pause] He does not bow.
entries.game_text: A foreman steps out of the crate shadow, katana already drawn, rain streaming off shoulders the Scorpion trained. He does not bow.

entries.text: [dramatic] [breathless] Three blades in the rain. Kaoru's katana carves a clean arc, Toe-uh's wakizashi rides her dance-line, [short pause] and Kurogane's Scorpion cut keeps trying to split them apart. Crate wood splinters. [short pause] The footing underneath is blood-slick tar.
entries.game_text: Three blades in the rain. Kaoru's katana carves a clean arc, Toa's wakizashi rides her dance-line, and Kurogane's Scorpion cut keeps trying to split them apart. Crate wood splinters. The footing underneath is blood-slick tar.

entries.text: [dramatic] [breathless] Kurogane feints high, then drops low, his steel angled for her ribs instead of his. [short pause] One breath to choose. Crane footwork, [short pause] or the magistrate's shadow.
entries.game_text: Kurogane feints high, then drops low, his steel angled for her ribs instead of his. One breath to choose. Crane footwork, or the magistrate's shadow.

entries.text: [dramatic] She drops back a single step, but not into his shadow. [short pause] Her wakizashi rides the dance-line up and turns the foreman's low cut a hand's width wide, just long enough. Kaoru crosses into the opening she bought him, and his coat takes the edge that would have opened her ribs.
entries.game_text: She drops back a single step, but not into his shadow. Her wakizashi rides the dance-line up and turns the foreman's low cut a hand's width wide, just long enough. Kaoru crosses into the opening she bought him, and his coat takes the edge that would have opened her ribs.

entries.text: [dramatic] [breathless] Steel screams once. [short pause] Kurogane stumbles into the custody rope, not into mercy. Kaoru's sleeve is dark with rain, or with something worse, [short pause] and still his free hand finds her wrist and pins her behind his shoulder.
entries.game_text: Steel screams once. Kurogane stumbles into the custody rope, not into mercy. Kaoru's sleeve is dark with rain, or with something worse, and still his free hand finds her wrist and pins her behind his shoulder.

entries.text: [calm] [matter-of-fact] By dawn the foreman's manifest sits in custody beside Case Three's saw kerf. The clerk's runner has not vanished, only gone quiet, [short pause] and in Ryoko Owari that quiet is its own kind of confession.
entries.game_text: By dawn the foreman's manifest sits in custody beside Case Three's saw kerf. The clerk's runner has not vanished, only gone quiet, and in Ryoko Owari that quiet is its own kind of confession.

entries.text: [pause] [dramatic] Rain beads on the canal rope. The clerk studies his wax tablet. Kaoru's hand closes on her elbow — escort, not comfort — and the compound swallows them.
entries.game_text: Rain beads on the canal rope. The clerk studies his wax tablet. Kaoru's hand closes on her elbow — escort, not comfort — and the compound swallows them.

entries.text: [dramatic] He files witness attachment the way clerks file tax. [short pause] Her whole season is already columned on his desk, five cases on one witness chain, and he never once said yoriki.
entries.game_text: He files witness attachment the way clerks file tax. Her whole season is already columned on his desk, five cases on one witness chain, and he never once said yoriki.

entries.text: [dramatic] She climbs back from the archive with the canal docket hugged to her chest. [short pause] No adjoining chamber waits beside his office, only four more files stacked behind Case One, and a season to prove she belongs to any of them.
entries.game_text: She climbs back from the archive with the canal docket hugged to her chest. No adjoining chamber waits beside his office, only four more files stacked behind Case One, and a season to prove she belongs to any of them.

entries.text: Three mornings after the dock's steel went quiet, the runner does not bring breakfast. He brings a summons, ink still wet, pleasure-quarter seal copied twice as if the clerk feared forgery.
entries.game_text: Three mornings after the dock's steel went quiet, the runner does not bring breakfast. He brings a summons, ink still wet, pleasure-quarter seal copied twice as if the clerk feared forgery.

entries.text: She packs Crane neatness into a travel kosode, the kind one wears when patronage ends and the gate guard asks for paper she no longer has.
entries.game_text: She packs Crane neatness into a travel kosode, the kind one wears when patronage ends and the gate guard asks for paper she no longer has.

entries.text: Ryoko Owari's open docket hall smells of wet stone and copied petitions. Quarter clerks line the left wall; a Crane envoy's crest sits cold on the right. Someone in the back row wears another magistrate's colors without sitting in the seat.
entries.game_text: Ryoko Owari's open docket hall smells of wet stone and copied petitions. Quarter clerks line the left wall; a Crane envoy's crest sits cold on the right. Someone in the back row wears another magistrate's colors without sitting in the seat.

entries.text: The Crane envoy does not stand. His silence is its own letter to Shiro no Yogen.
entries.game_text: The Crane envoy does not stand. His silence is its own letter to Shiro no Yogen.

entries.text: [dramatic] The envoy exhales once, not a blessing, only a tally of who gains. [short pause] The rival magistrate's colors leave before the wax cools.
entries.game_text: The envoy exhales once, not a blessing, only a tally of who gains. The rival magistrate's colors leave before the wax cools.

entries.text: [calm] The inner office after public ink feels smaller than the hearing hall. He locks the corridor himself. No runner, no cushion joke, only cedar and the heat of wax that will not cool before he touches her again.
entries.game_text: The inner office after public ink feels smaller than the hearing hall. He locks the corridor himself. No runner, no cushion joke, only cedar and the heat of wax that will not cool before he touches her again.

entries.text: [calm] She does not perform Crane purity behind his screen. She wants him honestly, without asking him to be kinder, only there, proprietary, filed under a heading she still refuses to name.
entries.game_text: She does not perform Crane purity behind his screen. She wants him honestly, without asking him to be kinder, only there, proprietary, filed under a heading she still refuses to name.

entries.text: [dramatic] The first week as his sworn left hand is not a triumph procession. [short pause] It is runners, copied seals, and a quarter walk where the okami nod at her sash instead of her obi.
entries.game_text: The first week as his sworn left hand is not a triumph procession. It is runners, copied seals, and a quarter walk where the okami nod at her sash instead of her obi.

entries.text: She does not say love. He does not offer it. Ryoko Owari has a name on his left hand, and a week that has only begun.
entries.game_text: She does not say love. He does not offer it. Ryoko Owari has a name on his left hand, and a week that has only begun.

entries.text: The hearing hall does not open for witness-only paper. A clerk stamps discharge instead of appointment, and the pleasure-quarter seal on the summons is filed as bait, not verdict.
entries.game_text: The hearing hall does not open for witness-only paper. A clerk stamps discharge instead of appointment, and the pleasure-quarter seal on the summons is filed as bait, not verdict.

entries.text: Afternoon off the ledger: no case number, no runner, only steam under the kotatsu and mikan peel curling on the tray.
entries.game_text: Afternoon off the ledger: no case number, no runner, only steam under the kotatsu and mikan peel curling on the tray.

entries.text: [dramatic] She passes him a segment anyway. [short pause] He takes it without looking, as if hunger were a secret he refused to file, and her fingers on the peel a form he meant to seal later.
entries.game_text: She passes him a segment anyway. He takes it without looking, as if hunger were a secret he refused to file, and her fingers on the peel a form he meant to seal later.

entries.text: [calm] Rain ticks the eaves. The kotatsu holds their warmth and the peel and the almost-smile he will deny tomorrow. Ryoko Owari lies elsewhere. Here, for once, it does not matter who holds the key.
entries.game_text: Rain ticks the eaves. The kotatsu holds their warmth and the peel and the almost-smile he will deny tomorrow. Ryoko Owari lies elsewhere. Here, for once, it does not matter who holds the key.

entries.text: The corner of his mouth twitches. Not quite a smile.
entries.game_text: The corner of his mouth twitches. Not quite a smile.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] Chains in a pleasure-quarter back room are still filed under Emerald business when the name on the scroll is not hers.
entries.game_text: Chains in a pleasure-quarter back room are still filed under Emerald business when the name on the scroll is not hers.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] Holding cells under the magistrate hall learn a dancer's name the way the canal learns ash, slowly, and without mercy.
entries.game_text: Holding cells under the magistrate hall learn a dancer's name the way the canal learns ash, slowly, and without mercy.

entries.text: [dramatic] The scroll stays open a breath, then he rolls it closed himself. [short pause] Quarter clerks on the left wall stop pretending they are not listening. No one reaches for chains. This is a parting, not a sentence.
entries.game_text: The scroll stays open a breath, then he rolls it closed himself. Quarter clerks on the left wall stop pretending they are not listening. No one reaches for chains. This is a parting, not a sentence.

entries.text: [dramatic] The Crane envoy's crest finally rises. [short pause] Whatever he writes home tonight, it will not be a scandal. It will be a dancer who kept her own name in a city that collects them.
entries.game_text: The Crane envoy's crest finally rises. Whatever he writes home tonight, it will not be a scandal. It will be a dancer who kept her own name in a city that collects them.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] Cedar oil and lantern steam. Iron finds her wrist where Crane footwork never taught her to break a magistrate's grip.
entries.game_text: Cedar oil and lantern steam. Iron finds her wrist where Crane footwork never taught her to break a magistrate's grip.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] An okami counts coin without looking at her face. Kaoru's footsteps leave before the first lock clicks.
entries.game_text: An okami counts coin without looking at her face. Kaoru's footsteps leave before the first lock clicks.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] What the quarter collects is not entered where clerks can cite it. Only the ache, if she survives the night.
entries.game_text: What the quarter collects is not entered where clerks can cite it. Only the ache, if she survives the night.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] Stone under the magistrate hall is colder than canal water. Her kosode tears on an iron hinge someone forgot to file as sharp.
entries.game_text: Stone under the magistrate hall is colder than canal water. Her kosode tears on an iron hinge someone forgot to file as sharp.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] A clerk slides wax paper under the grate. Not the yoriki scroll. A companion chit, quarter escort, temporary, the kind that buys silence.
entries.game_text: A clerk slides wax paper under the grate. Not the yoriki scroll. A companion chit, quarter escort, temporary, the kind that buys silence.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] His hanko lands while her pride is still screaming. The hall does not echo. It only records.
entries.game_text: His hanko lands while her pride is still screaming. The hall does not echo. It only records.

entries.text: [pause] [calm] The holding cell learns her thumbprint before she learns to stop shaking. No yoriki characters. Only file ink.
entries.game_text: The holding cell learns her thumbprint before she learns to stop shaking. No yoriki characters. Only file ink.

entries.text: [calm] [tender] Case One has its spine on the tray now, though this part never gets a number. [short pause] Call it the kitchen seal. It is the first night she slept on the far side of his screen, and the midday she tried to cook her gratitude straight into a pot.
entries.game_text: Case One has its spine on the tray now, though this part never gets a number. Call it the kitchen seal. It is the first night she slept on the far side of his screen, and the midday she tried to cook her gratitude straight into a pot.

entries.text: [calm] [matter-of-fact] It is the first night after she moved into the adjoining chamber. [short pause] The terms are the same ones from the companion menu. Past the inner screen, down the left corridor, [short pause] and do not, under any circumstances, rearrange his shelves.
entries.game_text: It is the first night after she moved into the adjoining chamber. The terms are the same ones from the companion menu. Past the inner screen, down the left corridor, and do not, under any circumstances, rearrange his shelves.

entries.text: [softly] [calm] Paper keeps rustling on his side of the shoji. She lies there counting ceiling beams instead of sheep, [short pause] and somewhere past the magistrate wing a night clerk stamps a form she will never get to read.
entries.game_text: Paper keeps rustling on his side of the shoji. She lies there counting ceiling beams instead of sheep, and somewhere past the magistrate wing a night clerk stamps a form she will never get to read.

entries.text: [dramatic] The footsteps stop. [short pause] Fabric whispers in the dark. A quilt lands on her side of the screen, heavy wool, unmistakably his, smelling of cedar, ink, and the sleep he will never admit to losing. Paper keeps rustling on his side anyway, as if some sealed bundle on the outer desk were already listening.
entries.game_text: The footsteps stop. Fabric whispers in the dark. A quilt lands on her side of the screen, heavy wool, unmistakably his, smelling of cedar, ink, and the sleep he will never admit to losing. Paper keeps rustling on his side anyway, as if some sealed bundle on the outer desk were already listening.

entries.text: [calm] [matter-of-fact] Midday after the barge, with Case Two's letters still waiting unopened on the outer desk. [short pause] The magistrate wing kitchen smells of curry roux and a little guilt.
entries.game_text: Midday after the barge, with Case Two's letters still waiting unopened on the outer desk. The magistrate wing kitchen smells of curry roux and a little guilt.

entries.text: [calm] [tender] He eats without praise and without flinching, [short pause] as though his jurisdiction now extends to broth.
entries.game_text: He eats without praise and without flinching, as though his jurisdiction now extends to broth.

entries.text: [calm] [tender] No new case number lands on her desk. [short pause] Only the steam, and the seal tucked back into his sleeve where it belongs.
entries.game_text: No new case number lands on her desk. Only the steam, and the seal tucked back into his sleeve where it belongs.

entries.text: [softly] [tense] The wing goes quiet. [short pause] Then paper scratches on his side of the shoji, deliberate, filing the dark. [short pause] Rice paper tears once, not theater. [short pause] Warm breath ghosts through the gap before she has counted another beam.
entries.game_text: The wing goes quiet. Then paper scratches on his side of the shoji, deliberate, filing the dark. Rice paper tears once, not theater. Warm breath ghosts through the gap before she has counted another beam.

entries.text: [intimate] [softly] Tan fingers close on her pale wrist through the torn panel. [short pause] Shallow light, shallow depth. [short pause] Her sob against the grain is evidence he catalogs without sharing her name with any clerk who sells courage by the cup.
entries.game_text: Tan fingers close on her pale wrist through the torn panel. Shallow light, shallow depth. Her sob against the grain is evidence he catalogs without sharing her name with any clerk who sells courage by the cup.

entries.text: [dramatic] When it ends she does not perform purity. [short pause] She crawls back to her futon with his blanket over her shoulders and something private cooling between her thighs, a sealed bundle of letters glaring from the outer desk like a runner who already knows too much.
entries.game_text: When it ends she does not perform purity. She crawls back to her futon with his blanket over her shoulders and something private cooling between her thighs, a sealed bundle of letters glaring from the outer desk like a runner who already knows too much.

entries.text: [intimate] [softly] His thumb finds the collar cord instead of her palm. [short pause] Gold brocade, rose obi edge, skin warming under linen that is not office kosode. [short pause] Shallow focus, shallow mercy.
entries.game_text: His thumb finds the collar cord instead of her palm. Gold brocade, rose obi edge, skin warming under linen that is not office kosode. Shallow focus, shallow mercy.

entries.text: [intimate] [softly] Rain needles the strakes. [short pause] One closed eye, white lashes wet as paper, silver hair stuck to her temple. [short pause] Lantern bokeh bleeds gold across the gunwale while she holds still for him.
entries.game_text: Rain needles the strakes. One closed eye, white lashes wet as paper, silver hair stuck to her temple. Lantern bokeh bleeds gold across the gunwale while she holds still for him.

entries.text: [tense] [intimate] His tanned grip finds her pale wrist on wet wood. [short pause] Kimono cuffs, shallow depth, the kobune rocking like a clerk trying to lie under pressure.
entries.game_text: His tanned grip finds her pale wrist on wet wood. Kimono cuffs, shallow depth, the kobune rocking like a clerk trying to lie under pressure.

entries.text: [softly] [intimate] His hand covers the yoriki seal on the inner desk, brown fingers, red wax still warm, as if the oath were a body he could keep off the public tray.
entries.game_text: His hand covers the yoriki seal on the inner desk, brown fingers, red wax still warm, as if the oath were a body he could keep off the public tray.

entries.text: [warm] [softly] Under the quilt edge, bare ankles and shared heat, wool and skin and the shallow depth of a room that keeps no ledger. [short pause] Tactile warmth, not performance.
entries.game_text: Under the quilt edge, bare ankles and shared heat, wool and skin and the shallow depth of a room that keeps no ledger. Tactile warmth, not performance.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] SUMMARY ONLY. Witness names redacted per magistrate seal.
entries.game_text: SUMMARY ONLY. Witness names redacted per magistrate seal.

entries.text: [dramatic] Matter: administrative. No body. No numbered case file after closure.
entries.game_text: Matter: administrative. No body. No numbered case file after closure.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Subject: Kitsu Kaoru, Emerald Magistrate, Ryoko Owari quarter. Period: three mornings prior to interclan renewal spike.
entries.game_text: Subject: Kitsu Kaoru, Emerald Magistrate, Ryoko Owari quarter. Period: three mornings prior to interclan renewal spike.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Witness A ████████ (tea clerk): left cups at the inner desk. Subject did not drink.
entries.game_text: Witness A ████████ (tea clerk): left cups at the inner desk. Subject did not drink.

entries.text: [dramatic] Witness B ████████ (runner, age twelve): delivered three summonses across the Hour of the Tiger, each a few breaths apart. [short pause] Subject signed without looking up.
entries.game_text: Witness B ████████ (runner, age twelve): delivered three summonses across the Hour of the Tiger, each a few breaths apart. Subject signed without looking up.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Witness C ████████ (puppeteer, street): performed villain motive incorrectly. Subject corrected from window. No arrest.
entries.game_text: Witness C ████████ (puppeteer, street): performed villain motive incorrectly. Subject corrected from window. No arrest.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Witness D ████████ (Ronin-adjacent): escorted per House of Falling Lanterns arithmetic. Subject ordered door closed.
entries.game_text: Witness D ████████ (Ronin-adjacent): escorted per House of Falling Lanterns arithmetic. Subject ordered door closed.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Finding: subject maintained ledger discipline. Emotional display: none recorded.
entries.game_text: Finding: subject maintained ledger discipline. Emotional display: none recorded.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Recommendation: file under patronage appetite, spendable witnesses, proprietary corridor. Open next docket when renewal petition arrives.
entries.game_text: Recommendation: file under patronage appetite, spendable witnesses, proprietary corridor. Open next docket when renewal petition arrives.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] First morning. Rain on the eaves like a clerk tapping a stamp.
entries.game_text: First morning. Rain on the eaves like a clerk tapping a stamp.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] One cup at the desk corner. Steam gone. The magistrate reads a drowning report and does not touch it.
entries.game_text: One cup at the desk corner. Steam gone. The magistrate reads a drowning report and does not touch it.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Second morning. Heavier rain. Two cups, both empty, lined up like failed petitions.
entries.game_text: Second morning. Heavier rain. Two cups, both empty, lined up like failed petitions.
