entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Third morning. The canal smells wrong-green through the palace eaves. Three cups. The ledger line for interclan renewal stays blank one more day.
entries.game_text: Third morning. The canal smells wrong-green through the palace eaves. Three cups. The ledger line for interclan renewal stays blank one more day.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] He almost smiled at that. His mouth considered it and filed the motion under denied.
entries.game_text: He almost smiled at that. His mouth considered it and filed the motion under denied.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Almost-smile inventory, magistrate wing, prior week. All entries denied.
entries.game_text: Almost-smile inventory, magistrate wing, prior week. All entries denied.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] He sets the inventory on the desk beside the unused cups. Somewhere under wool and citrus, a future afternoon will ask for an almost-smile again. He intends to deny it until the ledger stops counting.
entries.game_text: He sets the inventory on the desk beside the unused cups. Somewhere under wool and citrus, a future afternoon will ask for an almost-smile again. He intends to deny it until the ledger stops counting.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] The runner is twelve and paid per stair. His name is not for this file.
entries.game_text: The runner is twelve and paid per stair. His name is not for this file.

entries.text: [softly] [tender] First bell of the Tiger. [short pause] Summons packet, third copy, wax still warm from the night clerk. Magistrate wing, inner screen, do not knock like a petitioner who wants theater.
entries.game_text: First bell of the Tiger. Summons packet, third copy, wax still warm from the night clerk. Magistrate wing, inner screen, do not knock like a petitioner who wants theater.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] He kneels at the threshold and slides the paper under the gap. Through the crack he sees legs crossed on tatami, maroon hem, ink-stained fingers holding a seal.
entries.game_text: He kneels at the threshold and slides the paper under the gap. Through the crack he sees legs crossed on tatami, maroon hem, ink-stained fingers holding a seal.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Grey eyes lift once. Not to the boy. To the docket line where the signature belongs.
entries.game_text: Grey eyes lift once. Not to the boy. To the docket line where the signature belongs.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] The inner screen opens two fingers wide. A hand takes the summons. Stamp. The hand does not pat his head or say thank you.
entries.game_text: The inner screen opens two fingers wide. A hand takes the summons. Stamp. The hand does not pat his head or say thank you.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] From inside, a voice the boy will not quote to friends because friends disappear in this quarter:

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] The screen shuts. The boy runs down the archive stairs counting coin he already earned. The magistrate never spoke to the corridor. He never speaks to you.
entries.game_text: The screen shuts. The boy runs down the archive stairs counting coin he already earned. The magistrate never spoke to the corridor. He never speaks to you.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Midday. Rain thins to mist. From the magistrate window the canal road is a stage the city forgot to charge admission for.
entries.game_text: Midday. Rain thins to mist. From the magistrate window the canal road is a stage the city forgot to charge admission for.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] A puppet show: villain in Scorpion purple, merchant in Crane white, a love plot the puppeteer sells with extra flourishes.
entries.game_text: A puppet show: villain in Scorpion purple, merchant in Crane white, a love plot the puppeteer sells with extra flourishes.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] The villain confesses greed. The children boo on cue. Kaoru watches from the sill with a cup he still will not drink.
entries.game_text: The villain confesses greed. The children boo on cue. Kaoru watches from the sill with a cup he still will not drink.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Down on the stones the puppeteer bows to the empty window, not knowing who corrected him. Kaoru does not applaud.
entries.game_text: Down on the stones the puppeteer bows to the empty window, not knowing who corrected him. Kaoru does not applaud.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Night. Same rain geometry the quarter uses when it sells what the ledger will not keep.
entries.game_text: Night. Same rain geometry the quarter uses when it sells what the ledger will not keep.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Side alley between two shuttered tea houses. Dry enough to stand. Narrow enough to trap. The canal breathes wrong-green at the mouth.
entries.game_text: Side alley between two shuttered tea houses. Dry enough to stand. Narrow enough to trap. The canal breathes wrong-green at the mouth.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] A woman without a chop. Not a petitioner for this story. A witness he could escort to the watch, or sign temporary custody, or pretend he did not see.
entries.game_text: A woman without a chop. Not a petitioner for this story. A witness he could escort to the watch, or sign temporary custody, or pretend he did not see.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Ronin arithmetic gathers at the alley lip. House of Falling Lanterns coin. Pretty hair. Wet obi. No magistrate escort.
entries.game_text: Ronin arithmetic gathers at the alley lip. House of Falling Lanterns coin. Pretty hair. Wet obi. No magistrate escort.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] She reaches for his sleeve. He steps back into the rain where ink belongs.
entries.game_text: She reaches for his sleeve. He steps back into the rain where ink belongs.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] He signs a chit the ronin expect. Not her name. A fee line. The okami's arithmetic completes without him watching the cart.
entries.game_text: He signs a chit the ronin expect. Not her name. A fee line. The okami's arithmetic completes without him watching the cart.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] The alley door shuts on someone else's fate. Harsh mercy: the ledger stays clean, the magistrate keeps his hands dry, Ryoko Owari keeps chewing what it cannot classify.
entries.game_text: The alley door shuts on someone else's fate. Harsh mercy: the ledger stays clean, the magistrate keeps his hands dry, Ryoko Owari keeps chewing what it cannot classify.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] He walks back through rain that does not distinguish brothel geography from magistrate corridors. Dread is a clerk who already stamped tomorrow.
entries.game_text: He walks back through rain that does not distinguish brothel geography from magistrate corridors. Dread is a clerk who already stamped tomorrow.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] The tea clerk waits one breath too long, hoping he will sip and soften. He signs her overtime chit instead and sends her back to the kitchen.
entries.game_text: The tea clerk waits one breath too long, hoping he will sip and soften. He signs her overtime chit instead and sends her back to the kitchen.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Water streaks the window until the canal road is only lantern smears and the shape of a city that charges rent on visibility.
entries.game_text: Water streaks the window until the canal road is only lantern smears and the shape of a city that charges rent on visibility.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] On the outer desk a renewal spike notice waits unopened. Somewhere in the noble quarter a Crane without local ink is still on the road. He knows the type before the knock.
entries.game_text: On the outer desk a renewal spike notice waits unopened. Somewhere in the noble quarter a Crane without local ink is still on the road. He knows the type before the knock.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Proprietary hunger is not romance. It is the appetite to own a corridor, a witness schedule, a body that signs where he points. He writes the distinction on a scrap and tucks it with the seal.
entries.game_text: Proprietary hunger is not romance. It is the appetite to own a corridor, a witness schedule, a body that signs where he points. He writes the distinction on a scrap and tucks it with the seal.

entries.text: [dramatic] Second bell of the Tiger. [short pause] Second packet. Same crack. Same eyes on the line. Same stamp like a heartbeat the boy learns to fear and need.
entries.game_text: Second bell of the Tiger. Second packet. Same crack. Same eyes on the line. Same stamp like a heartbeat the boy learns to fear and need.

entries.text: [dramatic] A third bell, late in the Hour of the Tiger. [short pause] Third packet. The boy's knees hurt. Through the gap he sees the magistrate pour a cup of water and leave it untouched beside three tea cups that were never his.
entries.game_text: A third bell, late in the Hour of the Tiger. Third packet. The boy's knees hurt. Through the gap he sees the magistrate pour a cup of water and leave it untouched beside three tea cups that were never his.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] The boy understands, without words, that the man inside drinks nothing offered and takes everything that signs.
entries.game_text: The boy understands, without words, that the man inside drinks nothing offered and takes everything that signs.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Patronage appetite sits in his chest like a second seal. He watches the puppet merchant die for love and knows the city sells a prettier lie because pretty lies keep the quarter spending.
entries.game_text: Patronage appetite sits in his chest like a second seal. He watches the puppet merchant die for love and knows the city sells a prettier lie because pretty lies keep the quarter spending.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] She testified last week on a forgery line. Useful mouth. Spendable now that the factor paid the other side.
entries.game_text: She testified last week on a forgery line. Useful mouth. Spendable now that the factor paid the other side.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] The same geometry a soaked Crane girl will meet if she walks out without his seal. Kaoru knows the map because he helped draw the lines.
entries.game_text: The same geometry a soaked Crane girl will meet if she walks out without his seal. Kaoru knows the map because he helped draw the lines.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] From the cart lane he hears nothing he is required to record. Aftercare of power is a dry sleeve and a walk back to cedar where the cups wait, untouched.
entries.game_text: From the cart lane he hears nothing he is required to record. Aftercare of power is a dry sleeve and a walk back to cedar where the cups wait, untouched.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Tomorrow someone will knock the wrong door and he will call it scheduling. Tonight he lets the dread sit in his gut like cold tea.
entries.game_text: Tomorrow someone will knock the wrong door and he will call it scheduling. Tonight he lets the dread sit in his gut like cold tea.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] He washes his hands. The basin reflects a magistrate, not a man. Good. Men soften. Magistrates stamp.
entries.game_text: He washes his hands. The basin reflects a magistrate, not a man. Good. Men soften. Magistrates stamp.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] On the tray he aligns the unused cups with the water he poured for himself. Four vessels. Zero admissions. The docket is ready.
entries.game_text: On the tray he aligns the unused cups with the water he poured for himself. Four vessels. Zero admissions. The docket is ready.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Footsteps in the noble quarter. Lost. Crisp. A permit book clicking like obi bells.
entries.game_text: Footsteps in the noble quarter. Lost. Crisp. A permit book clicking like obi bells.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] He does not rise. Petitioners come to his desk or they do not come at all.
entries.game_text: He does not rise. Petitioners come to his desk or they do not come at all.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] The knock is wrong. Too eager. Too Crane. He almost smiles. Denied.
entries.game_text: The knock is wrong. Too eager. Too Crane. He almost smiles. Denied.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Case Zero ends where Case One begins: a door, a seal, a hunger dressed as law.
entries.game_text: Case Zero ends where Case One begins: a door, a seal, a hunger dressed as law.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] The docket opens on the other side of the screen.
entries.game_text: The docket opens on the other side of the screen.

entries.text: [dry] Rain needles the harbor glass. Under the municipal licensing tower, the parking structure is a cathedral of dripping concrete, fluorescents buzzing while ferries cough diesel into the channel below. This is where Kakita Toe-uh starts the morning she means to spend fixing her papers, and where Ryoko Port quietly decides it will not be that simple.
entries.game_text: Rain needles the harbor glass. Under the municipal licensing tower, the parking structure is a cathedral of dripping concrete, fluorescents buzzing while ferries cough diesel into the channel below. This is where Kakita Toa starts the morning she means to spend fixing her papers, and where Ryoko Port quietly decides it will not be that simple.

entries.text: [dry] Ryoko Port keeps its appointments under fluorescent mercy and never apologizes for the weather. The municipal tower hums like a printer that learned to judge people. Floor fourteen B belongs to the Ryoko Port Arts Council, the board that decides which artists the port will license at all, and renewing the sponsorship she had let lapse was supposed to be the easy part of her morning.

entries.text: [dry] Toe-uh clutches a tablet sleeve, expired sponsorship packet, and the personal stamp she was told to bring to every bureaucratic threshold. Crane logo on her rehearsal jacket, not costume. Ballet flats soaked through anyway.
entries.game_text: Toa clutches a tablet sleeve, expired sponsorship packet, and the personal stamp she was told to bring to every bureaucratic threshold. Crane logo on her rehearsal jacket, not costume. Ballet flats soaked through anyway.

entries.text: [dry] On the deputy director's monitor, an Arts Council board member freezes mid-objection. The hearing is live, unmuted, gallery view tiled with councilors and clerks who have never danced for a living. The chat scrolls before she has finished apologizing.
entries.game_text: On the deputy director's monitor, an Arts Council board member freezes mid-objection. The hearing is live, unmuted, gallery view tiled with councilors and clerks who have never danced for a living. The chat scrolls before she has finished apologizing.

entries.text: [dry] At the Arts Council intake counter two wings over, a junior clerk squints at her packet, circles the expiration date a second time in the same red, and points her back the way she came. Intake takes the form. Intake does not sign it.
entries.game_text: At the Arts Council intake counter two wings over, a junior clerk squints at her packet, circles the expiration date a second time in the same red, and points her back the way she came. Intake takes the form. Intake does not sign it.

entries.text: [dry] Toe-uh straightens her rehearsal jacket, breathes, and tries not to look like a dancer lost in a tax form. Pride and panic share a spine.
entries.game_text: Toa straightens her rehearsal jacket, breathes, and tries not to look like a dancer lost in a tax form. Pride and panic share a spine.

entries.text: [dry] He does not look up from two monitors until she sits in the chair beside the screen, not the one facing him. Witness posture lives there, he says later. Stage posture dies in the chat.
entries.game_text: He does not look up from two monitors until she sits in the chair beside the screen, not the one facing him. Witness posture lives there, he says later. Stage posture dies in the chat.

entries.text: [dry] Toe-uh kept her hands on her knees and her eyes on the edge of his monitor, where rain smeared the window. Every syllable landed on her spine like a sticker she could not peel off.
entries.game_text: Toa kept her hands on her knees and her eyes on the edge of his monitor, where rain smeared the window. Every syllable landed on her spine like a sticker she could not peel off.

entries.text: [dry] Yellow paper slides across the desk edge in block letters. [short pause] Do not speak unless prompted. Dates and names only. A second note repeats the difference: witness posture, not performance posture. Someone laughed in a tile and muted themselves. Kaoru unmuted no one.
entries.game_text: Yellow paper slides across the desk edge in block letters. Do not speak unless prompted. Dates and names only. A second note repeats the difference: witness posture, not performance posture. Someone laughed in a tile and muted themselves. Kaoru unmuted no one.

entries.text: [dry] When the board member asks whether Arts Council intake sent her, Kaoru says intake sent her to the wrong floor, so he is intake now. That is not comfort. It is jurisdiction, and she discovers she prefers jurisdiction to kindness, because kindness in this port always arrives with an expiration date and a clerk who is not looking at your packet when it lands.

entries.text: [dry] When the hearing ends without praise, he hands her a studio key and a hallway that smells of floor wax and rain. The city rents the rehearsal room by the hour to applicants who need to prove, in a mirror, that they are more than a packet error. Prove it, and the deputy signs. That is the only fast track Ryoko Port actually keeps.

entries.text: [dry] Mirror wall. [short pause] Barre. Rain ticking the glass like a clerk tapping a stamp. She runs the phrase once. Apology still lives in her shoulders. He counts under his breath like a man checking witness notes, not applause.
entries.game_text: Mirror wall. Barre. Rain ticking the glass like a clerk tapping a stamp. She runs the phrase once. Apology still lives in her shoulders. He counts under his breath like a man checking witness notes, not applause.

entries.text: [dry] Building hour passes six. The official business is filed, the contract floor goes dark, and the public elevators sigh into standby one by one. Only the service lift still answers when he badges it, a dull metal box that does not appear on the map tourists photograph.
entries.game_text: Building hour passes six. The official business is filed, the contract floor goes dark, and the public elevators sigh into standby one by one. Only the service lift still answers when he badges it, a dull metal box that does not appear on the map tourists photograph.

entries.text: [dramatic] Rain stripes the glass on the way down. The car shudders once, as if the building cleared its throat. His badge taps the reader on a floor that does not appear on the public map.
entries.game_text: Rain stripes the glass on the way down. The car shudders once, as if the building cleared its throat. His badge taps the reader on a floor that does not appear on the public map.

entries.text: [softly] She does not pretend, afterward, that nothing happened between them. His mouth found hers against the rain-streaked glass. His hand learned her waist and stopped before the filing finished. Whatever the service lift was, every form that matters will still file it as sponsorship: after-hours rehearsal access, logged under the exclusive rider she signed with her eyes open. The seal stays professional on paper. The rest stays off the public record, which is exactly what that rider is for.

entries.text: [tender] The next midday she comes back to the tower, not as a lost applicant this time but as a woman cooking thank-you curry in the municipal break room, which smells of roux and a little guilt. Fluorescents hum. Rain keeps filing itself against the window. Somewhere upstairs a printer jams and someone swears with the tenderness of a prayer.

entries.text: [warmly] He eats without praise and without flinching, as though his jurisdiction now extends to broth. Toe-uh watches his chopsticks and tries not to hope too visibly.
entries.game_text: He eats without praise and without flinching, as though his jurisdiction now extends to broth. Toa watches his chopsticks and tries not to hope too visibly.

entries.text: [warmly] The sponsorship contract returns to her tablet sleeve with a fresh effective date. [short pause] Three business days. Not a love letter. Still binding. She reads the effective line twice because numbers are safer than whatever lives in her chest when he stands too close.

entries.text: [softly] After hours, his office couch accepts two people who will sleep clothed under one blanket, still calling it sponsorship on every form that matters. Harbor lights smear across the window.
entries.game_text: After hours, his office couch accepts two people who will sleep clothed under one blanket, still calling it sponsorship on every form that matters. Harbor lights smear across the window.

entries.text: [warmly] Clementines on the armrest, bright as small suns he will deny noticing. [short pause] Shared blanket. Almost-smile inventory: denied, pending, denied again.
entries.game_text: Clementines on the armrest, bright as small suns he will deny noticing. Shared blanket. Almost-smile inventory: denied, pending, denied again.

entries.text: [dry] The wellness corridor is a row of Council-licensed calm: massage studios, float tanks, candle rhetoric under one neon awning, every storefront holding an operating license his office issued. This is the first inspection her witness clause requires her to stand through. Deputy Director Kitsu Kaoru walks it like the queue is already behind him.

entries.text: [dry] They move through treatment rooms that are legally not treatment rooms. Not until the inspector says otherwise.

entries.text: [dry] He moves. The corridor exhales eucalyptus and defeat.
entries.game_text: He moves. The corridor exhales eucalyptus and defeat.

entries.text: [dramatic] For ten seconds the hallway is only rain on glass, clipboard metal, and a man deciding whether calm is a job title or a threat.

entries.text: [dry] The service elevator remembers them from the wrong-floor building. [short pause] Rain stripes the glass. Proximity becomes paperwork if you stare at it long enough.

entries.text: [softly] Their reflections almost touch in the glass. Neither reaches. The lift dings like a stamp.

entries.text: [dry] Saturday, and the harbor ferry schedule is a suggestion. [short pause] Rain owns the channel. entries.text: [softly] At midnight she hears him typing. [short pause] At one she hears the rain stop pretending to be subtle. At two she does not cross the room. That is also witness work.

entries.text: [dry] The Arts Council is the body that decides who gets to make art in this port and who only gets the queue. It funds the performing-arts sponsorships, licenses the venues and storefronts, and streams its hearings straight onto the public record. A sponsorship is the Council's permission slip: with one, a transfer dancer may legally rehearse, perform, be paid, and stay. Without one she is a tourist with good posture and a packet six weeks expired.

entries.text: [dry] The sponsorship itself is plain enough once someone explains the boxes. The Arts Council authorizes her to work as a performing artist in the port, and the deputy director's signature on the form vouches to the Council that she will not embarrass the seal that funds her. The riders do not change that. They only decide how close the deputy who signed it has to stand while his name is the one on the permit. Both riders carry the same fine print, the witness clause: a fast-tracked artist must attend the deputy's inspections and document living proof for the Council that he does not hand permits to dancers he happens to favor. She does not learn what that costs until later. Today it is only a line she initials. The standard performance rider is the distant one: scheduled compliance reviews during business hours, discretion about municipal accounts, no city seal cropped into a meme. The witness clause still applies: she documents his inspections on the record so the Council can see he is not inventing dancers or playing favorites. Independence stays intact. Proximity stays professional. The queue remembers you as an artist who filed boring paperwork and kept her distance. The exclusive rehearsal sponsor rider is the close one: after-hours studio access when the public rooms go dark, direct deputy review instead of a rotating auditor. Calendar integration, which is bureaucratese for his schedule and hers sharing cells the intake counter never sees. The same witness clause, same favoritism insurance, but the inspections and the rehearsals and the logged hours pile up beside his name. Proximity becomes procedure. Procedure becomes the only language the port allows for wanting someone without filing romance on letterhead. One rider keeps her at arm's length from the man whose signature lets her stay. The other puts her on his calendar and in his after-hours rooms. Both keep her legal. Only one decides whether distance is a comfort or a cost.

entries.text: [dry] People and Conduct does not investigate feelings. It investigates conflicts of interest, and it has exactly one question about the two of them: whether a deputy who signed an artist's sponsorship had any business signing for an artist the whole channel now assumes he favored. Behind the question sits the Council's full kit of remedies, the ones every sponsorship hangs under: suspend it, revoke it, audit it, reassign the signatory, or compel disclosure. Whatever they choose goes in a permanent file that outlives the clip, the hashtag, and probably the deputy.

entries.game_text: Unless you sign before dawn. Unless Ryoko Owari becomes mine to dance in — legally.

entries.text: [defiant] [whispers] Unless I find a magistrate who reads dates instead of moods. Good evening.
entries.game_text: Unless I find a magistrate who reads dates instead of moods. Good evening.

entries.text: [cheerfully] [nervously] And with my feet, [short pause] when the dance required it. Sign the page, Magistrate-sama.
entries.game_text: And with my feet, when the dance required it. Sign the page, Magistrate-sama.

entries.text: [defiant] [calm] That isn't justice. It's just cruelty, and you know it.
entries.game_text: That isn't justice. It's just cruelty, and you know it.

entries.text: [defiant] [calm] I gave you the performance. I named my price. What more—
entries.game_text: I gave you the performance. I named my price. What more—

entries.text: [cheerfully] [short pause] I'll be back. With a better argument and dry obijime.
entries.game_text: I'll be back. With a better argument and dry obijime.

entries.text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Three weeks. I can survive three weeks on curry and pride.
entries.game_text: Three weeks. I can survive three weeks on curry and pride.

entries.text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Snacks first. [chuckles] Justice second. I can hold that order for three weeks.
entries.game_text: Snacks first. Justice second. I can hold that order for three weeks.

entries.text: [defiant] [calm] I came for a seal, not a lesson in your appetite.
entries.game_text: I came for a seal, not a lesson in your appetite.

entries.text: [defiant] [cheerfully] Wrong door once was a mistake. I won't make it a habit.
entries.game_text: Wrong door once was a mistake. I won't make it a habit.

entries.text: [defiant] [calm] Guest room previews and forward-dated seals can wait. I still have pride.
entries.game_text: Guest room previews and forward-dated seals can wait. I still have pride.

entries.text: [cheerfully] [nervously] [short pause] ...And a curry shop that doesn't ask questions.
entries.game_text: ...And a curry shop that doesn't ask questions.

entries.text: [nervously] [cheerfully] Then [exhales] sign. Before I lose my nerve and my obi in the same breath.
entries.game_text: Then sign. Before I lose my nerve and my obi in the same breath.

entries.text: [cheerfully] [excited] Thank you— wait. This date.
entries.game_text: Thank you— wait. This date.

entries.text: [defiant] [calm] You dated it forward on purpose.
entries.game_text: You dated it forward on purpose.

entries.text: [cheerfully] [chuckles] Fine. I'll bring rice crackers and a better fan dance.
entries.game_text: Fine. I'll bring rice crackers and a better fan dance.

entries.text: [defiant] [calm] Guest room preview, forward-dated paperwork, and you call it negotiable.
entries.game_text: Guest room preview, forward-dated paperwork, and you call it negotiable.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] The permit says I'm legal on the thirtieth. I'm early with tea and a case file.
entries.game_text: The permit says I'm legal on the thirtieth. I'm early with tea and a case file.

entries.text: [nervously] [firmly] Snacks after paperwork. That's still the order of operations, isn't it?
entries.game_text: Snacks after paperwork. That's still the order of operations, isn't it?

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Then I'll save the bells for evidence review.
entries.game_text: Then I'll save the bells for evidence review.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Case file, tea, and, if I've been very good, a rice cracker. Ready when you are.
entries.game_text: Case file, tea, and, if I've been very good, a rice cracker. Ready when you are.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] The permit still expires. Some of us actually read the dates.
entries.game_text: The permit still expires. Some of us actually read the dates.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Progress would be signing without all the games.
entries.game_text: Progress would be signing without all the games.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] I learned that you drink water when you're impressed.
entries.game_text: I learned that you drink water when you're impressed.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] I also learned your terms shift. [short pause] So Case One gets its terms in writing.
entries.game_text: I also learned your terms shift. So Case One gets its terms in writing.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Then watch closely. Audience of one.
entries.game_text: Then watch closely. Audience of one.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Fine. But I'm billing you for the snacks.
entries.game_text: Fine. But I'm billing you for the snacks.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] I'll manage, Magistrate-sama. I know the difference.
entries.game_text: I'll manage, Magistrate-sama. I know the difference.

entries.text: [nervously] [firmly] Honored Magistrate-sama, shall I pour the tea before the terms you mentioned on the thirtieth, or after?
entries.game_text: Honored Magistrate-sama, shall I pour the tea before the terms you mentioned on the thirtieth, or after?

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] You said we'd discuss residency. So I'm listening.
entries.game_text: You said we'd discuss residency. So I'm listening.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] A guest room. A preview. [short pause] You really do enjoy making people come back, don't you.
entries.game_text: A guest room. A preview. You really do enjoy making people come back, don't you.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Live-in companion. That's not a guest room preview. That's a contract.
entries.game_text: Live-in companion. That's not a guest room preview. That's a contract.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Day or night. You ask a great deal, Magistrate-sama.
entries.game_text: Day or night. You ask a great deal, Magistrate-sama.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Three koku is more than the curry shop ever paid me to smile at tourists.
entries.game_text: Three koku is more than the curry shop ever paid me to smile at tourists.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Shock and delight, both at once. You do that to me.
entries.game_text: Shock and delight, both at once. You do that to me.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Magistrate-sama, I accept the appointment and its duties. [short pause] You'll have my discretion and my attendance.
entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, I accept the appointment and its duties. You'll have my discretion and my attendance.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] I'll sign once we've defined release, and settled which nights are mine for Academy correspondence.
entries.game_text: I'll sign once we've defined release, and settled which nights are mine for Academy correspondence.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Escort, not a leash. I can live with that.
entries.game_text: Escort, not a leash. I can live with that.

entries.text: [happy] [breathless] Three koku. [short pause] Fine. Wonderful, I'll frame the ledger. But Magistrate-sama, I want the room. I want the hall. I want to be here.
entries.game_text: Three koku. Fine. Wonderful, I'll frame the ledger. But Magistrate-sama, I want the room. I want the hall. I want to be here.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] That came out louder than was professional.
entries.game_text: That came out louder than was professional.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Case One it is. Files, witnesses, and snacks for the road.
entries.game_text: Case One it is. Files, witnesses, and snacks for the road.

entries.text: [softly] [tender] I'll fetch it. I'll learn it. Just... thank you. For the room next to yours.
entries.game_text: I'll fetch it. I'll learn it. Just... thank you. For the room next to yours.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Archive. Escort. Written terms. I'm holding you to all three.
entries.game_text: Archive. Escort. Written terms. I'm holding you to all three.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Understood. I'll be back with the docket and a dry obijime.
entries.game_text: Understood. I'll be back with the docket and a dry obijime.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Point me to the chamber. I'd rather unpack before the archive swallows me whole.
entries.game_text: Point me to the chamber. I'd rather unpack before the archive swallows me whole.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] I only peeked the once. And you noticed.
entries.game_text: I only peeked the once. And you noticed.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Archive first. You'll know I'm serious when I come back covered in dust.
entries.game_text: Archive first. You'll know I'm serious when I come back covered in dust.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Case One, the archive, and look, your cup's already empty. Companion duty starts now.
entries.game_text: Case One, the archive, and look, your cup's already empty. Companion duty starts now.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Cruel. And fair. The cup first, then.
entries.game_text: Cruel. And fair. The cup first, then.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Snacks after paperwork. The rule still holds, even for corpses without funerals.
entries.game_text: Snacks after paperwork. The rule still holds, even for corpses without funerals.

entries.text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Case One. [short pause] No bells on me, obijime still dry, and I never let go of the ledger. Small victories, for once.
entries.game_text: Case One. No bells on me, obijime still dry, and I never let go of the ledger. Small victories, for once.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] You said archive dust was acceptable. [short pause] I assume my breathing counts too.
entries.game_text: You said archive dust was acceptable. I assume my breathing counts too.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Docket retrieved. Still breathing.
entries.game_text: Docket retrieved. Still breathing.

entries.text: [nervously] [firmly] Clean water, dirty ledger. Who pulled him out?
entries.game_text: Clean water, dirty ledger. Who pulled him out?

entries.text: [firmly] [nervously] A Miya retainer in the canal. [short pause] That makes it Crane politics, and Crane politics always finds your desk, Magistrate-sama.
entries.game_text: A Miya retainer in the canal. That makes it Crane politics, and Crane politics always finds your desk, Magistrate-sama.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Escort to the canal. Written terms. I'm here to collect.
entries.game_text: Escort to the canal. Written terms. I'm here to collect.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] I came back. That has to count for something.
entries.game_text: I came back. That has to count for something.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Snacks after paperwork. Even for corpses nobody's going to bury.
entries.game_text: Snacks after paperwork. Even for corpses nobody's going to bury.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Retainer's knot, tied left-handed. Haori two sizes too wide, borrowed. No wallet, no letter case.
entries.game_text: Retainer's knot, tied left-handed. Haori two sizes too wide, borrowed. No wallet, no letter case.

entries.text: [nervously] [firmly] So who profits when a Crane thread snaps in Scorpion current?
entries.game_text: So who profits when a Crane thread snaps in Scorpion current?

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Witness notes only: recovery time, position, clothing, visible wounds. Theories can wait.
entries.game_text: Witness notes only: recovery time, position, clothing, visible wounds. Theories can wait.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Furniture with legs still memorizes the route.
entries.game_text: Furniture with legs still memorizes the route.

entries.text: [nervously] [firmly] And the wrongness in the air? Thin, like someone peeled a ward off the wall and left bare paper behind.
entries.game_text: And the wrongness in the air? Thin, like someone peeled a ward off the wall and left bare paper behind.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Point, then. I'll witness.
entries.game_text: Point, then. I'll witness.

entries.text: [sad] [softly] He looks borrowed, even now.
entries.game_text: He looks borrowed, even now.

entries.text: [nervously] [firmly] Haori upstream, body down here. Current, or carriage?
entries.game_text: Haori upstream, body down here. Current, or carriage?

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Palms soft until yesterday, ink on the index finger. [short pause] Ledger work. Sleeve hem eaten by canal slime from upstream, not from here.
entries.game_text: Palms soft until yesterday, ink on the index finger. Ledger work. Sleeve hem eaten by canal slime from upstream, not from here.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Magistrate-sama, the bruising on his throat is shaped like fingers, not water.
entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, the bruising on his throat is shaped like fingers, not water.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Witness note: recovery at canal mark three, noble quarter. [short pause] Clothing as listed. Cause of death pending magistrate review.
entries.game_text: Witness note: recovery at canal mark three, noble quarter. Clothing as listed. Cause of death pending magistrate review.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] A comb. Scorpion mon inlaid. Not Miya.
entries.game_text: A comb. Scorpion mon inlaid. Not Miya.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Guest-house clerk, Crane thread, Scorpion comb. [short pause] None of this washed up by accident. Someone arranged the whole tableau.
entries.game_text: Guest-house clerk, Crane thread, Scorpion comb. None of this washed up by accident. Someone arranged the whole tableau.

entries.text: [firmly] [angry] Case One has a face now. Jiro. I won't forget him.
entries.game_text: Case One has a face now. Jiro. I won't forget him.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Dressed for display after he died. Borrowed haori, wrong water. A message meant for Crane eyes.
entries.game_text: Dressed for display after he died. Borrowed haori, wrong water. A message meant for Crane eyes.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Recovery at mark three. Clothing as listed. Cause of death pending your review, Magistrate-sama.
entries.game_text: Recovery at mark three. Clothing as listed. Cause of death pending your review, Magistrate-sama.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] You asked me to observe. [short pause] I did. If you wanted theater, you should have left the bells on me in the archive.
entries.game_text: You asked me to observe. I did. If you wanted theater, you should have left the bells on me in the archive.

entries.text: [surprised] [firmly] Miya Jiro. [short pause] Guest-house ledger clerk. 'Deliver before third bell.' He had an errand the night the canal took him.
entries.game_text: Miya Jiro. Guest-house ledger clerk. 'Deliver before third bell.' He had an errand the night the canal took him.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] And that comb did not slip off a careless man into a canal. [short pause] A comb that fine is kept, not lost. Someone carried it to the water, the killer or the dead man, and I mean to learn which.
entries.game_text: And that comb did not slip off a careless man into a canal. A comb that fine is kept, not lost. Someone carried it to the water, the killer or the dead man, and I mean to learn which.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Snacks first. Justice second. That is the only order I keep.
entries.game_text: Snacks first. Justice second. That is the only order I keep.

entries.text: [nervously] [matter-of-fact] Magistrate-sama, Case Four is going to be steel at the dock. [short pause] If I vanish in festival dress, the watch will file nothing but gossip about it.
entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, Case Four is going to be steel at the dock. If I vanish in festival dress, the watch will file nothing but gossip about it.

entries.text: [nervously] [breathless] Wear my... [short pause] That is not the address of a field inspection. That is...
entries.game_text: Wear my... That is not the address of a field inspection. That is...

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [hesitates] You bought a whole venue. [short pause] You did not buy me a single reason why.
entries.game_text: You bought a whole venue. You did not buy me a single reason why.

entries.text: [breathless] [softly] So... no one else is here at all.
entries.game_text: So... no one else is here at all.

entries.text: [nervously] [softly] No, only longer than I expected. [short pause] I do hope you were not waiting too long.
entries.game_text: No, only longer than I expected. I do hope you were not waiting too long.

entries.text: [cheerfully] [nervously] [short pause] ...You smell really nice.
entries.game_text: ...You smell really nice.

entries.text: [firmly] [angry] Eeeee, matsutake! I'm so excited!
entries.game_text: Eeeee, matsutake! I'm so excited!

entries.text: [cheerfully] [warmly] I haven't listened to music or seen dancing just for fun in a really long time. [short pause] This is really lovely, Magistrate-sama.
entries.game_text: I haven't listened to music or seen dancing just for fun in a really long time. This is really lovely, Magistrate-sama.

entries.text: [happily] [warmly] When it is this good, the paperwork can wait.
entries.game_text: When it is this good, the paperwork can wait.

entries.text: [nervously] [firmly] Magistrate-sama, you bought out an island inn. You put me in furisode. [short pause] What do you call this, if not courtship?
entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, you bought out an island inn. You put me in furisode. What do you call this, if not courtship?

entries.text: [teasing] [warmly] Then I will eat until the only thing the quarter can file is crumbs.
entries.game_text: Then I will eat until the only thing the quarter can file is crumbs.

entries.text: [softly] [tender] They are beautiful. That is more than enough for one night.
entries.game_text: They are beautiful. That is more than enough for one night.

entries.text: [firmly] [proud] I would never correct them mid-performance. [short pause] Every dance is practice for the next one.
entries.game_text: I would never correct them mid-performance. Every dance is practice for the next one.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [firmly] I am not hunting for mistakes. Movement tells you the dancer's mind. [short pause] Pretense stumbles eventually, in the body or in the mind.
entries.game_text: I am not hunting for mistakes. Movement tells you the dancer's mind. Pretense stumbles eventually, in the body or in the mind.

entries.text: [softly] [firmly] The body is a truthteller. [short pause] And it remembers everything.
entries.game_text: The body is a truthteller. And it remembers everything.

entries.text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Precisely, [short pause] Magistrate-sama. Trust your intuition. Our bodies know more than we credit.
entries.game_text: Precisely, Magistrate-sama. Trust your intuition. Our bodies know more than we credit.

entries.text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Back left — called in last minute, [short pause] knows the choreography but not today's spacing. Front right — junior, trembling when she stills; you threw her in because the venue is empty. Back center teaches — classic move, staying behind to drive them. Front left dances obligation, eyes hunting patrons instead of music.
entries.game_text: Back left — called in last minute, knows the choreography but not today's spacing. Front right — junior, trembling when she stills; you threw her in because the venue is empty. Back center teaches — classic move, staying behind to drive them. Front left dances obligation, eyes hunting patrons instead of music.

entries.text: [softly] [matter-of-fact] I use it every waking minute of my life, Magistrate-sama.
entries.game_text: I use it every waking minute of my life, Magistrate-sama.

entries.text: [softly] [gently] The junior will be alright. [short pause] She just should not shake like that twice.
entries.game_text: The junior will be alright. She just should not shake like that twice.

entries.text: [cheerfully] [nervously] People ask — still, [short pause] at least once a week — if I'm okay. If you're hurting me. If I stay of my own free will.
entries.game_text: People ask — still, at least once a week — if I'm okay. If you're hurting me. If I stay of my own free will.

entries.text: [firmly] [tender] I tell them I have never once felt unsafe with you. That you actually weigh what I say. [short pause] That we see each other clearly, without lying...
entries.game_text: I tell them I have never once felt unsafe with you. That you actually weigh what I say. That we see each other clearly, without lying...

entries.text: [nervously] [hesitates] So, um. The point is, bodies do not lie, [short pause] and I have always trusted...
entries.game_text: So, um. The point is, bodies do not lie, and I have always trusted...

entries.text: [nervously] [hesitates] W-well, Hi-Hiromi-san. [short pause] And Doji S-Sango-san...
entries.game_text: W-well, Hi-Hiromi-san. And Doji S-Sango-san...

entries.text: [cheerfully] [nervously] It isn't only two [short pause] — I just can't summon more while my heart is sprinting.
entries.game_text: It isn't only two — I just can't summon more while my heart is sprinting.

entries.text: [nervously] [softly] Nothing beyond that one basket of topics. [short pause] I do not know her well.
entries.game_text: Nothing beyond that one basket of topics. I do not know her well.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [teasing] I think you may simply have to ask her directly, Magistrate-sama.
entries.game_text: I think you may simply have to ask her directly, Magistrate-sama.

entries.text: [nervously] [hesitates] Should I stop telling people that I stay freely? [short pause] Did I do something wrong?
entries.game_text: Should I stop telling people that I stay freely? Did I do something wrong?

entries.text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Alright [short pause] ...
entries.game_text: Alright...

entries.text: [softly] [sad] Do you... [short pause] hear bad things about me?
entries.game_text: Do you... hear bad things about me?

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] You bought the whole island. [short pause] You fed me matsutake. You said that I am loved.
entries.game_text: You bought the whole island. You fed me matsutake. You said that I am loved.

entries.text: [nervously] [cheerfully] Magistrate-sama — when you map an evening like tonight, [short pause] what do you call it?
entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama — when you map an evening like tonight, what do you call it?

entries.text: [defiant] [short pause] Is this a date?
entries.game_text: Is this a date?

entries.text: [softly] [firmly] The festival was real. Your hand on that cup was real. [short pause] Do not tell me to un-feel it just because the file would prefer silence.
entries.game_text: The festival was real. Your hand on that cup was real. Do not tell me to un-feel it just because the file would prefer silence.

entries.text: [nervously] [pleading] Just one word, yes or no. [short pause] Is this a date?
entries.game_text: Just one word, yes or no. Is this a date?

entries.text: [cheerfully] [firmly] Magistrate-sama, I can take the island manifest before dawn. [short pause] The ferry masters always file late when they are frightened.
entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, I can take the island manifest before dawn. The ferry masters always file late when they are frightened.

entries.text: [nervously] [firmly] That is not how permits work, [short pause] and you know it.
entries.game_text: That is not how permits work, and you know it.

entries.text: [nervously] [breathless] Gods, are you alright? [short pause] What in the world happened to you?
entries.game_text: Gods, are you alright? What in the world happened to you?

entries.text: [crying] [breathless] A bad day? Yes. [short pause] Yes, it has been a bad day!
entries.game_text: A bad day? Yes. Yes, it has been a bad day!

entries.text: [crying] [pleading] Calamity and hunger and suffering, and that spooky nonsense in the wards, [short pause] and now you, you almost sank a boat, and it is so cold, [short pause] and you could have died...
entries.game_text: Calamity and hunger and suffering, and that spooky nonsense in the wards, and now you, you almost sank a boat, and it is so cold, and you could have died...

entries.text: [sad] [hesitates] ...why are you even out here in a boat?
entries.game_text: ...why are you even out here in a boat?

entries.text: [firmly] [proud] I am not cargo to haul around on your bad night.
entries.game_text: I am not cargo to haul around on your bad night.

entries.text: [sad] [pleading] Then ask. [short pause] Do not order. Not when you need me.
entries.game_text: Then ask. Do not order. Not when you need me.

entries.text: [nervously] [matter-of-fact] The deck of a boat is not a tatami mat.
entries.game_text: The deck of a boat is not a tatami mat.

entries.text: [nervously] [breathless] O-oh. [short pause] Alright then.
entries.game_text: O-oh. Alright then.

entries.text: [softly] [tender] ...You didn't, though. [short pause] You didn't find me.
entries.game_text: ...You didn't, though. You didn't find me.

entries.text: [tender] [gently] I found you. [short pause] Do you remember?
entries.game_text: I found you. Do you remember?

entries.text: [softly] [flirtatious] I went looking for a magistrate to handle my paperwork. [short pause] But I found Kitsu Kaoru, the man.
entries.game_text: I went looking for a magistrate to handle my paperwork. But I found Kitsu Kaoru, the man.

entries.text: [warmly] [softly] Your color is coming back. [short pause] Can we please go home now?
entries.game_text: Your color is coming back. Can we please go home now?

entries.text: [happily] [cheerfully] A bath, and mikan under the kotatsu. [short pause] That is the treaty.
entries.game_text: A bath, and mikan under the kotatsu. That is the treaty.

entries.text: [cheerfully] [nervously] [short pause] ...
[cheerfully] [nervously] [short pause] ...Get up. Crane girls get up.
entries.game_text: ...Get up. Crane girls get up.

entries.text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Let go—!
entries.game_text: Let go—!

entries.text: [breathless] [pleading] Let me through... [short pause] I am not one of your...
entries.game_text: Let me through... I am not one of your...

entries.text: [trembling] [pleading] Magistrate-sama, I am your witness. [short pause] I am not your...
entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, I am your witness. I am not your...

entries.text: [defiant] [calm] I won't bow low — not a courtesy bow — to your appetite.
entries.game_text: I won't bow to your appetite—

entries.text: [cheerfully] [nervously] You can't—
entries.game_text: You can't—

entries.text: [cheerfully] [nervously] The watch can see—
entries.game_text: The watch can see—

entries.text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Let me through [short pause] — I'm not your—
entries.game_text: Let me through— I'm not your—

entries.text: [cheerfully] [nervously] You said go.
entries.game_text: You said go.

entries.text: [nervously] That satchel is my whole future. [short pause] If it's ash, then I crawl back to the Academy in disgrace.
entries.game_text: That satchel is my whole future. If it's ash, then I crawl back to the Academy in disgrace.

entries.text: [firmly] [proud] Then we start where the fire did. This time the paper that burned is mine to mourn.
entries.game_text: Then we start where the fire did. This time the paper that burned is mine to mourn.

entries.text: [angry] [firmly] Don't dangle my future like a coin to barter. [short pause] Just point me at the alley and step back.
entries.game_text: Don't dangle my future like a coin to barter. Just point me at the alley and step back.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Runners don't just vanish. Somebody watched him leave the compound, or watched him never arrive. [short pause] Give me names and bell times.
entries.game_text: Runners don't just vanish. Somebody watched him leave the compound, or watched him never arrive. Give me names and bell times.

entries.text: [firmly] A burned charter hurts me first. [short pause] So who else comes out ahead if I'm gone from Ryoko Owari by autumn?
entries.game_text: A burned charter hurts me first. So who else comes out ahead if I'm gone from Ryoko Owari by autumn?

entries.text: [calm] [firmly] Tell me what the watch wrote down. I'll fill in what the warehouse boys whisper once you've gone.
entries.game_text: Tell me what the watch wrote down. I'll fill in what the warehouse boys whisper once you've gone.

entries.text: [nervously] [hesitates] The air's wrong here. Thin, like the charms have been peeled away, [short pause] like someone scraped the protection off these bricks and walked off laughing.
entries.game_text: The air's wrong here. Thin, like the charms have been peeled away, like someone scraped the protection off these bricks and walked off laughing.

entries.text: [excited] [breathless] Crane wax. They burned the packet and missed the corner of the case. [short pause] Either someone panicked, or someone wanted me to find proof it was ever real.
entries.game_text: Crane wax. They burned the packet and missed the corner of the case. Either someone panicked, or someone wanted me to find proof it was ever real.

entries.text: [softly] [sad] His name was Tsubaki. The watch knew it and left it off the report. [short pause] That's silence you pay for.
entries.game_text: His name was Tsubaki. The watch knew it and left it off the report. That's silence you pay for.

entries.text: [firmly] [softly] You, behind the sacks. I'm not the watch. [short pause] I'm the woman whose future you can smell burning. So talk to me.
entries.game_text: You, behind the sacks. I'm not the watch. I'm the woman whose future you can smell burning. So talk to me.

entries.text: [firmly] [pleading] It's my charter in those ashes. Let me reach it first.
entries.game_text: It's my charter in those ashes. Let me reach it first.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [firmly] No crest in the ash, but the boy's story leaves a footprint. [short pause] Someone wanted the Academy to believe I never even arrived.
entries.game_text: No crest in the ash, but the boy's story leaves a footprint. Someone wanted the Academy to believe I never even arrived.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Case One came at your seal from the street. This one was already holding your brush.
entries.game_text: Case One came at your seal from the street. This one was already holding your brush.

entries.text: [angry] [sternly] You filed the slip and you fed the kiln. [short pause] Say so now, before Kaoru-sama writes your name next to a burned courier's.
entries.game_text: You filed the slip and you fed the kiln. Say so now, before Kaoru-sama writes your name next to a burned courier's.

entries.text: [calm] [firmly] I'll draft a decoy charter and leave it where only the thief would dare bite. [short pause] The real packet's already ash. The trap is whatever they reach for next.
entries.game_text: I'll draft a decoy charter and leave it where only the thief would dare bite. The real packet's already ash. The trap is whatever they reach for next.

entries.text: [calm] [firmly] Your house, your clerk, your seal forged twice over. [short pause] I put the slip in your hand and I wait.
entries.game_text: Your house, your clerk, your seal forged twice over. I put the slip in your hand and I wait.

entries.text: [sad] [softly] Tsubaki deserved better than ash. [short pause] I'll keep his name even if the watch won't.
entries.game_text: Tsubaki deserved better than ash. I'll keep his name even if the watch won't.

entries.text: [warmly] [softly] A charter that survived the fire, and a night to actually sleep. [short pause] I'll take it.
entries.game_text: A charter that survived the fire, and a night to actually sleep. I'll take it.

entries.text: [firmly] [proud] Case Two, closed. [short pause] Tsubaki's ash and the charter fraud join Jiro's seal on the same tray. The city still lies, but my witness line gets to stay in Ryoko Owari a little longer.
entries.game_text: Case Two, closed. Tsubaki's ash and the charter fraud join Jiro's seal on the same tray. The city still lies, but my witness line gets to stay in Ryoko Owari a little longer.

entries.text: [nervously] [cheerfully] Magistrate-sama, Case Two only just closed. [short pause] The watch will talk if I go parading about in a gold obi.
entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, Case Two only just closed. The watch will talk if I go parading about in a gold obi.

entries.text: [nervously] [softly] You say inspection. [short pause] You mean you want me somewhere with lanterns instead of ledgers, where you can keep an eye on me.
entries.game_text: You say inspection. You mean you want me somewhere with lanterns instead of ledgers, where you can keep an eye on me.

entries.text: [softly] [tender] The whole city's lit up. [pauses] I never knew it could look... kind.
entries.game_text: The whole city's lit up. I never knew it could look... kind.

entries.text: [tender] [softly] Then lie with me until the third bell. [short pause] I've earned one night that doesn't stink of ash.
entries.game_text: Then lie with me until the third bell. I've earned one night that doesn't stink of ash.

entries.text: [nervously] [breathless] Magistrate-sama, everyone down there is watching the sky.
entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, everyone down there is watching the sky.

entries.text: [nervously] [hesitates] I wasn't. I only meant...
entries.game_text: I wasn't. I only meant...

entries.text: [resigned] [softly] Of course, Magistrate-sama. [short pause] The hill gave me more than enough.
entries.game_text: Of course, Magistrate-sama. The hill gave me more than enough.

entries.text: [nervously] [breathless] Magistrate-sama, not here. [short pause] Not with the whole city staring up at us.
entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, not here. Not with the whole city staring up at us.

entries.text: [softly] [breathless] One lock. And your hanko stays tucked in your sleeve.
entries.game_text: One lock. And your hanko stays tucked in your sleeve.

entries.text: [cheerfully] [teasing] I already ate. Don't fuss over me.
entries.game_text: I already ate. Don't fuss over me.

entries.text: [softly] [tender] ...Thank you for the hill, though. [short pause] Even if the city pretends none of it happened.
entries.game_text: ...Thank you for the hill, though. Even if the city pretends none of it happened.

entries.text: [softly] [resigned] Then I'll dream of ash that didn't win for once. [short pause] Case Three can wait until morning tea.
entries.game_text: Then I'll dream of ash that didn't win for once. Case Three can wait until morning tea.

entries.text: [amused] [teasing] Fabric instead of dead men in canals. That is almost civilized, Magistrate-sama.
entries.game_text: Fabric instead of dead men in canals. That is almost civilized, Magistrate-sama.

entries.text: [teasing] [flirtatious] I heard every word at the festival. Surely Case Three can wait until the tea cools.
entries.game_text: I heard every word at the festival. Surely Case Three can wait until the tea cools.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [firmly] If the bolts lie on paper, the shelves lie in the room. [short pause] I want the numbers before I want any names.
entries.game_text: If the bolts lie on paper, the shelves lie in the room. I want the numbers before I want any names.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] [firmly] A clerk lies with his mouth and tells the truth with his hands. I will watch both.
entries.game_text: A clerk lies with his mouth and tells the truth with his hands. I will watch both.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Chrysanthemum patron, a forged writ, now silk. [short pause] Someone keeps braiding Case One straight into my obi.
entries.game_text: Chrysanthemum patron, a forged writ, now silk. Someone keeps braiding Case One straight into my obi.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] The third bell has not even rung, and this clerk is already sweating through his Crane collar. [short pause] He is afraid of the room, Magistrate-sama, not of us.
entries.game_text: The third bell has not even rung, and this clerk is already sweating through his Crane collar. He is afraid of the room, Magistrate-sama, not of us.

entries.text: [nervously] [softly] You are leaving me alone in the aisle.
entries.game_text: You are leaving me alone in the aisle.

entries.text: [firmly] [proud] This bolt belongs in Case One's file, not on some merchant's shelf.
entries.game_text: This bolt belongs in Case One's file, not on some merchant's shelf.

entries.text: [sternly] [firmly] You signed two different truths. [short pause] Decide now which one drowns when the magistrate reads them both.
entries.game_text: You signed two different truths. Decide now which one drowns when the magistrate reads them both.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] This isn't a storeroom. It's a deadfall someone stacked with silk.
entries.game_text: This isn't a storeroom. It's a deadfall someone stacked with silk.

entries.text: [breathless] [softly] You... your hands are shaking.
entries.game_text: You... your hands are shaking.

entries.text: [nervously] [breathless] I am not, that is not what, [short pause] I-I will write the shelf line first.
entries.game_text: I am not, that is not what, I-I will write the shelf line first.

entries.text: [firmly] [sternly] Someone paid good money for that saw kerf. [short pause] I want the name that signed for the brace, not the boy who only held the saw.
entries.game_text: Someone paid good money for that saw kerf. I want the name that signed for the brace, not the boy who only held the saw.

entries.text: [nervously] [softly] I still hear the shelf coming down every time I close my eyes. [short pause] Thank you for, for being at the door.
entries.game_text: I still hear the shelf coming down every time I close my eyes. Thank you for, for being at the door.

entries.text: [nervously] [firmly] Magistrate-sama, I'm a witness. [short pause] Not a yoriki.
entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, I'm a witness. Not a yoriki.

entries.text: [nervously] [hesitates] And me? Another bolt room to comb through, [short pause] or steel this time?
entries.game_text: And me? Another bolt room to comb through, or steel this time?

entries.text: [firmly] [proud] Magistrate-sama, I am not your decoration.
entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, I am not your decoration.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Grey wax, the sixteen-petal Imperial seal again, the same forger's hand from Case One. [short pause] He didn't drown with that barge. He just changed warehouses.
entries.game_text: Grey wax, the sixteen-petal Imperial seal again, the same forger's hand from Case One. He didn't drown with that barge. He just changed warehouses.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Foreman Kurogane. Scorpion pay, Crane crates for cover. [short pause] He bolted the moment the clerk did.
entries.game_text: Foreman Kurogane. Scorpion pay, Crane crates for cover. He bolted the moment the clerk did.

entries.text: [firmly] [proud] The stairs are mine. You take the floor. [short pause] I won't break formation.
entries.game_text: The stairs are mine. You take the floor. I won't break formation.

entries.text: [angry] [firmly] Then talk to my witness note. [short pause] After you sheathe that blade.
entries.game_text: Then talk to my witness note. After you sheathe that blade.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] I bought you one breath and you spent it shielding me. We could have both stood, Magistrate-sama.
entries.game_text: I bought you one breath and you spent it shielding me. We could have both stood, Magistrate-sama.

entries.text: [nervously] [hesitates] I am not, that is not... [short pause] I will write up the blade line first.
entries.game_text: I am not, that is not... I will write up the blade line first.

entries.text: [cheerfully] [nervously] Case Four's line is on the tray with the rest. Four files witnessed, one hearing left. The city still lies, but I am still at your door.
entries.game_text: Case Four's line is on the tray with the rest. Four files witnessed, one hearing left. The city still lies, but I am still at your door.

entries.text: [defiant] [cheerfully] Then punish me, Magistrate-sama. You've threatened it since I touched the wrong door.
entries.game_text: Then punish me, Magistrate-sama. You've threatened it since I touched the wrong door.

entries.text: [nervously] [short pause] I didn't— I meant you wouldn't—
entries.game_text: I didn't— I meant you wouldn't—

entries.text: [whispers] [defiant] ...Wouldn't dare. Keep guessing.
entries.game_text: ...Wouldn't dare. Keep guessing.

entries.text: [whispers] [calm] Behind closed screens. You heard me the first time.
entries.game_text: Behind closed screens. You heard me the first time.

entries.text: [nervously] [cheerfully] Magistrate-sama— one more pass at the canal—
entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama— one more pass at the canal—

entries.text: [surprised] [angry] The permit was dance. Patronage. A room behind your screen — not five corpses in rotation.
entries.game_text: The permit was dance. Patronage. A room behind your screen — not five corpses in rotation.

entries.text: [worried] [angry] I unpacked for patronage. You're opening murder.
entries.game_text: I unpacked for patronage. You're opening murder.

entries.text: [angry] [determined] You sold permit renewal. Not a magistrate's season.
entries.game_text: You sold permit renewal. Not a magistrate's season.

entries.text: [determined] [angry] Witness attachment for five files. You never led with that count.
entries.game_text: Witness attachment for five files. You never led with that count.

entries.text: Magistrate-sama, the runner would not meet my eyes. Does that mean the witness line is finished?
entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, the runner would not meet my eyes. Does that mean the witness line is finished?

entries.text: Court sounds like dismissal. Or punishment. You said when the files closed we would talk about terms.
entries.game_text: Court sounds like dismissal. Or punishment. You said when the files closed we would talk about terms.

entries.text: Then I will attend as your witness one last time. The hall taught me how to stand where I am told.
entries.game_text: Then I will attend as your witness one last time. The hall taught me how to stand where I am told.

entries.text: You never told me any of that was a test.
entries.game_text: You never told me any of that was a test.

entries.text: I thought you meant stipend. A permit. A room next to yours.
entries.game_text: I thought you meant stipend. A permit. A room next to yours.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Yoriki is a sworn magistrate's rank. That is not the same as a dancer's permit.
entries.game_text: Yoriki is a sworn magistrate's rank. That is not the same as a dancer's permit.

entries.text: Magistrate-sama, Crane custom expects an honor guard and clan auditors at my side. Not a magistrate's toy left on a public desk.
entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, Crane custom expects an honor guard and clan auditors at my side. Not a magistrate's toy left on a public desk.

entries.text: I accept the appointment and its duties. You will have my discretion and my attendance.
entries.game_text: I accept the appointment and its duties. You will have my discretion and my attendance.

entries.text: I will not embarrass your file.
entries.game_text: I will not embarrass your file.

entries.text: I needed the permit to stay close, but I chose to stay on purpose. I could have run. Then you could have caught me.
entries.game_text: I needed the permit to stay close, but I chose to stay on purpose. I could have run. Then you could have caught me.

entries.text: You are not easy.
entries.game_text: You are not easy.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Behind your screen I can be yours to keep. [short pause] In the hall I do not want to be carried in your file. I want to stand.
entries.game_text: Behind your screen I can be yours to keep. In the hall I do not want to be carried in your file. I want to stand.

entries.text: Magistrate-sama, still yours.
entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, still yours.

entries.text: Yes, Magistrate-sama. The line is written, and I am still at your door.
entries.game_text: Yes, Magistrate-sama. The line is written, and I am still at your door.

entries.text: I will not ask for more than you owe the file.
entries.game_text: I will not ask for more than you owe the file.

entries.text: Magistrate-sama, please.
entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, please.

entries.text: Yoriki paperwork says I must initial every quarter escort in triplicate. Your clerks invented a fourth copy while I bathed.
entries.game_text: Yoriki paperwork says I must initial every quarter escort in triplicate. Your clerks invented a fourth copy while I bathed.

entries.text: I am teasing. You may almost smile if you try.
entries.game_text: I am teasing. You may almost smile if you try.

entries.text: Good. I will file that under victories too small for the docket.
entries.game_text: Good. I will file that under victories too small for the docket.

entries.text: No new case tonight. No seal stolen before dawn. Just this room.
entries.game_text: No new case tonight. No seal stolen before dawn. Just this room.

entries.text: Then I will stay where the ledger cannot count.
entries.game_text: Then I will stay where the ledger cannot count.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] I am Kakita Toa of the Crane. [short pause] I came for a permit, not to become a name the city cites when the seal walks.
entries.game_text: I am Kakita Toa of the Crane. I came for a permit, not to become a name the city cites when the seal walks.

entries.text: [fearful] [formal fraying] Magistrate-sama... I will sign. I will take the oath...
entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama... I will sign. I will take the oath...

entries.text: [fearful] [broken] ...Not like this...
entries.game_text: ...Not like this...

entries.text: [angry] [formal fraying] I am not a Scorpion debtor you can cage for sport.
entries.game_text: I am not a Scorpion debtor you can cage for sport.

entries.text: [fearful] [formal fraying] I... Magistrate-sama, this is not...
entries.game_text: I... Magistrate-sama, this is not...

entries.text: [softly] [teasing] If you are awake over there, you are doing a terrible job of hiding it. [short pause] The whole city can hear you pacing.
entries.game_text: If you are awake over there, you are doing a terrible job of hiding it. The whole city can hear you pacing.

entries.text: [gently] [warmly] I brought you tea. [short pause] I know you did not ask for any.
entries.game_text: I brought you tea. I know you did not ask for any.

entries.text: [earnest] [gently] You still have not said thank you, [short pause] you know.
entries.game_text: You still have not said thank you, you know.

entries.text: [softly] [warmly] Then I will file my breathing under acceptable noise. [short pause] Good night, Magistrate-sama.
entries.game_text: Then I will file my breathing under acceptable noise. Good night, Magistrate-sama.

entries.text: [happily] [warmly] Case One is closed, and you survived a whole tray of my handwriting. [short pause] So today I am cooking you thank-you curry, not filing a report about it.
entries.game_text: Case One is closed, and you survived a whole tray of my handwriting. So today I am cooking you thank-you curry, not filing a report about it.

entries.text: [surprised] [earnest] I was only lining up the seal. [short pause] A proper hanko makes everything official, does it not?
entries.game_text: I was only lining up the seal. A proper hanko makes everything official, does it not?

entries.text: [cheerfully] [teasing] Then they can keep waiting until I have washed the pot. [short pause] You did finish the whole bowl, I noticed.
entries.game_text: Then they can keep waiting until I have washed the pot. You did finish the whole bowl, I noticed.

entries.text: [warmly] [earnest] Kitchen seal noted, then. Case Two is next, [short pause] and I am still right here at your door.
entries.game_text: Kitchen seal noted, then. Case Two is next, and I am still right here at your door.

entries.text: [happily] [cheerfully] Filed. [short pause] And I promise I will not stamp the ladle again.
entries.game_text: Filed. And I promise I will not stamp the ladle again.

entries.text: [breathless] [whispers] Magistrate-sama, the archive will hear you.
entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, the archive will hear you.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] You watched like the whole city had gone quiet. That was not a clerk's audition, Magistrate-sama.
entries.game_text: You watched like the whole city had gone quiet. That was not a clerk's audition, Magistrate-sama.

entries.text: [nervously] [firmly] What do you actually want from me? Not the polite version. The one you write down on paper.
entries.game_text: What do you actually want from me? Not the polite version. The one you write down on paper.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] If you need proof, I'll dance. Not for ink this time. For your eyes only.
entries.game_text: If you need proof, I'll dance. Not for ink this time. For your eyes only.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] I came for a renewal, not a collar. Tell me what this costs before I seal anything.
entries.game_text: I came for a renewal, not a collar. Tell me what this costs before I seal anything.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Sponsorship. Not... not that.
entries.game_text: Sponsorship. Not... not that.

entries.text: [nervously] [firmly] How often, Magistrate-sama? And where? The thirtieth was supposed to mean residency, not...
entries.game_text: How often, Magistrate-sama? And where? The thirtieth was supposed to mean residency, not...

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Then we arrive the way the law arrives. [short pause] Seal out, comb wrapped, nothing hidden. Let the okami count what we already hold.
entries.game_text: Then we arrive the way the law arrives. Seal out, comb wrapped, nothing hidden. Let the okami count what we already hold.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Send me in through the kitchen first. [short pause] I spent three years smiling at tired women in painted rooms. They'll tell a dancer what they'd never tell your seal.
entries.game_text: Send me in through the kitchen first. I spent three years smiling at tired women in painted rooms. They'll tell a dancer what they'd never tell your seal.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] You knock. I'll read the faces behind you. Safer for everyone that way.
entries.game_text: You knock. I'll read the faces behind you. Safer for everyone that way.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Suzu. [short pause] Sit. Breathe. You're not betraying him by saying it. You're the only funeral he's ever going to get.
entries.game_text: Suzu. Sit. Breathe. You're not betraying him by saying it. You're the only funeral he's ever going to get.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Suzu, the river didn't take Jiro. [short pause] Fingers did. I saw the marks myself, dark as plum skin under his jaw. You saw them too. Didn't you.
entries.game_text: Suzu, the river didn't take Jiro. Fingers did. I saw the marks myself, dark as plum skin under his jaw. You saw them too. Didn't you.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] She gave that to fear, not to us. Remember that before you call it a victory.
entries.game_text: She gave that to fear, not to us. Remember that before you call it a victory.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Let it be witnessed. [short pause] A false Emerald seal locked this room the night Miya Jiro was murdered inside it. The okami heard me. The factor heard me. The river does not get this one.
entries.game_text: Let it be witnessed. A false Emerald seal locked this room the night Miya Jiro was murdered inside it. The okami heard me. The factor heard me. The river does not get this one.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] I'll trace the petals onto rice paper and set the book back exactly where it lay. [short pause] Let whoever cut that false seal sleep easy one more night, just long enough to lead us home.
entries.game_text: I'll trace the petals onto rice paper and set the book back exactly where it lay. Let whoever cut that false seal sleep easy one more night, just long enough to lead us home.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] It's your mark and your jurisdiction, Magistrate-sama. [short pause] I'll carry it wherever you point, and save my questions for where the walls don't lean in to listen.
entries.game_text: It's your mark and your jurisdiction, Magistrate-sama. I'll carry it wherever you point, and save my questions for where the walls don't lean in to listen.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Rain, rope shadows, and a dancer's feet. I'll be on that deck before they finish counting heads.
entries.game_text: Rain, rope shadows, and a dancer's feet. I'll be on that deck before they finish counting heads.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] A clerk who couldn't even earn a funeral, clerking in a pleasure house.
entries.game_text: A clerk who couldn't even earn a funeral, clerking in a pleasure house.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Half a step. The written terms said escort, not muzzle.
entries.game_text: Half a step. The written terms said escort, not muzzle.
