entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Half a step behind the most feared man in the noble quarter. [short pause] I think I can live with that.
entries.game_text: Half a step behind the most feared man in the noble quarter. I think I can live with that.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Tolerance, then. It's somewhere to start.
entries.game_text: Tolerance, then. It's somewhere to start.

entries.text: [nervously] [firmly] Snacks after paperwork. Does the Lacquered Plum count as paperwork, or as the field?
entries.game_text: Snacks after paperwork. Does the Lacquered Plum count as paperwork, or as the field?

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] The air's thin again. [short pause] Peeled-charm thin. Someone scrubbed protection off this doorway and never bothered to replace it.
entries.game_text: The air's thin again. Peeled-charm thin. Someone scrubbed protection off this doorway and never bothered to replace it.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Booked, paid, private. [short pause] And here, that's Jiro's hand. The third-bell delivery, signed off the very night he died.
entries.game_text: Booked, paid, private. And here, that's Jiro's hand. The third-bell delivery, signed off the very night he died.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Magistrate-sama, look at the seal. [short pause] This chrysanthemum has sixteen petals. The Emerald office only ever cuts fourteen. The stamp's a forgery. A fine one, but the petal count gives it away.
entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, look at the seal. This chrysanthemum has sixteen petals. The Emerald office only ever cuts fourteen. The stamp's a forgery. A fine one, but the petal count gives it away.

entries.text: [nervously] [firmly] That's your office's mark, isn't it? An Emerald writ, sealing the river room off private the night Jiro died.
entries.game_text: That's your office's mark, isn't it? An Emerald writ, sealing the river room off private the night Jiro died.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] One seal stands between you and that book, and yet here you are, come to fetch it yourself. [short pause] A truly privileged record wouldn't need collecting by a man who tips in foreign silver.
entries.game_text: One seal stands between you and that book, and yet here you are, come to fetch it yourself. A truly privileged record wouldn't need collecting by a man who tips in foreign silver.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] We came for a guest registry and found a forger sitting somewhere inside your own office, Magistrate-sama.
entries.game_text: We came for a guest registry and found a forger sitting somewhere inside your own office, Magistrate-sama.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Then I'll call it progress, and try not to push my luck.
entries.game_text: Then I'll call it progress, and try not to push my luck.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Behind you. Watching. [short pause] And I still saw the petal count before you did, Magistrate-sama.
entries.game_text: Behind you. Watching. And I still saw the petal count before you did, Magistrate-sama.

entries.text: [nervously] [firmly] Escort, or cage?
entries.game_text: Escort, or cage?

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] And I'll keep noting it right back, until the ledger reads patronage beside my name.
entries.game_text: And I'll keep noting it right back, until the ledger reads patronage beside my name.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] A forged seal, a barge, and a flower with a strangler's hand. [short pause] Jiro pointed us up the current. So we follow it.
entries.game_text: A forged seal, a barge, and a flower with a strangler's hand. Jiro pointed us up the current. So we follow it.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] And it's on the record now. [short pause] Whoever cut your seal can't drown what a whole house full of witnesses already heard.
entries.game_text: And it's on the record now. Whoever cut your seal can't drown what a whole house full of witnesses already heard.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] And we copied it quiet. [short pause] The flower books his room one more high tide, never dreaming we traced his petals.
entries.game_text: And we copied it quiet. The flower books his room one more high tide, never dreaming we traced his petals.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Case One has a name, a comb, and a tide now. [short pause] Jiro pointed us up the current, and I mean to follow it all the way to the flower.
entries.game_text: Case One has a name, a comb, and a tide now. Jiro pointed us up the current, and I mean to follow it all the way to the flower.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Jiro died for one page in that book. [short pause] I am not letting the tide take it too.
entries.game_text: Jiro died for one page in that book. I am not letting the tide take it too.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] They already heard us at the Plum. The barge crew knows we're coming. Good.
entries.game_text: They already heard us at the Plum. The barge crew knows we're coming. Good.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Magistrate-sama, here's the cargo manifest. [short pause] Rice in the ledger, resin in the barrels. Jiro was right all along.
entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, here's the cargo manifest. Rice in the ledger, resin in the barrels. Jiro was right all along.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] False rice tally, true resin weight. [short pause] Someone taxed the city on its hunger and smuggled poison on the side.
entries.game_text: False rice tally, true resin weight. Someone taxed the city on its hunger and smuggled poison on the side.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Got it. Just don't let him swallow the seal this time.
entries.game_text: Got it. Just don't let him swallow the seal this time.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Jiro gets his name on the watch ledger now, and a line that says strangled. [short pause] That's a funeral worth standing in the rain for.
entries.game_text: Jiro gets his name on the watch ledger now, and a line that says strangled. That's a funeral worth standing in the rain for.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] And we still have the traced petals from the Plum. [short pause] The flower has more than one trap waiting for him now.
entries.game_text: And we still have the traced petals from the Plum. The flower has more than one trap waiting for him now.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Case One, closed. Jiro's name is on the record now, and so is mine as the witness who put it there. Then whatever the city decides to throw at us next.
entries.game_text: Case One, closed. Jiro's name is on the record now, and so is mine as the witness who put it there. Then whatever the city decides to throw at us next.

entries.text: [nervously] [dry] The elevator map said fourteen B. [short pause] The packet said fast track. Those two facts have not shaken hands yet.
entries.game_text: The elevator map said fourteen B. The packet said fast track. Those two facts have not shaken hands yet.

entries.text: [flustered] I wasn't... that is, I'm looking for Arts Council sponsorship intake?
entries.game_text: I wasn't... that is, I'm looking for Arts Council sponsorship intake?

entries.text: [dry] Fine. I'll find a deputy with better signage.
entries.game_text: Fine. I'll find a deputy with better signage.

entries.text: [nervously] Kitsu Kaoru, Deputy Director? That glass door with the badge reader?
entries.game_text: Kitsu Kaoru, Deputy Director? That glass door with the badge reader?

entries.text: [nervously] Third time's the charm. Or the deputy director. Hopefully both.
entries.game_text: Third time's the charm. Or the deputy director. Hopefully both.

entries.text: [earnest] The transfer letter said Ryoko Port had a fast track for performing arts sponsorship.
entries.game_text: The transfer letter said Ryoko Port had a fast track for performing arts sponsorship.

entries.text: [nervously] Can I at least not be the reason your Zoom looks unprofessional?
entries.game_text: Can I at least not be the reason your Zoom looks unprofessional?

entries.text: [nervously] [surprised] You want me to audition for a permit extension?
entries.game_text: You want me to audition for a permit extension?

entries.text: [warmly] That one was clean. You counted out loud.
entries.game_text: That one was clean. You counted out loud.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] Standard rider. Discretion, attendance, and no social posts that tag municipal accounts.
entries.game_text: Standard rider. Discretion, attendance, and no social posts that tag municipal accounts.

entries.text: [matter-of-fact] Exclusive rehearsal sponsor. After-hours studio access and direct deputy review.
entries.game_text: Exclusive rehearsal sponsor. After-hours studio access and direct deputy review.

entries.text: [dry] That is not a municipal form.
entries.game_text: That is not a municipal form.

entries.text: [teasing] Then audit quietly, Deputy Director-sama. The building still has ears.
entries.game_text: Then audit quietly, Deputy Director-sama. The building still has ears.

entries.text: [warmly] [softly] They don't give case numbers upstairs. So today I am cooking thank-you curry, not filing a report about it.
entries.game_text: They don't give case numbers upstairs. So today I am cooking thank-you curry, not filing a report about it.

entries.text: [cheerfully] I brought the stamp. A proper hanko makes everything official, does it not?
entries.game_text: I brought the stamp. A proper hanko makes everything official, does it not?

entries.text: [sheepishly] [amused] Filed. And I promise I will not stamp disposable tableware again.
entries.game_text: Filed. And I promise I will not stamp disposable tableware again.

entries.text: [teasing] [softly] Then I'll file my breathing under acceptable noise. Good night, Deputy Director-sama.
entries.game_text: Then I'll file my breathing under acceptable noise. Good night, Deputy Director-sama.

entries.text: [teasing] You almost smiled when I said thank-you curry, didn't you?
entries.game_text: You almost smiled when I said thank-you curry, didn't you?

entries.text: [dry] Mandatory on-site witness for a surprise inspection. That sounds like a field trip with liability.
entries.game_text: Mandatory on-site witness for a surprise inspection. That sounds like a field trip with liability.

entries.text: [dry] Velvet Lantern Wellness Collective. The sign promises serenity in four fonts.
entries.game_text: Velvet Lantern Wellness Collective. The sign promises serenity in four fonts.

entries.text: [curious] Do I film everything or only what you point at?
entries.game_text: Do I film everything or only what you point at?

entries.text: [amused] Is that a problem or a punchline?
entries.game_text: Is that a problem or a punchline?

entries.text: [amused] Timestamped video. If they move a chair, the chair has a timecode.
entries.game_text: Timestamped video. If they move a chair, the chair has a timecode.

entries.text: [quietly] Typed log. Quiet thumbs. No flash.
entries.game_text: Typed log. Quiet thumbs. No flash.

entries.text: [dry] Fourteen seats, twelve candles, one diffuser working overtime.
entries.game_text: Fourteen seats, twelve candles, one diffuser working overtime.

entries.text: [teasing] [flustered] You called me To-chan in a wellness closet. Is that witness work or harassment?
entries.game_text: You called me To-chan in a wellness closet. Is that witness work or harassment?

entries.text: [firmly] Deputy Director Kitsu is on record. [short pause] I am on record. Your hallway is on record.
entries.game_text: Deputy Director Kitsu is on record. I am on record. Your hallway is on record.

entries.text: [warmly] We only need five more minutes and your posted capacity chart. Sponsorship requires patience.
entries.game_text: We only need five more minutes and your posted capacity chart. Sponsorship requires patience.

entries.text: [nervously] Logged. My hands shook. That is also on the record.
entries.game_text: Logged. My hands shook. That is also on the record.

entries.text: [dry] I'll take classifications that keep my sponsorship active.
entries.game_text: I'll take classifications that keep my sponsorship active.

entries.text: [amused] That sounds like Case 2 with salt air.
entries.game_text: That sounds like Case 2 with salt air.

entries.text: [softly] Unless the harbor. Not romance on letterhead.
entries.game_text: Unless the harbor. Not romance on letterhead.

entries.text: [amused] If the ferry is late, do we still owe the island a witness log?
entries.game_text: If the ferry is late, do we still owe the island a witness log?

entries.text: [dry] Two hours late. My tracksuit is waterproof. My patience is municipal.
entries.game_text: Two hours late. My tracksuit is waterproof. My patience is municipal.

entries.text: [teasing] Cute. Very *audit retreat*. Does the listing mention ghosts or only damp towels?
entries.game_text: Cute. Very *audit retreat*. Does the listing mention ghosts or only damp towels?

entries.text: [amused] One bed. One deputy. That is either a rom-com or a labor violation.
entries.game_text: One bed. One deputy. That is either a rom-com or a labor violation.

entries.text: [nervously] I call the sofa. [short pause] You call the bed. That is professional roommate energy, right?
entries.game_text: I call the sofa. You call the bed. That is professional roommate energy, right?

entries.text: [amused] Sango texts: *ferry delay omg*. Then: *one bed airbnb*. Then: *girl is this a date???*
entries.game_text: Sango texts: *ferry delay omg*. Then: *one bed airbnb*. Then: *girl is this a date???*

entries.text: [dry] I should tell her it is a harbor audit with a man who counts witness work out loud.
entries.game_text: I should tell her it is a harbor audit with a man who counts witness work out loud.

entries.text: [amused] I text: *not a date. contract says not romance on letterhead. send snacks.* She sends back *sure, Jan.* And she is not wrong. The contract says not romance on letterhead, and the contract is the most romantic thing anyone has ever written about me. That is the whole joke. We file it as procedure so we never have to call it the thing it plainly is.
entries.game_text: I text: *not a date. contract says not romance on letterhead. send snacks.* She sends back *sure, Jan.* And she is not wrong. The contract says not romance on letterhead, and the contract is the most romantic thing anyone has ever written about me. That is the whole joke. We file it as procedure so we never have to call it the thing it plainly is.

entries.text: [teasing] Roommate mode. Separate sleep surfaces. [short pause] You keep your blazer on like a seatbelt.
entries.game_text: Roommate mode. Separate sleep surfaces. You keep your blazer on like a seatbelt.

entries.text: [nervously] We stress-test the exclusive rider. Not dating. Just... deliverable review with salt air.
entries.game_text: We stress-test the exclusive rider. Not dating. Just... deliverable review with salt air.

entries.text: [teasing] [softly] Then I'll file my breathing under *compliant*. Good night, Deputy Director-sama.
entries.game_text: Then I'll file my breathing under *compliant*. Good night, Deputy Director-sama.

entries.text: [firmly] Procedural night. Balcony debrief. No deliverables behind closed doors.
entries.game_text: Procedural night. Balcony debrief. No deliverables behind closed doors.

entries.text: [softly] After-hours audit. Quiet. Western inn. Not romance on letterhead.
entries.game_text: After-hours audit. Quiet. Western inn. Not romance on letterhead.

entries.text: [softly] I can hold still. Count.
entries.game_text: I can hold still. Count.

entries.text: [warmly] I file gratitude in the break room. You said so.
entries.game_text: I file gratitude in the break room. You said so.

entries.text: [softly] Already filed. Deputy Director-sama.
entries.game_text: Already filed. Deputy Director-sama.

entries.text: [dry] Tuesday HR. That sounds like the viral Zoom clip finally grew teeth.
entries.game_text: Tuesday HR. That sounds like the viral Zoom clip finally grew teeth.

entries.text: [amused] Roommate mode survived. Barely. Sango will not believe me.
entries.game_text: Roommate mode survived. Barely. Sango will not believe me.

entries.text: [amused] Exclusive rider survived cross-examination. My face did not.
entries.game_text: Exclusive rider survived cross-examination. My face did not.

entries.text: [dry] Procedural night. I can survive procedural.
entries.game_text: Procedural night. I can survive procedural.

entries.text: [teasing] Deputy Director-sama, you are trending. Your one good sentence has a hashtag and a remix.
entries.game_text: Deputy Director-sama, you are trending. Your one good sentence has a hashtag and a remix.

entries.text: [dry] The top comment says *who is the dancer*. [short pause] The second says *HR nightmare*. The third is a recipe ad. The internet has no witness posture.
entries.game_text: The top comment says *who is the dancer*. The second says *HR nightmare*. The third is a recipe ad. The internet has no witness posture.

entries.text: [dry] And someone clipped the part where you muted the gallery. They captioned it *deputy protects mystery girl*. I am the mystery girl. I have a name and an expired packet.
entries.game_text: And someone clipped the part where you muted the gallery. They captioned it *deputy protects mystery girl*. I am the mystery girl. I have a name and an expired packet.

entries.text: [earnest] [nervously] I walked into the wrong conference room once. [short pause] I have read the plate every day since. Does the file know I read the plate now?
entries.game_text: I walked into the wrong conference room once. I have read the plate every day since. Does the file know I read the plate now?

entries.text: [dry] So the building thinks the rider says romance, and the rider says *not romance on letterhead*. We agree with the letterhead. The internet did not read the letterhead.
entries.game_text: So the building thinks the rider says romance, and the rider says *not romance on letterhead*. We agree with the letterhead. The internet did not read the letterhead.

entries.text: [firmly] We post one statement. [short pause] Plain. *The deputy seated a confused applicant and corrected a packet error. There is no story. There is a queue.* I will sign my own name to it.
entries.game_text: We post one statement. Plain. *The deputy seated a confused applicant and corrected a packet error. There is no story. There is a queue.* I will sign my own name to it.

entries.text: [quietly] [firmly] Then I do nothing loud. [short pause] I keep witness posture. The clip wants a reaction. I give it a closed mouth and a current packet.
entries.game_text: Then I do nothing loud. I keep witness posture. The clip wants a reaction. I give it a closed mouth and a current packet.

entries.text: [teasing] You sound like a man reading his own name as a liability. I have practiced that face in studio mirrors. It is not a flattering port de bras.
entries.game_text: You sound like a man reading his own name as a liability. I have practiced that face in studio mirrors. It is not a flattering port de bras.

entries.text: [amused] I owned it. [short pause] *Confused applicant, corrected packet, no story.* My follower count went up. My panic went down. Roughly even trade.
entries.game_text: I owned it. *Confused applicant, corrected packet, no story.* My follower count went up. My panic went down. Roughly even trade.

entries.text: [softly] I stayed quiet. [short pause] Witness posture. It turns out the hardest deliverable is the one where I do not defend myself out loud.
entries.game_text: I stayed quiet. Witness posture. It turns out the hardest deliverable is the one where I do not defend myself out loud.

entries.text: [thoughtful] So the question is not whether we did anything against the rules. The question is which version of us goes in the permanent file. The clip's version, or the calendar's.
entries.game_text: So the question is not whether we did anything against the rules. The question is which version of us goes in the permanent file. The clip's version, or the calendar's.

entries.text: [firmly] Recuse the signatory. [short pause] Move my packet to a deputy with no hashtag. Clean conflict, clean file. You stop being my leverage. I stop being your liability.
entries.game_text: Recuse the signatory. Move my packet to a deputy with no hashtag. Clean conflict, clean file. You stop being my leverage. I stop being your liability.

entries.text: [earnest] Or we tell the truth on a form. [short pause] *Signatory and applicant have a personal relationship. Signatory discloses. Applicant consents to oversight.* Not romance on letterhead. Romance disclosed in the margin, where HR can read it.
entries.game_text: Or we tell the truth on a form. *Signatory and applicant have a personal relationship. Signatory discloses. Applicant consents to oversight.* Not romance on letterhead. Romance disclosed in the margin, where HR can read it.

entries.text: [softly] So you are not my signatory anymore. You are just the man who taught me witness posture and keeps clementines he claims he does not
entries.game_text: So you are not my signatory anymore. You are just the man who taught me witness posture and keeps clementines he claims he does not

entries.text: [warmly] You put us on a form and signed it. [short pause] That is the most romantic thing a deputy director can do. It is also, technically, paperwork. I am crying about paperwork.
entries.game_text: You put us on a form and signed it. That is the most romantic thing a deputy director can do. It is also, technically, paperwork. I am crying about paperwork.

entries.text: [dry] If the clip ever finds the ferry receipt, I will deny everything in dates and names only. Saturday. Harbor. Audit. No poetry.
entries.game_text: If the clip ever finds the ferry receipt, I will deny everything in dates and names only. Saturday. Harbor. Audit. No poetry.

entries.text: [softly] The clip got the conference room and none of the quiet parts. I find I do not want the internet auditing the quiet parts.
entries.game_text: The clip got the conference room and none of the quiet parts. I find I do not want the internet auditing the quiet parts.

entries.text: [teasing] You almost smiled when I said I cried about paperwork. [short pause] I have witnesses. The witness is me. I am very reliable.
entries.game_text: You almost smiled when I said I cried about paperwork. I have witnesses. The witness is me. I am very reliable.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] You seal your own renewals after the clerks go home, Magistrate. [short pause] A man who trusted his office would be asleep by now.
entries.game_text: You seal your own renewals after the clerks go home, Magistrate. A man who trusted his office would be asleep by now.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Then he died here, in this room, behind a seal that was never yours, and the tide carried him down to the noble canal where the watch would write drowning. [short pause] The slime on his sleeve ran the wrong way for a man who fell in downstream. He came from up here, in the licensed quarter, where the water still tastes of the Scorpion piers.
entries.game_text: Then he died here, in this room, behind a seal that was never yours, and the tide carried him down to the noble canal where the watch would write drowning. The slime on his sleeve ran the wrong way for a man who fell in downstream. He came from up here, in the licensed quarter, where the water still tastes of the Scorpion piers.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] The clerk's second ledger is the thread. [short pause] Night counts in one hand, day counts in the other, both his. He will trade the Chrysanthemum's name before he lets his own hang for the bolt room.
entries.game_text: The clerk's second ledger is the thread. Night counts in one hand, day counts in the other, both his. He will trade the Chrysanthemum's name before he lets his own hang for the bolt room.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Magistrate-sama, the colors in the back row. [short pause] He has not taken a seat, because to sit is to be entered in the record. Sixteen petals locked Jiro's room, cut by a hand that knew the Emerald office from the inside. A magistrate has been keeping the Chrysanthemum's wax warm this whole season.
entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, the colors in the back row. He has not taken a seat, because to sit is to be entered in the record. Sixteen petals locked Jiro's room, cut by a hand that knew the Emerald office from the inside. A magistrate has been keeping the Chrysanthemum's wax warm this whole season.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] So the root keeps growing, because the one hand that could cut it sits where no one dares write his name. [short pause] That is your whole season, Magistrate. Five files, none of them ever truly closed.
entries.game_text: So the root keeps growing, because the one hand that could cut it sits where no one dares write his name. That is your whole season, Magistrate. Five files, none of them ever truly closed.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] You are letting me go. After all of it, you are simply... letting me go.
entries.game_text: You are letting me go. After all of it, you are simply... letting me go.

entries.text: [teasing] Deputy Director-sama. [short pause] You have been replaced. The channel found a louder clip. A councilor narrated nine minutes of a budget meeting with his microphone muted. The internet calls it *muted councilor energy*.
entries.game_text: Deputy Director-sama. You have been replaced. The channel found a louder clip. A councilor narrated nine minutes of a budget meeting with his microphone muted. The internet calls it *muted councilor energy*.

entries.text: [amused] I am no longer the mystery girl. [short pause] I am, at most, a footnote with good hair.
entries.game_text: I am no longer the mystery girl. I am, at most, a footnote with good hair.

entries.text: [calm] The People and Conduct fishbowl went quiet months back. The folder with two names in it closed, one way or another, on terms the building agreed to carry. The building wanted a story it could stamp. It never got one.
entries.game_text: The People and Conduct fishbowl went quiet months back. The folder with two names in it closed, one way or another, on terms the building agreed to carry. The building wanted a story it could stamp. It never got one.

entries.text: [teasing] [amazed] You filed a date on letterhead. [short pause] In your own handwriting. You. The man who spent three cases insisting it was not romance on letterhead.
entries.game_text: You filed a date on letterhead. In your own handwriting. You. The man who spent three cases insisting it was not romance on letterhead.

entries.text: [softly] Effective when?
entries.game_text: Effective when?

entries.text: [warmly] Then I accept the filing as written. [short pause] Effective immediately, no waiting period. For the record, I have wanted it effective immediately since the wrong conference room. I just never filed it.
entries.game_text: Then I accept the filing as written. Effective immediately, no waiting period. For the record, I have wanted it effective immediately since the wrong conference room. I just never filed it.

entries.text: [teasing] Objection, Deputy Director-sama. For three cases you told me everything you intended to keep was effective in three business days. I want my waiting period back. I have grown attached to the suspense.
entries.game_text: Objection, Deputy Director-sama. For three cases you told me everything you intended to keep was effective in three business days. I want my waiting period back. I have grown attached to the suspense.

entries.text: [teasing] [delighted] You smiled. [short pause] I have witnesses. The witness is me. I am extremely reliable. It has been classified.
entries.game_text: You smiled. I have witnesses. The witness is me. I am extremely reliable. It has been classified.

entries.text: [amused] Granted with no waiting period, after I argued for the suspense. [short pause] I withdraw my objection. Slowly. Under protest. For the record.
entries.game_text: Granted with no waiting period, after I argued for the suspense. I withdraw my objection. Slowly. Under protest. For the record.

entries.text: [warmly] Granted and effective immediately. [short pause] I accepted the filing and the filing accepted me back. That is not how paperwork usually works.
entries.game_text: Granted and effective immediately. I accepted the filing and the filing accepted me back. That is not how paperwork usually works.

entries.text: [teasing] You restock the clementines. [short pause] You have always restocked the clementines. You denied it for a year.
entries.game_text: You restock the clementines. You have always restocked the clementines. You denied it for a year.

entries.text: [softly] I like the posture. [short pause] It is how I sit when I am paying attention. I am paying attention, Deputy Director-sama.
entries.game_text: I like the posture. It is how I sit when I am paying attention. I am paying attention, Deputy Director-sama.

entries.text: [warmly] Then I will sit like a woman who stopped reading the plate to confirm she is allowed in the room.
entries.game_text: Then I will sit like a woman who stopped reading the plate to confirm she is allowed in the room.

entries.text: [softly] We audited the rider once before, on the island, after hours. My neck still remembers the count. I came back for the rest of it.
entries.game_text: We audited the rider once before, on the island, after hours. My neck still remembers the count. I came back for the rest of it.

entries.text: [softly] We kept the island procedural. I have wondered, on every ferry since, what the unprocedural version files like.
entries.game_text: We kept the island procedural. I have wondered, on every ferry since, what the unprocedural version files like.

entries.text: [softly] Audit it. Quietly. On my word, in dates and names only. [short pause] You taught me the difference.
entries.game_text: Audit it. Quietly. On my word, in dates and names only. You taught me the difference.

entries.text: [warmly] Close it here. Warm. Dressed. Your arm, the blanket, the rain. That is the whole filing tonight.
entries.game_text: Close it here. Warm. Dressed. Your arm, the blanket, the rain. That is the whole filing tonight.

entries.text: [breathless] Friday. Harbor. Kaoru. Please.
entries.game_text: Friday. Harbor. Kaoru. Please.

entries.text: [softly] Already filed, Deputy Director-sama. The standing Friday, made flesh. Effective immediately.
entries.game_text: Already filed, Deputy Director-sama. The standing Friday, made flesh. Effective immediately.

entries.text: [warmly] I can survive an open file. [short pause] I have survived worse paperwork. This is the first one I do not want closed.
entries.game_text: I can survive an open file. I have survived worse paperwork. This is the first one I do not want closed.

entries.text: [softly] Three business days used to be how long I had to wait for everything you intended to keep.
entries.game_text: Three business days used to be how long I had to wait for everything you intended to keep.

entries.text: [warmly] I still sit in witness posture sometimes. [short pause] Old habit. It is how I sit when I am paying attention, and I am still paying attention. I read the plate before I open the door. I have for a long time now.
entries.game_text: I still sit in witness posture sometimes. Old habit. It is how I sit when I am paying attention, and I am still paying attention. I read the plate before I open the door. I have for a long time now.

entries.text: [warmly] I stopped sitting in witness posture. [short pause] I sit like the filing now. I still read the plate before I open the door, out of love instead of procedure. I have for a long time now.
entries.game_text: I stopped sitting in witness posture. I sit like the filing now. I still read the plate before I open the door, out of love instead of procedure. I have for a long time now.

entries.text: [softly] I file that under *kept*. [short pause] In a place no portal can index. And I let the harbor keep its own minutes against the glass.

entries.text: [dry] So the fast track is a person. [short pause] And I opened his door by accident, on camera.

entries.text: [amused] And here I thought I was auditioning for a permit. [short pause] I am auditioning for your signature.

entries.text: [flustered] I understand paperwork. [short pause] I am very good at paperwork when someone explains the boxes. *Direct deputy review.* I read that line three times, and my pulse did something unprofessional each time. So that is the trick of the letterhead. We file the courtship as procedure precisely so neither of us has to admit it is one. The clause is the flirting. The filing is the romance. I will not put that in writing. I am, as you keep noting, very good at not putting things in writing.

entries.text: [dry] Favoritism insurance. I document your inspections so the Council can see you are not handing permits to artists you happen to favor. The irony writes itself. I am simply not allowed to laugh about it on the record.

entries.text: [softly] Everything you offer is a calendar invite. The inspection, the weekend, possibly the rest of my life. I am starting to suspect the calendar is how you say the things you will not put in a sentence.

entries.text: [softly] Witness posture, even here. I document the want and I do not perform it where a listing photo could see. My clause never asked me not to want him. It only forbade me to put it on letterhead.

entries.text: [warmly] A standing item. The Council files those the way it files rent and rain, the recurring things it expects to keep paying attention to. I have been a great many classifications in this building. That is the first one I would frame.

entries.text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Degage, the same stretch let off the ground. [short pause] Rond de jambe, the toe drawing a half circle. Then fondu, frappe, and grand battement, which is the leg thrown up like an objection nobody bothered to sustain.
